We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Back Office Real Time Coordinator to join our Workforce Management team at Lendable. This is a newly created role, sitting at the intersection of Workforce Management and back office operations - you will be the dedicated real-time point of contact for our Complaints, Financial Crime, Fraud & Card Disputes, and Fraud Investigations teams.

Unlike frontline coordination, this role requires an understanding of case-based workflows: how cases age, where backlogs build, and how to direct resources in a way that protects SLAs. You will work closely with the Workforce Lead and directly support Team Leaders and Operational Managers across all back office functions.

Success means making data-driven decisions on the fly to optimise agent schedules, handle unexpected shifts in volume, and communicate clear, actionable, performance trends to stakeholders at all levels. If you are a natural problem-solver with a sharp eye for details who thrives in a dynamic, fast paced environment, we want you on our team! You will report directly to the Workforce Lead.

Responsibilities:

  1. Intraday Capacity & Workload Management: Monitor real-time case volumes and throughput across back office queues (Complaints, Financial Crime, Fraud, Card Disputes, Fraud Investigations), identifying capacity risks and recommending resource reallocation to protect SLA targets.

  2. Schedule & Rota Adjustments: Process intraday schedule adjustments including absences, lateness, and unplanned non-productive time. Work with the Workforce Lead and Back office operational leaders to optimise available capacity against live workload demand.

  3. Performance Monitoring & Reporting: Actively track agent schedule adherence and productive time, flagging deviations to team leaders and operational managers. Generate and distribute intraday and daily performance snapshots covering key back office metrics such as volumes worked, SLA performance, and back office occupancy.

  4. Communication & Collaboration: Act as the primary real-time point of contact for back office operational matters, proactively communicating performance risks to relevant team leaders and the Director of Complaints and Fraud. Partner with the Workforce Lead to develop Assembled capability for back office teams, including building out relevant reporting and scheduling features.

  5. Escalation Management: Identify and escalate system issues, significant deviations from planned capacity, or emerging SLA breach risks to the Workforce Lead and relevant operational leads promptly.

  6. Building the Function: As this is a newly created role, you will play an active part in shaping how back office real-time coordination works at Lendable — documenting processes, defining metrics, and establishing ways of working with each team.

 

Qualifications:

  1. Analytical Skills: Analytical and problem-solving abilities to interpret real-time data, identify trends, and make informed decisions quickly.

  2. Back Office Experience: Experience working in or closely with a back office function (Complaints, Financial Crime, Fraud, or similar) is desirable. An understanding of case-based workflows, SLA management is advantageous.

  3. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey real-time information, collaborate with team members, and escalate issues when necessary.

  4. Technical Aptitude: Proficiency in using real-time monitoring tools, analytics platforms, and software systems. Knowledge of workforce management software (Assembled, Calabrio, Genesys) is beneficial.

  5. Time Management: Ability to prioritise tasks, manage multiple streams of real-time data simultaneously, and work under pressure to meet tight deadlines and service level requirements.

Interview Process

1) 15 minute online Assessment

2) 30 minute call with a member of the Talent Team

3) Onsite Interview with the hiring manager

4) 30 remote interview with Director of Complaints, Fraud and FinCrime

Life at Lendable

jobs.title: Senior AI Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  3. Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

We're hiring two Senior Quality Engineers to set up a Quality Engineering department at Lendable alongside a new Head of Quality.

At Lendable we already have a number of profitable, award winning credit products. They have a good automated quality story. However, as our customer base has grown into the millions we need to keep evolving to keep the quality bar high. Advances in AI engineering also have enabled us to ship faster, but we need to ensure we are not regressing on our quality metrics.

This is an automation-first role. You'll spend most of your time writing code - AI Agents, test frameworks, CI tooling, helpers. You won't be executing tests by hand. You'll work cross-functionally with software engineers, product and design. Quality is a team-level responsibility and your job is to work with teams to enable them to improve their quality processes by hands-on collaboration.

You'll also be working at the frontier of AI-assisted quality, using LLMs and AI tooling to speed up test authoring, triage failures, and surface coverage gaps, while applying the engineering judgement to keep tests trustworthy.

What you'll be doing

Enable teams to keep the quality bar high

  • Rotating around different product teams for short periods to level up quality

  • Define and evolve the pragmatic test pyramid for our products - deciding where E2E is worth the weight and where testing belongs in faster layers (unit and component tests)

  • Make deliberate calls about coverage, reliability, and speed trade-offs across our products

  • Devise and set up performance benchmarks to ensure critical parts of our systems don't regress

Bring AI testing into the SDLC

  • Speed up our SDLC by building agents that exploratory test changes and catch issues before they get to production

  • Use AI tools day-to-day to accelerate test authoring, cluster failures, surface coverage insights, and propose fixes

  • Decide where AI adds leverage and where a human eye is needed. A test suite that looks comprehensive but isn't trustworthy is worse than a smaller one we rely on

Build reliable E2E automation

  • Discover gaps in testing and help teams build comprehensive suites

  • Get test environments and data fixtures to a level where they are easy to use and reliable

  • Drive flakiness down and time-to-diagnosis down. We treat a flaky test the same way we treat a broken test, and we expect root-cause work rather than retry-until-green

Prevent defects, not just catch them

  • Partner with product and engineering on shift-left quality: join specs early, push back on ambiguous acceptance criteria, and surface risk before code is written

  • Close the loop on production issues using our observability stack (Datadog, Sentry, Grafana) - tying test coverage back to real customer impact

  • Ensure teams have Service Level Objectives set up and are achieving them

  • Run targeted exploratory testing on high-risk releases when it's the right call

What we're looking for

Essential

  • 5+ years in quality engineering or test automation, with a track record of keeping automated suites stable rather than letting them rot into a graveyard of quarantined tests

  • Experience working in a scaled engineering environment with multiple teams pulling in different directions and priorities, and know how to navigate that to drive quality improvements across them

  • Hands-on coding experience of writing test code, frameworks, CI pipelines and other helper scripts. You know what a good test codebase looks like and you constantly improve it

  • API and contract testing experience, with a point of view on test data and environment strategy

  • Have set up and used Service Level Objectives to define a contract of system reliability with stakeholders, and driven measurable improvements against them

  • Native AI-assisted working style. You can describe projects where AI meaningfully changed how you worked - test authoring, failure triage, coverage analysis - and where you decided it wasn't the right tool

  • Coaching other disciplines in quality. You evangelise quality practices and get others on board to solve quality problems together

  • Experience shaping CI/CD pipelines for test reliability (GitHub Actions or similar), including flakiness reduction, parallelisation, artefact management, and runtime control

  • Proactive, low-ego, and clear communicator, able to chase things down when blocked

  • Able to operate independently and drive improvements end-to-end (frameworks, CI, test data, reporting)

  • Can point to 3-4 projects where you moved the needle on quality - for example improving SLO coverage or reducing incident rate - and can speak to the measurable impact of each

Nice to have

  • Have worked with an incident management process to root cause issues with engineers and devise meaningful quality improvements as a result

  • Experience in PHP, Kotlin or Typescript

  • Experience in financial services (retail or institutional) or other regulated environments

Our tech stack

Frontend: TypeScript, React, React Native

Backend: PHP (Symfony), Kotlin, AWS, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes

Testing: PHPUnit, Behat, JUnit, Kotest, Jest, Maestro, K6

Tooling and observability: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, Sentry, Grafana

Why join?

  • See your work matter: Our products are used by millions of customers - the quality bar you help set has a direct line to customer trust and company revenue

  • High impact: You'll decide where and how to engage across teams to move quality forward, working hands-on rather than through process layers

  • Work at the frontier of AI: AI tooling for quality is moving fast. You'll be one of the people deciding how we apply it - what's useful, what isn't, and where to keep humans in the loop

  • An organisation that ships: No layers, no theatre, fast decisions

Interview process

  • Quick call with a Recruiter

  • 15 minute cognitive test

  • Hiring manager interview (30 minutes)

  • Technical interview (60 minutes)

  • Culture interview (60 minutes)

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

jobs.title: Marketing Technology (MarTech) Manager
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Role Overview This role is designed for a strategic systems-thinker who possesses deep expertise in enterprise marketing automation, server-side tracking, and data warehousing. You will not be writing standard email copy or making Canva graphics; you will be building the pipelines that manage 10,000+ records, tracking multi-touch attribution, and orchestrating complex cross-channel automated journeys. Core Responsibilities Systems Architecture & Data Fluidity: Build and manage our core marketing technology stack, ensuring seamless data integration between our ad platforms, enterprise MAP (Marketing Automation Platform), CRM (e.g., Salesforce, Dynamics), and our data warehouse. Enterprise Automation Orchestration: Architect complex, multi-channel automated workflows (email, SMS, web personalization) using dynamic triggers. You must understand frequency control, journey governance, and predictive lead scoring models. Server-Side Tracking & Attribution: Move our tracking beyond relying on browser cookies. You will implement and manage server-side tracking environments to ensure pristine data hygiene from the first anonymous touchpoint through to closed-won revenue. AI-Driven Optimization: Integrate predictive AI for lead scoring and dynamic journey branching, utilizing generative AI models (via API) to scale personalization across high-volume campaigns. Revenue Operations (RevOps) Alignment: Ensure that marketing data translates flawlessly to sales. You will build dashboards tracking SQL rates, pipeline generated, CAC payback periods, and LTV:CAC—not just clicks and impressions. Required Technical Expertise Enterprise MAP Mastery: Advanced proficiency in at least one enterprise-grade marketing automation platform (e.g., Marketo Engage, Oracle Eloqua, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud). You must be capable of handling webhook-based integrations and API rate limits. Tracking & Tag Management: Expert-level knowledge of Google Tag Manager (specifically Server-Side GTM container setups), the Meta Conversions API, and event streaming protocols. Data Integration & Reverse ETL: Deep working knowledge of integrating data with a central warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) and using data orchestration tools or iPaaS platforms (e.g., Make, Zapier, Fivetran, or Segment) to sync customer behavioral data. Analytics & Business Intelligence: Capability to turn complex datasets into actionable dashboards using BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, or Power BI) alongside platforms like GA4. GoHighLevel (GHL) Proficiency: High capability in configuring GHL snapshots, building complex trigger-based automations, and managing its CRM ecosystem as a component of the broader stack.

jobs.title: Kantpressare
jobs.description:
Är du en erfaren kantpressare som trivs med praktiskt arbete, noggrannhet och plåtbearbetning? Då kan detta vara nästa möjlighet för dig! Vi söker nu en driven och erfaren kantpressare till en av våra kunder i Kungsör.

Om tjänsten

Som kantpressare kommer du att arbeta med plåtbearbetning och kantpressmaskiner, där du formar olika typer av plåtprodukter utifrån ritningar och givna instruktioner.

Arbetet innebär bland annat bearbetning av material som aluminium, titan och rostfritt stål, där plåten bockas över olika verktyg för att uppnå rätt form och mått inför vidare montering och produktion.

Utöver kantpressning förekommer även arbetsuppgifter som:

    Gradning
    Borrning
    Putsning
    Kontroll och efterbearbetning av färdiga detaljer
    Arbete utifrån ritningar och produktionsunderlag

Du blir en viktig del av produktionen och arbetar med fokus på kvalitet, precision och leveranssäkerhet.

Start: Enligt överenskommelseArbetstider: Dagtid

Din profil

Vi söker dig som har tidigare erfarenhet av arbete med kantpressmaskin och som känner dig trygg i att hantera maskiner och olika typer av plåtmaterial.

Det är viktigt att du är noggrann och har ett öga för detaljer, eftersom arbetet kräver precision och förståelse för mått och ritningar.

Som person är du:

    Ansvarstagande och noggrann
    Målinriktad och kvalitetsmedveten
    Flexibel och lösningsorienterad
    Positiv och engagerad
    Ordningsam
    En lagspelare med god samarbetsförmåga

Eftersom arbetet sker ute hos kund är det viktigt att du är professionell, serviceinriktad och representerar både dig själv och Fiks Group på ett bra sätt.

Vi erbjuder

    Möjlighet att arbeta hos ett stabilt och väletablerat företag i Kungsör
    En varierande roll i en modern produktionsmiljö
    Möjlighet att utveckla dina kunskaper inom plåtbearbetning
    Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter
    En arbetsplats där kvalitet och kompetens värderas högt

Lön enligt överenskommelse.

Vi går igenom ansökningarna löpande och ber om ursäkt på förhand om det kan ta lite tid med återkoppling. Målet är att alla sökande ska få återkoppling via telefon eller mejl.

Om verksamheten

Fiks Group AB erbjuder bemanning och rekrytering till våra kunder och samarbetspartners. Fiks skall upplevas som en naturlig medarbetare när behov av personal uppstår. Genom en nära relation mellan företag och personal arbetar vi tillsammans för att nå alla uppsatta mål. Vi vill skapa nöjda kunder och nöjd personal.

Vi rekryterar kompetent personal, utvecklar och bemannar kundens verksamhet. Vår snabbhet och kompetens är vår styrka och er möjlighet.

Fiks Group är ett auktoriserat bemanningsföretag i ALMEGA.

Vi har funnits sedan 1997 i Eskilstuna men bemannar och rekryterar vart än behovet i Sverige uppstår. Vi bemannar lager-, industri- samt tillverkningsbranschen, till detta utför vi även rekrytering åt handel- och restaurangbranschen.

jobs.title: Myyjiä, S-market Pohjolankatu Iisalmi
jobs.description:
Primary location:
KUOPIO

S-MARKET POHJOLANKATU IISALMI etsii nyt MYYJIÄ vakituisiin työsuhteisiin - ihan tavallisiin töihin, harvinaisen mukavien työkavereiden joukkoon

Sopimustunnit: 4-37,5 t/vk
Työt alkavat: sopimuksen mukaan syksyllä 2026

Työtä kuvataan usein korulauseilla, mutta meidän mielestämme tavallisuudessa ei ole mitään pahaa. Me Osuuskauppa PeeÄssällä sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä - eikä se tarkoita tylsää porukkaa, päinvastoin. Työ on hyvää ja sujuvaa arkea, jossa teemme myös muiden arjesta, ja välillä juhlastakin, vähän parempaa. Ja joskus juhlitaan itsekin. Jos työpaikkailmoitusten kliseet kyllästyttävät, tule meille ihan tavallisiin töihin.

S-market Pohjolankatu on Iisalmen keskustaan avautuva uusi kauppapaikka, jossa pääset mukaan rakentamaan myymälän toimintaa alusta asti. Uudessa S-marketissa luodaan yhdessä tekemisen tavat, jotka helpottavat niin asiakkaiden asiointia kuin tiimin yhteistä työskentelyä. Laajojen aukioloaikojen myymälässä päivät ovat monipuolisia ja vaihtelevia, ja jokaisen työntekijän panos näkyy heti. Onnistuminen syntyy siitä, että myymälä on kunnossa, asiakkaat kohdataan hyvin ja työkaverit pidetään mukana.

Myyjänä päiväsi kuluvat vaihtelevassa rytmissä kassatyön, kuorman purun ja hyllytyksen parissa - välillä olet myös asiakasetsivä, joka auttaa löytämään sen oikean jogurtin. Työhösi kuuluu lisäksi hävikin ja saatavuuden hallintaa, eli pidät huolen siitä, että hyllyt ovat täynnä ja hävikki pysyy mahdollisimman pienenä. Perehdytämme sinut monipuolisesti koko kaupan saloihin: kassasta kuormaan, kampanjoiden esillepanoon ja varaston hallintaan asti. Työ on liikkuvaa ja nopeatempoista, joten päivät kuluvat vauhdilla eikä tekeminen käy yksitoikkoiseksi.

Tämä työ sopii sinulle, jos viihdyt asiakkaiden parissa, tartut hommiin reippaasti ja tykkäät tehdä töitä yhdessä muiden kanssa - ja jos arvostat poikkeuksellisen hyviä henkilökunta-aleja, kannustavaa työporukkaa ja sitä pientä ylpeyden tunnetta, kun asiakas lähtee kaupasta hymy huulilla. Työ on vuorotyötä, ja odotamme hakijoilta valmiutta työskennellä vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa toimipaikan laajojen aukioloaikojen mukaan, myös öisin ja juhlapyhinä.

Edellytämme sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.
Arvostamme kaupan alan työkokemusta ja koulutusta.

Mitä se ihan tavallinen työ meillä on
- Henkilökuntaetuja: alennuksia ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista, pankkipalveluista ja monesta muusta mukavasta asiasta.
- Epassin etuja: jopa 250 € arvosta vuodessa.
- Rahaa: työehtosopimuksen mukainen palkka, 11,16 €/t - 14,93 €/t kokemusvuosista riippuen. Lisät tuovat kivasti extraa, ne maksetaan myös TES:n mukaisesti.
- Tulospalkkaus: mahdollisuus ansaita ylimääräinen jopa 2 kuukauden palkka vuodessa.
- Työpaikka, johon on kiva tulla ja olla. Ei tarvitse olla yhtä iloista perhettä, mutta älä ylläty, jos työkavereista tulee ihan vaan kavereita.
- Mahdollisuus vaihtaa tehtäviä tai alaa: jos itse haluat.

Jos ihan tavallinen työ hyvässä porukassa kuulostaa sinun jutultasi, hae mukaan jo tänään.

Hakuaika päättyy: 23.8.2026.

Lisätietoja: marketpäällikkö Mari Levoskin, mari.levoskin@sok.fi tai kenttäpäällikkö Joonas Marjanen, joonas.marjanen@sok.fi, puh. 050 348 6353


Osuuskauppa PeeÄssä on yli 134 000 asiakasomistajan omistama palvelualan yritys Pohjois-Savossa. Tavoitteenamme on olla Parhaan Elämän Edelläkävijä Savossa. Meille se tarkoittaa merkityksellistä työtä, reilua työnantajuutta ja arjen sujuvuutta. Olemme ylpeitä siitä, että voimme tuottaa osuustoiminnallista hyötyä ja kehittää sitä jatkuvasti arvojemme mukaisesti: #tunteella, #toimeliaasti, #ylpeästi ja #yhdessä.

jobs.title: Part-Time Driver Alnabru
jobs.description:
We’re looking for Part-Time Drivers to join Oda!

At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective grocery system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.

As part of our team, you’ll work with smart, passionate colleagues who bring their whole selves to work every day. It’s a fast-moving, collaborative environment where everyone is welcome and everyone’s opinion matters. Whether you're shaping the future of online retail, tackling complex logistical problems, or making everyday life better for our customers, your work will have a real impact. Read on to find out what part you could play in our story.

What you’ll be doing as a Driver 🚚

  • Report directly to our Driver Operating Managers and Team Leaders at your site as an essential part of our dedicated delivery team.

  • Be a Customer Hero: You’ll be on the road bringing groceries and smiles directly to our customers, ensuring a top-notch "Oda experience" at every doorstep.

  • Keep the wheels turning: You’ll handle loading and unloading with speed and care, ensuring every box arrives in perfect condition.

  • Own your ride: You’ll take pride in your van, keeping it clean, presentable, and ready for the road.

  • Pay it forward: You’ll help onboard and train new colleagues, sharing your best tips and tricks from the road.

  • Make us better: We value your brain as much as your driving! You’ll contribute your ideas to help us improve our routines and ways of working.

What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • A valid driving license (Class B). You’ve had your license for at least 2 years and feel confident and safe behind the wheel.

  • Good communication skills: Comfortable in speaking and writing English. If you also know Norwegian or another Nordic language, that’s a big plus!

What would be nice to have 💡

  • Enjoy being active and thrive in a physically demanding job

  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team

  • A strong work ethic and a "can-do" mindset

  • Service-minded and always looking for the best solutions

  • A genuine desire to make our customers happy

  • Responsible and always prioritize safety in traffic

What we offer 🚀

  • A chance to make a real impact as a Part-Time Driver in a fast-moving company with a product people love-while shaking up the grocery industry.

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop-less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • A chance to shape the future of grocery shopping while building a company that’s here to stay.

Practical information

  • Application deadline: We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process once the right candidates are found. We encourage you to apply as early as possible.

  • Start date: As soon as possible.

  • Position: 20% Part-time

  • Working hours: Saturday and Sunday, every other weekend.

    • Morning shift: 05:45-13:45

    • Evening shift: 13:30-21:30

  • Location: Verkseier Furulunds Vei 1, 0668 Oslo

To ensure a fair and efficient process for everyone, we use Hubert, our virtual assistant, to help us with the first selection. 🤖 Keep an eye on your inbox – shortly after applying, you’ll receive an email with an invite to a chat-based interview. Just make sure your email address is correct so the invite finds its way to you!

A few final words

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.

Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium.

We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡

jobs.title: Exploration Manager
jobs.description:
Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society's access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future – what matters is how we produce them. Become a part of us and drive change for generations to come.

Your opportunity

Do you want to join us at Boliden and lead exploration strategy and discovery delivery across one of Europe’s most prospective mining regions?

We are looking for a Department Manager in Exploration to drive growth, prioritization, and value creation in the Central Fennoscandia region. The region is centred on the Skellefte District, one of Europe's premier volcanogenic massive sulphide (VMS) districts. It includes three operating mines, as well as several exploration ventures and projects.

Who you will work with

As Department Manager for Exploration in the Central Fennoscandia region, you are accountable for the full exploration value chain, from early-stage greenfield to near-mine initiatives across the Skellefte district.

Together with your first line managers, you lead the prioritization of exploration projects, balance long-term discovery potential with short-term business needs and allocate resources to maximize value creation and organic growth across the whole region.

What you will do

The department's goal is to extend the life of mine for all operating units within the region, provide opportunities for growing and expanding the operations, and search for new discoveries to sustain the region.

You will lead and develop the regional exploration portfolio, ensuring alignment with Boliden’s overall growth strategy and long-term resource development pipeline. You will also take part in discussions regarding project prioritization and ongoing exploration activities outside of your immediate area of responsibility.

The role includes:

    Strategic leadership - Contribute actively to overall exploration strategy, prioritization and investment decisions.
    Discovery alignment – Continuously assess and evaluate the growth potential of the region and align it with business goals and expectations.
    Resource & portfolio management - Own regional budgets, forecasts and portfolio performance, ensuring optimal allocation of capital across projects.
    Personnel – Lead three section managers with a total of around 30 employees.
    Safety, wellbeing & environmental performance – Ensure strong performance in safety, wellbeing and environmental responsibility across the department.
    Stakeholder & regulatory relations – Liaise with stakeholders and governmental authorities, while ensuring projects follow applicable laws and regulations for mining and exploration companies in each country.
    Contractor & consultant management – Negotiate with and manage cooperation with contractors and consultants.

You report to the Exploration Director and participate in Boliden’s Exploration Management Team, contributing to strategic decisions across the full exploration portfolio. The position is based at the Boliden Office or at one of Boliden Mines’ locations. Frequent travel is required, as well as regular presence at the Boliden Office.

What you bring

You have a university degree in geosciences and substantial experience in mineral exploration or mining, including a proven track record in leadership roles. You also have experience managing exploration portfolios, leading multidisciplinary teams, and working in complex stakeholder environments.

We place emphasis on your ability as a manager to motivate others and provide clear leadership in line with Boliden’s leadership principles. You are committed to developing the team, the region, and the company. You are results-oriented, with a focus on discovery and on creating both short- and long-term value. We expect you to share our values of Care, Courage, and Responsibility.

jobs.title: Charity Fundraiser, Copenhagen, 15 to 37 hours a week
jobs.description:
Job title:
Charity Fundraiser, Copenhagen. No experience required.

The job

You stand in Copenhagen and stop strangers. You have thirty seconds to make them care about something that matters, and then you ask them to put their money where their heart is.

Most walk past. Some stop. A few say yes, and those are the ones that fund real work by real organisations.

It is the oldest job there is: convince a human being, face to face, with nothing but your voice.

What you actually get out of it

Forget the job. Here is the skill.

By month three you will be able to walk up to anyone, anywhere, and start a conversation that goes somewhere. You will be able to hear no fifteen times and go straight into the sixteenth conversation without flinching. You will know how to ask for something and get it.

Almost nobody has that. The people who do run companies, close deals, get hired over better candidates, and talk their way into rooms they were not invited to.

You cannot learn it from a book. You learn it by doing it four hundred times. We pay you while you do.

The money

Good Guaranteed base +

Commission on top, no ceiling. Holiday allowance and pension on top of that.

The hours

Anywhere from 15 to 37 a week.

Where it goes

We started in February 2026. We are already growing, which means the ladder above you is short and mostly empty. We promote from inside, and people have moved up to team leader in months, not years. Get good and you will be leading people before most of your friends finish their first probation period.

Straight talk

This job is not for everyone, and we would rather tell you now.

Apply

Hit apply. One minute. No CV, no cover letter, no motivation essay.

https://fremtidensfundraising.dk/ansoeg/fundraiser/

We reply within two working days. Interviews every week. Start within two weeks.

Three positions. Questions, call August on 25 78 10 13.

jobs.title: På jakt etter jobb som tilkallingsvikar sentralt i Bergen? Da er dette jobben for deg!
jobs.description:
Jeg er en 30 år gammel mann (rullestolbruker) som er bosatt på Minde i Bergen. For å dekke opp vakter ved ferier og sykdom hos andre assistenter søker jeg nå etter flere dyktige tilkallingsvikarer. Jeg vil oppfordre deg til å søke hvis du trenger en deltidsjobb ved siden av studier eller er nysgjerrig på hva en BPA-stilling går ut på.

Jeg har fagbrev i dataelektronikk og jobber i et stort firma sin IT-avdeling. Man kan trygt si at jeg er glad i alle teknologiske «duppeditter»! Jeg er en rolig og easygoing person som trives like godt på tur som på sofaen med en god film eller serie. Med jevne mellomrom er jeg i svømmehallen – det er derfor en fordel at du trives i både badstue og vannet. Noe bistand til personlig hygiene må påberegnes. På sommerstid er jeg glad i å padle, så det er en fordel at du liker å være aktiv og vil være med på korte eller lengre padleturer. Ellers er jeg glad i god mat, og liker å prøve ut nye oppskrifter. Jeg er glad i baking, film og diverse prosjekter i hjemmet.

Det er en fordel at du liker hund da jeg har en golden retriver. Han er en veldig sosial hund og liker godt å ligge i sofaen. https://www.instagram.com/hugothegoldenboy2024/

Jeg ser etter positive, pålitelige og omgjengelige assistenter som liker aktive arbeidsdager så vel som rolige. Arbeidssted vil hovedsakelig være i mitt hjem, og det er gode buss- og bybaneforbindelser. Det er også aktuelt å ha med assistenter på ferie, så det er en fordel om du liker å reise.

Da jeg selv jobber på dagtid så vil de fleste vaktene være på kveldstid og i helger. Det kan også dukke opp noen få vakter på dagtid, men stillingen passer godt til å kombineres med studier.

I stilingen som tilkallingsassistent fungerer du som en vikar for mine faste ansatte. Det vil si at det kan dukke opp vakter på kort varsel, ved sykdom og lignende. Det blir også lagt ut vakter litt lenger frem i tid.

Nødvendig opplæring vil bli gitt ved oppstart, så det er ikke et krav med relevant erfaring.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

Ce que nous offrons: Un environnement stimulant au cœur du secteur immobilier.Une équipe dynamique et collaborative.Des opportunités de formation continue et de développement professionnel. La BIL offre une large gamme de projets stimulants et un important choix de carrier/ières. Nous vous aiderons à trouver la voie qui répond le plus à vos compétences et à vos attentes. Votre développement personnel est notre priorité et nous vous encourageons à vous impliquer le plus possible pour que votre expérience soit la meilleure. La BIL est convaincue que la diversité et l'inclusion contribuent à accroître la performance collective de la Banque. Nous nous engageons à créer une culture inclusive qui encourage le développement individuel de nos employés. NB : le candidat retenu devra délivrer un extrait de  (bulletin n°3); datant de moins de 3 mois, afin de garantir son honorabilité au poste visé compte tenu de la confidentialité des informations à observer dans l'exercice de sa fonction. jobs.description:
Prenez la direction d'un village vacances 3* Atout France situé à Sevrier, à 8 km d'Annecy, offrant une vue panoramique sur le lac et un cadre exceptionnel pour des séjours en pension complète ou demi-pension. Vous serez responsable de la gestion globale du village, de la satisfaction client, du management des équipes et de la performance opérationnelle et financière de la structure.
Typologies de clients principales : Séminaires (accueil de groupes professionnels), Groupes loisirs (associations, clubs, comités d'entreprise), Familles (séjours multigénérationnels, animations adaptées).
Ouverture : Toute l'année (fermeture annuelle 4 semaines février / mars).

VOS MISSIONS :
Vous serez le garant de l'excellence opérationnelle, de la rentabilité et de l'expérience client au sein d'un village de 155 chambres (rénovées en 2020), doté d'un restaurant panoramique, d'un bar, d'une piscine extérieure, d'un parc paysager de 3,5 ha, et d'équipements dédiés aux loisirs.
1. RELATION CLIENT ET SATISFACTION
- Garantir une expérience client irréprochable pour les trois typologies (séminaires, groupes loisirs, familles).
- Piloter la qualité des prestations (hébergement, restauration, animations, services techniques).
- Développer l'accueil des séminaires : logistique, équipements adaptés, services sur mesure.
- Superviser les animations (programmes variés pour familles et adultes, semaines thématiques).
- Assurer la gestion des réclamations et proposer des solutions adaptées.
2. MANAGEMENT ET RESSOURCES HUMAINES
- Recruter, former et encadrer une équipe pluridisciplinaire
- Organiser les plannings en tenant compte des pics d'activité.
- Animer les réunions d'équipe et favoriser la coopération interservices.
- Gérer les conflits et maintenir un climat social positif.
- Évaluer les performances et mettre en place des plans de développement.
3. GESTION OPÉRATIONNELLE ET FINANCIÈRE
- Piloter le budget du village et rendre compte à la direction générale.
- Optimiser les coûts (achats groupés, gestion des stocks, maintenance préventive).
- Superviser la maintenance des infrastructures et veiller au respect des normes ERP, HACCP et sécurité.
- Assurer la passation entre saisons (clôtures comptables, inventaires).
- Développer des partenariats locaux.

VOTRE PROFIL
Formation et Expérience
- Bac+2 à Bac+5 en management hôtelier, tourisme, gestion d'entreprise ou équivalent.
- Expérience : Minimum 3 ans en tant que Directeur(trice), hôtel-club 3*+
- Expérience impérative dans la gestion de séminaires et groupes loisirs.
Compétences Techniques
- Gestion financière : Maîtrise des budgets, tableaux de bord, analyse de rentabilité.
- Outils informatiques : Suite Office, logiciels de gestion hôtelière, outils de réservation en ligne.
- Réglementaire : Connaissance du droit du travail, des conventions collectives, et des obligations légales.
- Capacité à assurer un reporting structuré, précis et constant.
Qualités Humaines
- Leadership et exemplarité : Capacité à fédérer et motiver des équipes en contexte saisonnier.
- Polyvalence et adaptabilité : Gestion simultanée de publics variés et d'imprévus.
- Sens du service client : Empathie, écoute, réactivité et justesse.
- Rigueur et organisation : Gestion des priorités et respect des délais.
- Résistance au stress : Capacité à gérer les pics d'activité.

Acteur du tourisme associatif depuis 1949, la marque Neaclub est née en 2018 de la fusion de deux associations du tourisme social et familial : Les Carrefours de l'Amitié et Chemins. Aujourd'hui, Neaclub gère 5 villages-club labellisés 3 étoiles Atout-France, ainsi qu'un chalet-refuge en Haute-Savoie, Savoie et en Drôme Provençale :
- Les Balcons du lac d'Annecy situé à Sevrier (74) ;
- Les Cîmes du Léman situé à Habère-Poche (74) ;
- La Pulka situé à Valloire (73) ;
- La Lauza situé à Valmeinier (73) ;
- Les Lavandes situé à Rémuzat (26) ;
- Le Chalet-refuge

jobs.title: Thon Hotel Arena søker nattresepsjonist
jobs.description:
Vi søker nå en natt resepsjonist i en 80% stilling. Stillingen inngår i rullerende turnus, hvor man jobber 7 dager på og 7 dager av. Arbeidstiden er 23.15-07.15 og stillingen rapporterer til resepsjonssjef. 

Hos oss vil du bli en del av et internasjonalt og inkluderende miljø hvor latteren sitter løst og hvor vi spiller hverandre gode slik at vi får fine dager på jobb og tar godt vare på det gode arbeidsmiljøet vi har på hotellet. Som resepsjonist hos oss er du villig til å strekke deg langt. Her kan du løfte Thon Hotel Arena til nye høyder ved å engasjerer og spre glede blant dine kollegaer og gjester. Vår målsetning er å bli Norges beste resepsjon. Aktuelle kandidater kalles inn fortløpende til samtaler og stillingen kan bli besatt før søknadsfristen går ut. Oppstart 2. januar 2027 eller etter avtale.

Thon Hotel Arena er et moderne konferansehotell med alle muligheter for små og store konferanser, møter og banketter. Hotellet er også et av Norges mest sentrale knutepunkt for nasjonale og internasjonale arrangementer. Med vår sentrale beliggenhet i Lillestrøm, kort gangavstand fra togstasjonen, og med kun 12 minutters reise med tog fra Oslo S. eller Oslo Lufthavn kan mennesker samles på en miljøvennlig og bærekraftig måte.
 

Ansvarsområder/arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Møte alle gjester på en profesjonell og engasjert måte

  • Inn- og utsjekk av gjester

  • Betjene sentralbord og håndtere alle henvendelser

  • Holde resepsjon og lobby ryddig og innbydende

  • Behandle personopplysninger konfidensielt

  • Ivareta gjestenes og hotellets sikkerhet

  • Aktivt jobbe med mer salg og oppsalg av hotellets produkter

  • Kasse- og kreditt håndtering

  • Verve medlemmer til vårt lojalitetsprogram Thon+

  • Diverse forefallende resepsjons arbeid

Har du kompetansen og egenskapene vi ser etter? Vi ser etter noen som:

  • Har relevant erfaring fra lignende roller, gjerne fagbrev i resepsjonist- eller reiselivsfaget og/eller kunnskap i hotellsystemet Opera/Opera Cloud

  • Er ansvarsfull

  • Trives i et hektisk arbeidsmiljø

  • Trives med salg som service

  • Er en humør spreder og trives godt med å jobbe i team

  • Er service- og kvalitetsfokusert

  • Er tilpasningsdyktig og trives i en travel hverdag

  • Liker å jobbe systematisk og har stor arbeidskapasitet

  • Har gode kommunikasjonsevner, og må minimum beherske norsk og engelsk, både skriftlig og muntlig

  • Identifiserer deg med våre verdier: Viljen til å glede, profesjonelt vertskap og levende engasjert

  • Har fylt 18 år grunnet salg og servering av alkohol.

Vi tilbyr:

  • Faglig utvikling gjennom kurs og cross training i andre avdelinger

  • Mye ansvar og muligheten til å påvirke miljøet i resepsjonen

  • Et stort fagmiljø og dedikerte ledere

  • Dyktige og hyggelige kollegaer og samarbeidspartnere

  • Tarifflønn

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Våre virksomhetsområder

Thon Gruppen er et av Norges største privateide konsern, eid av Thon Stiftelsen. Vi driver innen hotell, eiendom, og servering, og har rundt 3 000 årsverk.

Vi er engasjert i:

Thon Hotels: En av Norges største hotellkjeder, med over 90 hoteller i Norge, Sverige, Danmark, Belgia og Nederland.

Thon Eiendom: Norges største private eiendomsaktør med utleie og salg av bolig- og næringseiendom, samt drift av over 80 kjøpesentre i Norge og Sverige.

Resthon: Vår serveringsvirksomhet med barer og restauranter – fra gastropuber til spillkonsepter – med fokus på god mat og god stemning. Les mer

    Omsetningen i 2024 var ca. 13,9 milliarder kroner. Les mer om konsernet her: thon.no/om

    Hvorfor jobbe hos oss?
    • Et trygt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med fokus på bærekraft og langsiktighet
    • Gode utviklings- og karrieremuligheter, med fokus på intern rekruttering
    • Mulighet til å jobbe i et konsern med stor bredde og mange ulike roller

    Vi er opptatt av mangfold og likestilling, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke – uansett alder, kjønn, bakgrunn eller funksjonsevne.

    Les mer om hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss: thon.no/karriere

    Samfunnsansvar og bærekraft

    Gjennom Thon Stiftelsen og i vår daglige drift jobber vi aktivt med:

    • Deltakelse i FNs Global Compact
    • Miljøfyrtårn-sertifisering av våre hoteller
    • Reduksjon av matsvinn
    • Fokus på likestilling og mangfold
    • Støtte til forskning og allmennyttige formål

jobs.title: Betongarbetare (Extra)
jobs.description:
Om tjänsten

Vi söker dig med bakgrund inom snickeri, betong eller bygg till vår kund strax utanför Eskilstuna.

Tjänsten inleds med en upplärnings- och introduktionsperiod på cirka 1–1,5 månader, där du får möjlighet att lära dig arbetsuppgifterna, rutinerna och arbetssättet på plats.

Efter introduktionsperioden är tanken att arbetet övergår till en extraanställning vid behov. Tjänsten passar därför bra för dig som exempelvis studerar, har ett annat arbete, söker ett extraarbete vid sidan av annan sysselsättning eller vill testa att arbeta inom ett nytt företag och få in en fot i branschen.

Omfattningen av arbetet kommer att styras av verksamhetens behov samt din prestation, arbetsinsats och förmåga att utföra arbetet med god kvalitet.

För rätt person finns det goda möjligheter till regelbundet och mer kontinuerligt arbete. Vi ser därför gärna att du är engagerad, ansvarstagande och motiverad att utvecklas i rollen.

Arbetsuppgifterna består bland annat av armering, gjutning, formning och ritningsläsning. Företaget arbetar med tillverkning av prefabricerade stommar och har egen tillverkning av både stålstommar och betongelement.

Din profil

Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med tillverkningen av företagets prefabricerade betongelement. Det innebär att du färdigställer väggar och andra betongelement inför leverans och montage.

Som betongarbetare arbetar du huvudsakligen med att:

    

Forma, armera och gjuta väggar i betong utifrån tillverkningsunderlag och instruktioner.

    

Arbeta med stor noggrannhet och precision.

    

Säkerställa att rätt ingjutningsgods gjuts in på rätt plats i produkterna.

    

Arbeta tillsammans med ett team för att nå de uppsatta målen för dagen.

    

Ha ett stort fokus på kvalitet och säkerhet.

    

Läsa och förstå ritningar och tillverkningsunderlag.

Vi söker dig som har gymnasial utbildning eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet. Du har ett logiskt tänkande, är noggrann och behärskar svenska i tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du tidigare har arbetat med betong, armering, snickeri eller liknande arbetsuppgifter inom bygg.

Som person har du lätt för att lära dig nya saker och är driven, ansvarstagande och noggrann. Du kan leverera god kvalitet även när tempot är högt och har lätt för att samarbeta med andra.

Eftersom arbetet utförs i team är det viktigt att du har en positiv inställning och bidrar till ett bra samarbete på arbetsplatsen.

Anställningsform

Tjänsten börjar med en upplärningsperiod på cirka 1–1,5 månader. Därefter är planen att du arbetar extra vid behov, utifrån verksamhetens behov.

Det kan vara ett bra alternativ för dig som studerar, har ett annat arbete, vill ha ett extraarbete vid sidan av annan sysselsättning eller vill testa en ny arbetsplats och få möjlighet att komma in på ett nytt företag.

Hur mycket arbete som erbjuds kommer att påverkas av både verksamhetens behov och din prestation. För dig som visar framfötterna, tar ansvar och levererar ett bra arbete finns det möjlighet till mer regelbundet och kontinuerligt arbete över tid.

Vi går igenom ansökningarna löpande och ber om ursäkt på förhand om det kan ta lite tid med återkoppling. Målet är att alla sökande ska få återkoppling via telefon eller mejl.

Om verksamheten

Fiks Group AB erbjuder inhyrning av personal under korta eller längre perioder.Fiks skall upplevas som en naturlig samarbetspartner i Sverige när behov av personal uppstår.Genom en nära relation mellan företag och personal arbetar vi tillsammans för att nå våra uppsatta mål. Vi vill skapa nöjda kunder och nöjd personal.

Vi rekryterar kompetent personal, utvecklar och bemannar kundens verksamhet.Vår snabbhet och kompetens är vår styrka och er möjlighet.

Fiks Group är ett auktoriserat bemanningsföretag i ALMEGA.

Vi har funnits sedan 1997 i Eskilstuna men är nu runt hela Sverige. Vi bemannar era behov!

jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Insulsafe Ltd is looking for a skilled and experienced Plasterer to join our team. The successful candidate will carry out a range of plastering and plasterboard works on construction projects, including preparing walls and ceilings for plastering, installing plasterboard, applying plaster and finishing coats, taping and jointing plasterboard, applying joint compounds, sanding and finishing surfaces to a high standard. Duties will also include measuring and preparing materials, repairing damaged plaster and surfaces, ensuring walls and ceilings are properly prepared and finished, and using appropriate hand and power tools and plastering equipment. Applicants should have good practical knowledge of plastering techniques, materials, tools and standard practices of the plastering trade and be capable of carrying out work accurately and efficiently in accordance with required quality and health and safety standards. This is a permanent, full-time position, 39 hours per week, with an annual salary of €48,145, location in county Dublin. Please, apply through JobsIreland portal

jobs.title: Embedded Software Developer  Robotics R&D Residential  Husqvarna Group
jobs.description:
Are you an embedded software developer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and seeing your work come to life in products used by customers around the world?

Husqvarna's R&D organization for Residential Robotics is looking for an Embedded Software Developer to join our team in Huskvarna. Our robotic lawn mowers are advanced autonomous systems that combine software, electronics, mechanics, sensors, connectivity, and intelligent behaviors. This creates a unique opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in a product that makes a real difference for users every day.

About the Role

This role is best described as a Robot Developer. As part of our embedded software team, you will contribute to the development of our next generation robotic lawn mowers. Your responsibilities may include:

    Developing software for embedded systems using C/C++
    Designing and implementing new features and technologies for our robotic products
    Working with drivers, sensors, motors, and communication interfaces
    Developing and improving robotic behaviors based on sensor data and advanced algorithms
    Collaborating closely with software, electronics, mechanics, and systems engineers
    Contributing throughout the development lifecycle, from concept and design to testing and release

About You

We believe you are a curious and motivated software developer who enjoys working hands-on with technology and solving real-world challenges. To succeed in this role, you likely have:

    At least 3 years of experience in embedded software development
    Experience working with C/C++
    Experience developing software for embedded or real-time systems
    Knowledge of Linux, RTOS, drivers, sensors, communication protocols, or similar technologies
    A collaborative mindset and a willingness to learn and share knowledge
    Strong communication skills in English

It is considered a merit if you also have:

    Experience with Python
    Experience from robotics, autonomous systems, or mechatronic products

Knowledge of sensor fusion, AI, computer vision, or machine learning

Swedish language skills

Why Join Us?

At Husqvarna, you will be part of a team that works together to achieve goals, share knowledge, and continuously develop. You will see the results of your work in market-leading robotic products used by customers globally.

We value curiosity, collaboration, and continuous improvement. If you are passionate about technology and enjoy working in an open and supportive environment where innovation is encouraged, you will feel right at home with us.

Location

Huskvarna. We believe the best ideas happen when we are connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

Your application

Please apply with CV and Cover Letter. We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. For more questions regarding the position please contact:

Hiring Manager: Kim Vindemarker, kim.vindemarker@husqvarnagroup.com. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina,gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.

Processing of personal data

When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice.

Winning Through Culture

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.

Our culture is built on three core themes:

    Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
    Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
    Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

jobs.title: Sykepleier/vernepleier med hjerte for aktivitet, mestring og gode dager på Heracleum dagsenter.
jobs.description:
Bli med på å skape den gode dagen på dagsenteret!

Vi søker en erfaren sykepleier eller vernepleier som ønsker å bli en del av vårt kreative og engasjerte team på Heracleum dagsenter!

Dagaktivitet til eldre i Tromsø kommune er organisert under en felles enhetlig ledelse ved Kvaløya hjemmetjeneste.
Enhetens formål er å tilrettelegge for helhetlige og tilpassede tjenestetilbud.
Sammen med hjemmetjenesten jobber vi for systematisk og forebyggende oppfølging.
Tilbudet fra Dagsenter skal ha kvalitet som gir den enkelte deltager gode opplevelser og mening i hverdagen. Grunnlaget for slike tilbud er kunnskap om personsentrert omsorg, miljøbehandling og basiskunnskap om demenssykdommer. Formålet med oppholdet kan være hjelp til mestring, sosial støtte, ernæring og økt livskvalitet, samt avlastning for pårørende. Målet er at eldre som ønsker det kan bo hjemme så lenge som mulig.

Sykepleiere/vernepleiere på dagsenter har en viktig funksjon fordi brukerne ofte har komplekse helseutfordringer som krever faglig kompetanse og helhetlig oppfølging. 

Stillingen har per i dag arbeidstid hovedsakelig på dagtid 0800 - 1530. Endringer i arbeidstid og arbeidsplan kan bli aktuelt som følge av endrede brukerbehov, tjenestens utvikling eller organisatoriske endringer i kommunen.

Stillingen har oppstart januar 2027


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Tilby meningsfulle aktiviteter tilpasset brukernes behov. Dette kan være gode samtaler, minnearbeid, sang/musikk, gåturer, trim, quiz, høytlesing.
  • Utvikle og lede gruppeaktiviteter.
  • Samarbeide med hjemmetjenesten om observasjon og helsehjelp til brukerne, være pårørendekontakt, samt samarbeide med andre avdelinger.
  • Sentralt står også det gode måltidet og et aktivt tilstedeværende personale.
  • Delta i ulike administrative oppgaver for å sikre effektiv drift av virksomheten.
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Norsk autorisasjon som sykepleier eller vernepleier.
  • God forståelse av verktøy for EPJ og tekstbehandling. Våren 2027 går vi over til EPJ-systemet AIDN. 
  • Gode formulerings- og kommunikasjonsevner, både muntlig og skriftlig.
  • Dersom du har annet morsmål enn norsk, må språknivå tilsvarende C1 dokumenteres.
  • Ved tilsetting vil relevant erfaring og personlig egnethet vektlegges.
Personlige egenskaper
  • Er trygg, omsorgsfull og respektfull i møte med brukere og pårørende.
  • Er fleksibel, løsningsorientert og kan ta raske beslutninger.
  • Bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø.
  • Har god samarbeids og kommunikasjonsevne.
  • Bidrar positivt i arbeidsmiljøet.
  • Personlig egnethet vil vektlegges ved ansettelse.
  • Jobben krever selvstendighet, samarbeidsevne, fleksibilitet og at du har evnen til å skape den gode dagen for eldre personer på dagsenter.
Vi tilbyr
  • Stillingskode 7174 Sykepleier- Grunnlønn fra 522600 - 614400.
  • Stillingskode 6455 Vernepleier - Grunnlønn fra 522600 - 614400.
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.
  • Et trivelig arbeidsmiljø og gode utviklingsmuligheter.
  • God fagdekning og et godt faglig fellesskap.

 

  • Tilsetting skjer i henhold til gjeldende lover, reglementer og tariffavtaler.
  • Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste selv om søkeren har bedt om anonymitet. Dette blir du i så fall varslet om.
  • Ved tilsetting må gyldig politiattest iht. helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven §5-4 fremlegges.
  • Ved tilsetting kreves tuberkuloseundersøkelse for søkere som i løpet av de siste tre årene har oppholdt seg sammenhengende mer enn tre måneder i land med høy forekomst av tuberkulose iht. tuberkuloseforskriftens § 3.1 og 3.2.
  • Attester og vitnemål legges ved søknad før intervju.
  • Søknad sendes elektronisk via Webcruiter.

 

KontaktinformasjonRune Wilhelmsen, Avdelingsleder, +47 47 47 90 45
ArbeidsstedVestregata 15
9008 Tromsø
Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Tromsø kommune

Referansenr.: 5110312447
Stillingsprosent: 100%
Fast
Søknadsfrist: 24.08.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Tromsø kommune er Nord-Norges mest folkerike kommune med 77 000 innbyggere. Vi er en stor samfunnsaktør som drifter og forvalter viktige velferdsordninger, og som bidrar til utvikling av lokal infrastruktur, næring og kultur. Vi skal sikre et best mulig tjenestetilbud og service til lokalsamfunnet og kommunens innbyggere. Våre 7000 arbeidsplasser skal være preget av mangfold, og ha en arbeidsstyrke som representerer befolkningen. Vi ønsker alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke jobb hos oss.

Kvaløya hjemmetjeneste består av to ordinære hjemmetjenesteavdelinger med store deler av geografien i distrikt (avdeling Nord og  Sør) og en distriktsavdeling med heldøgns omsorgsboliger i tillegg til ordinære hjemmetjenester (avdeling Brensholmen). I tillegg er seks ulike dagaktivitetstjenester i seksjonen organisert under Kvaløya hjemmetjeneste: Tromsø aktivitet og rehabilitering (TAR) lokalisert i sentrum og avdelinger for dagaktivitet for eldre som har fem ulike lokaler i kommunen. Kvaløya har også ansvar for avdeling Forebyggende tjenester for eldre som planlegges inn i Sydspissen fra 2024. Her inngår forebyggende- og helsefremmende hjemmebesøk og hukommelsesteam. Enheten skal sørge for at innbyggere og tilreisende får nødvendig helsehjelp. Enheten gir tilbud om forebyggende og helsefremmende hjemmebesøk til kommunens 79 åringer. Vi har ansvar for hjemmesykepleie, praktisk bistand, rehabilitering, dagaktivitet og heldøgns omsorgsboliger på Havtun. Enheten skal ha fokus på omsorg, tidlig innsats, økt selvstendighet og mestring slik at innbyggerne kan bo lengst mulig i eget hjem.

jobs.title: Bus Driver - Full Time
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Bus Driver Full Time Dublin Bus is the largest Public Transport provider in Ireland. We are recruiting Professional Bus Drivers to join us in delivering a quality customer service. We are looking for people who will operate our buses safely and efficiently. *Please read the information sheet for bus driving applicants carefully prior to applying for the role. Minimum Requirements Car Licence Applicants A valid Category B Irish car driving licence (for a minimum of 2 years) with no endorsements OR Bus Licence Applicants A valid, full category D Irish driving licence, with no endorsements Up to date valid driver qualification card, category D (CPC card) An up- to- date copy from the online CPC Driver Portal as proof that your CPC is up to date, go to www.rsa.ie, click on Professional Drivers, click on Driver CPC then click on My CPC. Applicants must have excellent interpersonal skills and good command of the English language. Salary €724.10 basic rate of pay per week, increasing to €838.40 on a six-year pay scale (Including shift pay and Sunday premium, rate of pay is €893.06 per week increasing to €1034.03, on the six-year pay scale). From 01 June 2026. Shifts New drivers will operate scheduled services covering a 5-day week with rotating shifts (including night service). The standard working week will be 39 hours, exclusive of breaks. Training Successful candidates will earn €€724.10 a week while in the bus driver training programme. Successful candidates with a B Licence will commence a 6-week (full time) driver training programme, successful candidates with a D licence will commence a 4-week (full time) driver training programme. Initial training and mentoring is provided as well as on-going training and development, including periodic CPC. Benefits On appointment (following a probationary period of 6 months), we will offer you a wide range of benefits. How to Apply Apply at Dublin Bus E-Recruitment Site Click the "Search" button at the bottom of the page. Click on "Full Time Bus Driver". If you are having problems submitting your bus driver application online, please contact busdriverrecruitment@dublinbus.ie, we will provide you with assistance to submit your application form. Please visit our advertisement on https://www.dublinbus.ie/careers/bus-drivers to apply. AD PUBLISHED: FROM 10th August 2026 UNTIL 07 September 2026 Dublin Bus is an equal opportunities Employer

jobs.description:
Hasselt | Commercieel | Sales support | NL/EN | 6 adv-dagen | Vast Contract | Schoonmaaksector




Over de organisatie
Onze klant is marktleider in de verkoop en verhuur van schoonmaakproducten en machines. Reeds 40 jaar is dit bedrijf gevestigd in Hasselt en verwezenlijkt men jaarlijks een mooie groei.

Jouw nieuwe functie
Als medewerker Commercial Sales Support kom je terecht in de wereld van de schoonmaak. Hier verhuurt en verkoopt men allerlei kleine schoonmaakmachines, schoonmaakartikelen en facilitaire oplossingen. Je werkt nauw samen met de accountmanagers en samen zorgen jullie voor een fijne ervaring voor de klanten. Daarbij ondersteun je de accountmanagers op administratief vlak, inclusief het beheren van hun agenda's en het inplannen van afspraken. Ook beantwoord je alle klantvragen en speel je proactief in op de behoeften van klanten om samen nieuwe opportuniteiten te ontdekken.





Jouw profiel
Wij zijn voor deze vacature op zoek naar een kandidaat die naast Nederlands ook vloeiend Engels spreekt. Kennis van een andere taal is een pluspunt. Naast administratief nauwkeurig ben je vooral zeer klantgericht en commercieel ingesteld, met een sterke focus op telefonisch klantencontact in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels. Graag zien we kandidaten met minimum 1 à 2 jaar ervaring als inside salesmedewerker. Een hoger diploma is niet noodzakelijk.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager / Milwaukee
jobs.description:
Key Account Manager with strategic focus
Techtronic Industries Nordic, Finland

Do you want to join us on the MILWAUKEE® growth journey?

Do you have a winning attitude, and are you passionate about building strong relations?

Techtronic Industries Nordic, Finland

TTI Nordic is a well-consolidated company, which markets and sells a wide range of power tools, hand tools, outdoor products, accessories, and PPE equipment under the leading market brands MILWAUKEE® and Ryobi®. We sell through a large network of distributors in the Nordic and Baltic countries. End customers are typically professional users and quality-conscious DIY people.

We are looking for a Key Account Manager to further strengthen Milwaukees position in the exciting market, building strong partnerships with new and existing customers across Finland, as well as our Category Sales Managers internally. We are looking for a colleague with a can-do attitude, as we strive to always come up with the best possible solutions to support both our customers and colleagues across the region. You come with experience as a Key Account Manager or Product Manager and have a clear expertise of the Finnish market situation, to easily identify the best solution for greater success with different kinds of customers, across the region.

The key factors for your success are experience in Key Account Management, determination, and the ability to build long-term and trusting customer relationships. We appreciate an energetic way of working and believe that strong communication skills are key to succeeding in the role. You will work with a high level of stakeholders, where strong negotiation skills are required and thus the ability to see the larger picture, even when the good solutions take a little longer to reach – we are in it for the long run. We believe constructive feedback is important and in TTI Nordic we value trust and teamwork, and we do our best each day to raise the bar, working as a strong business partner to our customers and colleagues.

Join us on our green and innovative journey!

Our products have been developed with the green transition in mind, where we convert traditionally heavy, noisy, air- and petrol-powered products into quiet battery-powered products that also consider the work environment and ergonomics in the product. You will have a great influence on our further development in the Baltic region, and you will work in areas such as zero emissions, world goals, safety, CSR, and the environment based on our long-term green strategy.

You work from your home office, and your time is equally spent talking to your customers and the Finnish sales organization. For this role, travel days will be expected, as well as visits to Copenhagen during onboarding, for customer visits booked in the Copenhagen office, as well as our yearly Nordic Conference in week 32, where we gather all our employees from the Nordics and the Baltics.

Take charge of the entire sales process and develop the market with new customers!

You work at the strategic level where you negotiate, demonstrate and sell our range of specific power tools and accessories to both new and existing B2B customers – from the sustainability specialist to the workers on the construction site. In addition, you will have the primary responsibility for planning and following up several exciting sales activities at our dealers, in support with our Account Managers.

This means that you:

- direct and implement MILWAUKEE®'s campaign activities.
- maintain and develop existing customer relationships in collaboration with KAMs.
- follow up on leads for new business opportunities daily and update our CRM system.
- collaborate closely with marketing and product teams regarding customer needs and market trends.

Outgoing and relationship-building salesperson

- You have experience in sales and Key Account Management, with a proven track record.
- You have strong communication skills and can master these across cultures.
- You are native in Finnish and have a strong knowledge in working in English language too.
- You can see yourself in a role where you create long-term customer relationships.
- You have a high drive and energy plus a keen eye for new business opportunities.
- You have a structured relationship with sales work and strong IT skills.
- You are practically oriented and have a desire to develop your technical knowledge and product understanding.
- You need to have at least a class B drivers license.

What do we offer

We offer an exciting, independent, and dynamic job where you become part of a Nordic sales organization with leading brands and fantastic colleagues. Together, we constantly strive for even better solutions for customers and colleagues – but we also have fun. We are a growing company with a strong and clear ambition to become no. 1. We offer a competitive salary and bonus opportunity, a company car, and good career opportunities.

Do you want to go on the journey with us? Then we look forward to hearing from you!

Our recruitment process is taken care of by S&S Consulting, who supports us in Finland.

During the process, there will be a search and screening by S&S Consulting before you will meet our Finnish Head of KAM and our Nordic HR Business Partner for interviews.

For more information about the position and the recruitment process, please contact Jan Holmström at S&S Consulting, +358 500 625 543, starting from August 3rd.

Please submit your CV and application, including your salary expectation, via the link below by August 26th, 2026. We aim to conduct interviews during September. Kindly ensure that you complete the application form carefully, especially your personal details and work experience.

Who are we?

TTI is a fast-growing world leader in the design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools, garden equipment and floor care as well as accessories for both consumers, professional and industrial customers. The products are marketed to industries within the interior design, garden, renovation and construction industry. TTI Group's ongoing strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products and exceptional people is extensively characterizing our cultural DNA. jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

We are looking forSales Engineer to join our sales team (Chemical & Process).

In the Sales Engineer role, you will be responsible for designing and proposing technical solutions tailored to our customers' needs, specifically for our custom-made Plate & Shell Heat Exchangers.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Acting as technical support within the sales team for the design of Vahterus Plate & Shell Heat Exchangers.
- Ensuring our equipment meets or exceeds customer specifications, process design, and requirements.
- Continuously enhancing product and application knowledge through collaboration with colleagues, attending seminars, fairs, training, and customer events.
- Supporting clients and sales representatives from product selection to start-up and providing ongoing lifecycle support.
- Educating customers about our products and technology.
- Collaborating with engineers and experts across departments on key engineering initiatives and projects.
- Visiting current and potential customers to build and maintain strong, productive relationships.


We work in a hybrid model, so remote work is possible, however, we expect regular presence in our offices in Kalanti or Raisio. As our production site is in Kalanti, being there periodically will keep you close to the product and enable cross-departmental collaboration.

We offer you:- Comprehensive training on our products and industry expertise.
- Opportunities to work in an international network, collaborating with customers and cross-functional experts.
- A growing company in an expanding industry with a focus on innovation and development.
- Activities organized by the leisure committee Huvivaht.
- Smartum wellness and exercise benefits.
- Extensive occupational health and insurance service.


We expect you to have:
- A Bachelors or Masters degree in engineering or other suitable major.
- A technical and innovative approach to solve technical challenges.
- Curious, customer focused and hands-on approach to sales, product, and process development.
- English as your daily work language; other language skills will be seen as an advantage.


For more information about the role, please contact:

Marko Rantala, Business Sector Director, Chemical&Process
+358 44 742 7026, marko.rantala@vahterus.com

If you are interested, please leave your application at latest on 23.08.2026

Vahterus - Who we are
Established in 1990, Vahterus is a Finnish family business focused on sustainable heat exchanger solutions. We are a global company with a headquarter and manufacturing facilities in Finland, and subsidiaries in the UK, Germany, Sweden, China, and the US. Our mission is to provide the best heat exchanger solutions for our customers. Vahterus Plate & Shell Heat Exchangers have extensive applications within the chemical and process, energy, and refrigeration industries.

We aim to maintain our position as forerunners in our field through continuous product development, automated production technology, and strong application expertise. Several global patents and awards granted for our innovative design and environmentally friendly products are a token of the success of our work.

jobs.description:
Primary location:
JYVÄSKYLÄ

Etsimme nytVERKKOKAUPAN KERÄILIJÄÄ/ MYYJÄÄ PrismaSeppälänpäivittäistavarantiimiin. Tehtävä onvakituinen ja osa-aikainen (28 h / vko).

Työpäivät koostuvat monipuolisista verkkokaupan tehtävistä ja tilausten keräilystä sekä erilaisista myymälän työtehtävistä, kuten hyllytyksestä, kuormanpurusta ja asiakaspalvelusta.Vauhdikkaampanakin työpäivänä tukenasi on koko työporukka ja myyntipäällikköJuuso.

Odotamme sinulta:
aikaisempaa kokemustapäivittäistavarakaupantehtävistä
tehokasta työskentelytapaa ja halua saavuttaa asetettuja tavoitteita
tarkkaa ja huolellista otetta työhön
innostut asiakaspalvelusta ja tykkäät tiimityöstä
tartut reippaasti työtehtäviin ja hoidat hommasi ripeästi
haluat työskennellä joustavasti eri vuoroissa – palvelemme asiakkaitamme laajoilla aukioloilla

Aikaisempi kokemus päivittäistavarakaupan tehtävistä auttaa sinua menestymään työssäsi, lisäksiSeppälän Prismantiimi perehdyttää sinut huolella tehtäviisi.

Palkka perustuu kaupan alan työehtosopimukseen ja onkokemusvuosistariippuen13,13 - 14,93€/h+ ilta- ja viikonloppulisät. Meillä sinulla on mahdollisuus tulospalkkioon, joka on jopa 1,5 euroa per tehty työtunti. Meillä saat käyttöösi myös Keskimaan huiput henkilöstöedut, joista voit lukea lisää täältä:https://keskimaa.fi/henkilostoedut/

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaaJuuso Tyyskä arkisinklo 9.00–15–00 puh. 040 593 3744.


Hae tehtävää viimeistään16.8., mutta älä jää odottamaan, sillä käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuajalla.

Meillä tehdään ihan tavallista työtä, jossa on harvinaisen selkeät tavoitteet. Tueksesi saat poikkeuksellisen kivan työporukan sekä reilun ja osaavan esihenkilön.

Työyhteisötutkimuksemme mukaan 94 % työntekijöistämme suosittelisi meitä työpaikkana ja meille on myönnetty Innostavimmat työpaikat tunnustus vuodesta 2015 lähtien. Arvot näkyvät arjessamme: teemme töitä usein ilolla, välillä sisulla, aina sydämellä ja yhdessä.

Lue lisää ihan tavallisesta arjestamme sekä epätavallisen hyvistä henkilöstöeduistamme:https://keskimaa.fi/toissa-meilla

Rekrytoinnissa apuna toimii yhteistyökumppanimme MinnaStaffPointilta. Tehtävään valittu henkilö työllistyy Osuuskauppa Keskimaalle.
