jobs.title: Student Assistant in Architecture & Technology
jobs.description:
Are you studying IT, software engineering, computer science, or a related field and looking for a student position where you can work with enterprise architecture, documentation, and modern technology? At Nordic RCC, you will join a team helping build the digital foundations that support the Nordic power system and the green transition.

If you are looking to make an impact in supporting the green transition of the energy sector across Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark, you might be the person we are looking for.

Join a fast-developing Nordic company and become a part of an agile environment where we develop innovative solutions. Nordic RCC is an important contributor to the green energy transition, supporting the Nordic transmission system operators in ensuring efficient and secure operations of the Nordic electricity power system.

Your role

As a student assistant in Architecture & Technology, you will be part of a dynamic team that includes architects across multiple domains. In this role, you will support the Architecture & Technology team in documenting our architecture landscape and develop guidelines and standards for architecture documentation. You will work closely with Enterprise, System and Application Architects and gain first-hand experience of how architecture is used to guide technology decisions across a growing organisation.

What you will do

  • Assist the architecture team in ensuring the quality of existing documentation

  • Create architecture models according to standards and guidelines, and support in architecture modelling and documentation activities

  • Assist in implementation governance tools

  • Contribute to governance activities, including architecture reviews and assessments

  • Research emerging technologies, trends, and industry best practices

  • Prepare presentations, reports, and decision material for management and stakeholders

We’re looking for someone with

  • Relevant Background: You are currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software/IT Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field

  • Collaborative Attitude: You enjoy working with others and are comfortable interacting with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Interest in Architecture & Technology: You are curious about how organisations design, govern, and evolve their technology landscape

  • Structured Working Style: You have an eye for detail and enjoy creating order, structure, and clarity in documentation and information

  • Analytical and Curious Mindset: You have a strong curiosity for technology, and enjoy analysing complex topics, identifying patterns, and creating structure and clarity from information

  • Proactive Approach: You take initiative, ask questions, and are not afraid to explore new topics independently while seeking guidance when needed

Through this role, you will gain practical experience with enterprise, system, and application architecture, on-premises technologies, and technology strategy. You will have the opportunity to work alongside experienced architects and technology professionals while contributing to initiatives that support Nordic RCC's mission and the green energy transition.

The role is designed to provide meaningful hands-on experience, allowing you to apply your academic knowledge in a real-world environment while developing both your technical and professional skills.

The position will require approximately 10-15 hours per week, depending on your study workload. We are flexible during exam periods and expect that you have at least 1½ - 2 years left of your studies.

If you do not tick all the boxes, but think you could be a good match, don’t hesitate to apply for this position.

What We Offer: A Flexible and Inclusive Workplace

You will join a diverse organization of 25 nationalities, where inclusivity is celebrated, with more than 30% women on board (and a commitment to improving this balance). We are located in Copenhagen Towers office in Ørestad, with the flexibility to balance on-site and remote work 2 days a week.

At Nordic RCC, we live by the values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency—values defined by our employees that shape how we collaborate and innovate. If you see yourself thriving in such an environment, we’d love to hear from you.

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to provide information to the same extent as the candidate for security clearance.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than 15 September. We will conduct interviews on a continuous basis. If you have any questions, please contact Camilla Schneider Bergman, Head of Architecture & Technology M: +45 29 11 16 39. (Not available until 1 September)

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

jobs.title: Ryhmäliikunnanohjaaja – tule Verden tuuraajatiimiin
jobs.description:
Etsimme Kuntokeskus Verdeen innostavia ja luotettavia ryhmäliikunnanohjaajia tuuraustehtäviin.

**Haluaisitko ohjata ryhmäliikuntaa joustavasti oman aikataulusi mukaan?** Verden tuuraajatiimissä voit ottaa vastaan vapaita tunteja silloin, kun ne sopivat sinulle. Tuuraustyö sopii hyvin esimerkiksi muun työn tai opiskelun rinnalle sekä liikunta-alan yrittäjälle.

**Mitä työ sisältää?**

Verdessä järjestetään ryhmäliikuntaa seitsemänä päivänä viikossa. Tuntivalikoimaamme kuuluu muun muassa lihaskuntoharjoittelua, pumppia, kuntopiiriä, zumbaa ja sisäpyöräilyä.

Kevät- ja syyskaudella järjestämme noin 20 ryhmäliikuntatuntia viikossa maanantaista sunnuntaihin. Vakituisten ohjaajiemme rinnalle etsimme uusia tuuraajia esimerkiksi sairastumisten ja muiden poissaolojen varalle.

Voit ottaa tuurauksia vastaan oman aikataulusi ja tilanteesi mukaan. Hyvin sujuneiden tuurausten kautta voi myöhemmin avautua mahdollisuus myös omiin vakituisiin tunteihin.

Kenelle työ sopii?

Toivomme sinulta liikunta-alan koulutusta ja/tai kokemusta ryhmäliikunnan ohjaamisesta. Ennen kaikkea etsimme ohjaajia, jotka nauttivat ihmisten kohtaamisesta ja osaavat luoda tunnille kannustavan ja hyvän ilmapiirin.

Asiakkaamme ovat pääasiassa noin 30–50-vuotiaita aikuisia, joista monet liikkuvat säännöllisesti. Meille on tärkeää, että jokainen voi tulla tunnille omana itsenään ja saada onnistumisen kokemuksia omasta lähtötasostaan riippumatta.

**Saatat sopia joukkoomme, jos**

- sinulla on koulutusta tai kokemusta ryhmäliikunnan ohjaamisesta

- olet energinen, kannustava ja luotettava

- viihdyt erilaisten ihmisten parissa

- haluat tehdä ohjaustyötä joustavasti muun elämäsi rinnalla.


Työ sopii hyvin myös esimerkiksi toiminimiyrittäjälle.

jobs.title: Management Support Role to Service Operations - At the Heart of the Nordic Power System
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by supporting highly skilled engineers and contributing to the secure operation of the Nordic power system? Do you thrive in an environment where operational reliability, collaboration, and continuous improvement are essential?

At the Nordic Regional Coordination Centre, in the Service Operations department, you will work closely with a team of engineers delivering critical services to the Nordic Transmission System Operators around the clock. In the role, you will act as a daily sparring partner and facilitator for the engineering team, helping ensure effective coordination between control center duties and development activities outside the operator chair.

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the security of supply and the Nordic green energy transition, while supporting the development of engineers working in a highly specialized operational environment.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time.

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Right now, we are looking for a management support role who would like to make a difference!

Job description:

You would be supporting an engineering team that works in a hybrid setup, combining:

  • Operator-on-shift roles in the Nordic RCC coordination centre, supporting Nordic TSOs around the clock

  • Work outside the operational shift including projects, operational follow-up, and continuous improvement activities

Your primary focus will be daily coordination, professional sparring, and supporting the development of effective structures and ways of working across the team, supporting and facilitating the performance of these roles.

You will NOT be part of the Operator on-shift roster, who is performing the coordination centre tasks and services 24/7.

The position does not initially include formal personnel management, as the engineers in the setup today report directly to the Head of Department in Service Operations. You will work closely with the Head of Department on topics like department structure and set-up, and by providing day-to-day coordination and operational support, as well as mentoring and sparring on subject matter topics with the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Driving department strategy and development in collaboration with the Head of Department (HoD) supporting effective coordination between coordination centre duties and non-operational activities, both within the team and externally towards other departments

  • Facilitating knowledge sharing, supporting and securing continuous training and collaboration

  • Supporting engineers in their professional development, and acting as a sparring partner, particularly those early in their careers

  • Identifying opportunities to improve structures, processes, and operational workflows

  • Supporting planning, prioritization, and follow-up across shifts, projects, and operational tasks

  • Contributing to continuous improvement of service quality and operational efficiency as well as securing the level of contingency and business continuity

  • The role will include sharing of responsibilities as part of 3rd line support with Head of Department as the department runs 24/7 operational services

Requirements:

You bring experience from a technical or operational environment and enjoy supporting the development and collaboration of highly skilled professionals.

We expect that you:

  • Have experience working in a technical, operational, or knowledge-intensive organization

  • Demonstrate strong ability to mentor, support, and collaborate with technical specialists

  • Have experience identifying and improving structures, processes, and ways of working

  • Are comfortable working in a complex environment with the responsibility of 24/7 operational services

  • Communicate clearly and effectively across technical and organizational boundaries

Additional beneficial competencies include:

  • Experience from the power system, electrical infrastructure, or energy sector

  • Engineering or technical background

  • Experience working in control centre or operational environments

  • Familiarity with organizations delivering 24/7operational services

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.

What we offer

You will be joining a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently 25 nationalities with over 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We offer workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance, including the possibility to work from home some of the time. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note, that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than September 13th  2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include a photograph in your CV or any other materials.

jobs.title: Jord- og betonarbejder søges til projekter på Sjælland
jobs.description:
Jord- og betonarbejder søges til projekter på Sjælland

LUBI søger for en kunde dygtige og engagerede jord- og betonarbejdere til spændende projekter rundt på Sjælland. Du vil blive en del af et team, der arbejder på forskellige bygge- og anlægsopgaver i både større byområder og regionale projekter.

  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling

  • Opstart hurtigst muligt

Oplys JOB ID 22709 ved telefonisk henvendelse.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Salgs- og rekrutteringskonsulent til JWC Staffing Agency
jobs.description:
Salgs- og rekrutteringskonsulent til JWC Staffing Agency

30 timer om ugen – med mulighed for fuldtid

Har du et skarpt salgsgen, trives med en travl hverdag og motiveres af at skabe resultater gennem stærke relationer?

Hos JWC Staffing Agency søger vi en engageret salgs- og rekrutteringskonsulent, der vil være med til at udvikle vores forretning og sikre de bedste medarbejdere til byggebranchen.

Du bliver en nøglespiller i vores fortsatte vækst, hvor du får ansvaret for både at udvikle vores kundeportefølje og sikre en professionel rekrutteringsproces fra første kontakt til medarbejderen er godt i gang hos kunden.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du får en alsidig hverdag, hvor salg, rekruttering og koordinering går hånd i hånd.

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:

· Opsøge og udvikle nye kunder inden for bygge- og anlægsbranchen.

· Vedligeholde og udvikle eksisterende kunderelationer.

· Planlægge og koordinere rekrutteringsforløb fra start til slut.

· Udarbejde og publicere stillingsopslag.

· Aktivt søge efter kandidater via jobportaler, sociale medier, og netværk.

· Gennemføre telefoninterviews, jobsamtaler og kandidatvurderinger.

· Koordinere ansættelser, onboarding og opfølgning.

· Arbejde målrettet med salgsbudgetter, pipeline og KPI'er.

Vi forestiller os, at du

· Har erfaring med salg – gerne inden for byggebranchen eller bemandingsbranchen.

· Trives i en hverdag med højt tempo og mange forskellige opgaver.

· Er en dygtig relationsskaber og kommunikerer naturligt med både kunder og kandidater.

· Arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket – også når tempoet er højt.

· Er selvstændig, initiativrig og tager ansvar for dine opgaver.

· Motiveres af at skabe resultater og nå dine mål.

· Taler - forstår og skriver dansk og kan begå dig på engelsk.

Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du har erfaring fra byggebranchen eller selv har en håndværksmæssig baggrund.

Vi tilbyder

Hos os får du ikke bare et job – du bliver en del af en virksomhed i udvikling, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

· En spændende og alsidig stilling med stor indflydelse på din egen hverdag.

· Mulighed for at præge virksomhedens fortsatte vækst.

· Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger.

· Gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling.

· Attraktiv lønpakke med pension og bonusordning.

· Computer, telefon og de nødvendige arbejdsredskaber.

· Mulighed for hjemmearbejde efter aftale.

· Frihed under ansvar og fleksibilitet i hverdagen.

Hvem er vi?

JWC Staffing Agency leverer vikar- og rekrutteringsløsninger til bygge- og anlægsbranchen i hele Danmark.

Vi er en ung virksomhed med store ambitioner. Selvom JWC Staffing Agency er en relativt ny virksomhed, består vores team af medarbejdere med mange års erfaring inden for bemandings- og byggebranchen. Derfor bygger vores samarbejde på værdier som ordentlighed, troværdighed og professionalisme.

Hos os bliver du en del af et mindre team med højt humør, en uformel omgangstone og stor respekt for hinandens kompetencer. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, og derfor arbejder vi ud fra filosofien: "Vi løfter i flok."

Hos os er kolleger ikke konkurrenter. Vi deler viden, hjælper hinanden og fejrer succeserne sammen. Den kultur afspejler sig både i vores daglige samarbejde og i vores bonusstruktur.

Vi har kontorer i Kolding og Odense, og denne stilling har primær arbejdsplads i Odense.

Ansøgning

Kan du se dig selv som en del af JWC Staffing Agency, og har du lyst til at være med på vores vækstrejse? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til jwc@jwc-staffing.dk med emnet "Salg".

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Application Experts to MIMER AI Factory, NAISS
jobs.description:
We have the power of over 50,000 students and co-workers. Students who provide hope for the future. Co-workers who contribute to Linköping University meeting challenges of today. Our fundamental values rest on credibility, trust and security. By having the courage to think freely and innovate, our actions together, large and small, contribute to a better world. We look forward to receiving your application!



Do you want to work at the forefront of Europe's AI development and contribute to building the next generation of AI infrastructure?

We are now looking for several AI Application Experts who want to contribute to the adoption and application of advanced AI methods across a wide range of domains, including technology and tools, data, life science, materials science, autonomous systems, training, and other emerging application areas.

These positions offer a unique opportunity to work with researchers, companies, public-sector organizations, and AI specialists within the EuroHPC AI Factory initiative and to help users transform ideas and data into impactful AI solutions.

The position

As an AI Application Expert, you will support users and projects in applying AI methods, tools, and workflows to real-world challenges. Depending on your background and interests, you may contribute within one or several application domains.

We welcome applicants with expertise in one or more of these domains. Candidates are not expected to cover all areas, and we encourage applications from specialists who can contribute strong expertise within their field.

The role combines hands-on technical work, user support, collaboration with domain experts, and participation in the development of AI services and best practices within MIMER and the wider European AI ecosystem.

Responsibilities

AI Application Support and Expertise

    Support researchers, companies, and public-sector organizations in the adoption and use of AI technologies
    Contribute expertise within one or more domains such as life science, materials science, autonomous systems, data science, AI tools, or training
    Help identify suitable AI methods, workflows, and technologies for specific use cases

Project and User Engagement

    Work directly with users to understand challenges and translate them into AI-enabled solutions
    Provide guidance on data preparation, model development, evaluation, and deployment
    Contribute to pilot projects, demonstrations, and proof-of-concept activities

Knowledge Sharing and Community Building

    Develop documentation, tutorials, training material, and examples
    Participate in workshops, training events, and outreach activities
    Contribute to building a strong national and European AI community

Collaboration and Innovation

    Collaborate with experts from academia, industry, and the public sector
    Help identify new opportunities for AI adoption and innovation
    Contribute to the continuous improvement of MIMER services and support offerings

The person we need

We are looking for someone who has:

    A Master's degree in AI, computer science, data science, engineering, life sciences, materials science, applied mathematics, or a related field
    Practical experience with AI, machine learning, data analytics, or related computational methods
    Ability to apply technical knowledge to real-world problems
    Experience working in research, industry, public-sector organizations, or innovation projects
    Interest in AI technologies and their practical application
    Ability to work in interdisciplinary and collaborative environments
    Strong communication skills and ability to engage with different stakeholder groups

It is particularly meriting if you have:

    Experience with modern AI methods such as generative AI, foundation models, or machine learning applications
    Experience with HPC, cloud computing, data platforms, or scientific computing environments
    Experience within one or more relevant domains such as life science, materials science, autonomous systems, public-sector AI, or industrial AI
    Experience developing training materials, providing user support, or working in collaborative projects
    Experience with European research infrastructures, EuroHPC, or international collaborations
    Excellent Swedish language skills

The workplace

MIMER AI Factory is part of a European initiative to strengthen the development of trustworthy and competitive AI in research, industry, and the public sector. Through advanced supercomputing infrastructure, expert support, and international collaboration, we enable the development of AI solutions across research, industry, and public administration. The activities are carried out in close collaboration between Linköping University, NAISS, and RISE.

The employment

Fixed-term employment for 1 year, full-time, 100%.

Starting date as soon as possible or by agreement.

The employment entails 10 positions as Applikationsexpert.

This position may come to be a security classified position. If so, security screening including a records check will be carried out before any decision on employment is made.

Salary and employment benefits

Linköping University is a Swedish public employer and offers individual salary setting, as well as opportunities to combine parenthood and an active lifestyle with employment.

NAISS offers a possibility of remote work up to 40% of the working time.

More information about employee benefits is available https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/employee-benefits.

Union representatives

Information about union representatives, see https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/hjalp%20for%20sokande.

Application procedure

Apply for the position by clicking the "Apply" button below. Your application must reach Linköping University no later than August 10th, 2026.

Applications and documents received after the date above will not be considered.

We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives - diversity enriches our work and helps us grow. Preserving everybody's equal value, rights and opportunities is a natural part of who we are. Read more about our work with: https://liu.se/en/article/lika-villkor/.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Linköping university has framework agreements and wishes to decline direct contacts from staffing- and recruitment companies as well as vendors of job advertisements.

jobs.title: Regional Internal Control & Compliance Officer  Americas
jobs.description:
Do you thrive on strengthening governance, driving compliance, and making a real impact across multiple entities in an international environment? At Seco, your expertise helps shape robust internal control and compliance across the Americas.

About the job

In this position, you support entities across the Americas region in maintaining effective internal controls, compliance, governance, and risk management practices. Acting as a key regional contact, you collaborate closely with internal control leads, process owners, and leadership to ensure alignment with policies and procedures while strengthening compliance awareness. The role may also support other regions depending on the need. You report to the Head of Internal Control and Compliance.

Job responsibilities

    Support entities in performing internal controls in line with defined control designs and risk and control matrices
    Guide stakeholders to improve internal control maturity, effectiveness, and documentation
    Participate in self-assessments, control testing, and walkthroughs for new or updated controls
    Monitor internal audit and control action plans, ensuring timely and effective closure
    Coordinate internal control testing and audit activities, acting as a bridge between entities and global functions
    Review compliance actions and their status, identify gaps, and support remediation, training, and awareness initiatives

Location and flexibility

This is a remote position with a flexible location, preferably based in a country in the Americas or alternatively in Europe where Seco has an office. Occasional travel within the region may be required.

Your profile

With a strong background in internal control, compliance, or audit, you bring a structured approach to governance and risk management. You’re comfortable working in an international setting and engaging with stakeholders across different functions and cultures.

Your background also includes:

    A degree in accounting, finance, law, business administration, auditing or a closely relevant discipline
    Experience in internal control, compliance, audit, risk management, preferably in manufacturing companies
    Strong understanding of control design, testing, and follow-up
    Experience working with control documentation such as control matrices
    Solid communication and presentation skills to clearly convey risks and action plans

You bring a proactive and analytical mindset, combined with integrity and attention to detail. Collaboration comes naturally, and you know how to influence and build trust across teams without direct authority. A structured way of working and clear communication help you navigate complexity and drive progress.

Our Seco culture 

At Seco, we're united by a spirit of collaboration and a shared curiosity to learn and grow. We take responsibility for our actions, stay focused on our customers, and believe in winning together. For us, it’s also clear that our diversities form an amazing foundation for achieving great results. Curious about our workplace and benefits? Read more on our website. You’re also welcome to visit our LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us and our products further.

We have an ongoing selection process, please send us your application as soon as possible, and no later than August 31, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0095855.

We aim for an open and fair recruitment process and use different tools to ensure an objective assessment. Later in the process, you may be invited to complete a personality and logic test.

For more information about our recruitment process, please contact HR Services at hrservices.sweden@sandvik.com.

jobs.title: Vill du jobba heltid, tre pass/vecka?
jobs.description:
Om jobbet

Vi har en tjänst ledigt hos en härlig kvinna utanför Björna

Vi söker en personlig assistent som tycker om trädgård, laga mat och baka.

Du måste vara utbildad undersköterska.

Arbetstiderna är 8.00 - 21.00 (en lördag varannan vecka.) Det är 3 arbetspass i veckan.

Körkort och tillgång till egen bil är ett krav då du behöver ta dig till arbetsplatsen. Hund och Katt finns i hemmet.

Att arbeta som personlig assistent innebär att du hjälper en annan människa att leva ett så självständigt liv som möjligt. Du är den som ska kompensera för den personens funktionsnedsättning och hjälpa till med både stort och smått.

Arbetet

-innebär ofta att du hjälper till med förflyttningar, av och påklädning, personlig hygien, att sköta hushållet, vara med på fritidsaktiviteter mm.

Att bygga en stark relation som ändå är professionell är grunden för en bra assistans. Det måste finnas ett förtroende mellan dig och den du ska arbeta med och det är viktigt att ni kan fungera tillsammans. God personkemi är viktigt!

Kanske har vi jobbet som skulle vara perfekt för just Dig! Tveka inte att höra av dig till oss.



Om oss:

Care of Elin & Lotta är ett lokalt företag som arbetar med personlig assistans och personlig omsorg.

Vår värdegrund bygger på ödmjukhet, respekt och en genuin vilja att hjälpa. Vi förstår att det vi gör påverkar människors liv, och därför tar vi vårt ansvar på största allvar. Vi är tacksamma för det förtroende som ges oss, och arbetar alltid för att vara ett stöd som känns nära, tryggt och pålitligt.

Vi söker de bästa medarbetarna

Som anställd på Care of Elin & Lotta så blir du en del av ett härligt Team med närvarande chefer som vill ge dig de bästa förutsättningarna för att kunna göra ett bra arbete. Vi vill ge våra kunder den allra bästa assistansen och omsorgen och det innebär att vi även har höga krav på vår personal.

När du arbetar hos oss så förväntar vi oss att du har ett professionellt förhållningssätt till yrket och är en god lagspelare som tillsammans med dina kollegor och chefer arbetar aktivt för att skapa en bra och lösningsfokuserad arbetsgrupp.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Tilkallingsassistent søkes til BPA-team på natt og kveld for latterfylt 15 åring
jobs.employer: MIO BPA AS AVD KONTOR KRISTIANSAND
jobs.description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Snarlig
📌 Stillingstype: Tilkalling

⏰ Arbeidstid: Natt og kveld

Lyst til å være fast ansatt i BPA -team til en sprudlende 15 åring?

Jeg er en positiv og glad ungdom/barn som bor sammen med mamma, pappa og to kosete katter. Jeg søker en fast ansatt som også må kunne jobbe ekstra i ferier. Det er viktig at du er komfortabel med mye fysisk trygghet, nærhet og kontakt. En av assistentene i teamet beskriver jobben som BPA slik: «Å være en del av BPA-teamet føles som å være hos sin egen familie - trygt, godt og fullt av latter hver eneste dag.»

Jeg elsker å bli lest for, høre på musikk og finne på ulike tøysete aktiviteter med assistentene. Jeg har litt tale og en digital snakkebok, men du trenger å bli kjent med meg for å forstå hva jeg ønsker å uttrykke. Siden jeg er alvorlig utviklingshemmet så trenger jeg at du er min støtte gjennom hverdagen i alle aktiviteter og gjøremål. Det er mye jeg klarer med din støtte og veiledning, og sammen med mine BPAer lærer jeg mer og mer.

Hva jobben innebærer:

• Være en støtte og trygghet gjennom dagen

• Bistå i hverdagen med personlig hygiene, påkledning og toalettbesøk

• Hente og levere på skolen

• Leke og være aktiv sammen med meg

• Passe på meg om kvelden når jeg sover

• Legge til rette for hvile og struktur i hverdagen

Vi ser etter deg som:

• Liker tull og tøys

• Er strukturert og ryddig – for det gir meg trygghet

• Erfaring fra helse, omsorg eller arbeid med barn er et pluss – men det aller viktigste er personlig egnethet og et varmt hjerte.

Stillingsstørrelse og arbeidstid:

Jeg søker etter fleksible tilkallingsvikarer som kan stille opp ved behov.

For meg er stabilitet og trygghet viktig, så jeg håper du ønsker å være en del av teamet mitt over tid - gjerne i flere år. Mamma og pappa vurderer søknader fortløpende og ansetter så snart de finner de rette personene.

Kvalifikasjoner:

• Førerkort klasse B. Det er en fordel om du har egen bil på grunn av begrenset kollektivtilbud, men det er ikke et krav

• Gode norskkunnskaper og norsk forståelse

• Plettfri vandel

• Du har et ønske og en motivasjon for å jobbe med barn

• Personlig egnethet og kjemi vektlegges

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Jenny Dolven på epost: jenny.dolven@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 225,40,-, kveldstillegg på 60,- og helgetillegg på 57,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

jobs.title: Sjuksköterska/Rehabsamordnare till Företagshälsa
jobs.description:
Med 1 000 experter på närmare 100 enheter över hela landet är Falck Sveriges mest kompletta leverantör av tjänster inom hälsa och arbetsliv. Vi erbjuder företagshälsovård, kris- och personalstöd, organisations- och ledarskapsutveckling, omställnings- och karriärtjänster samt primärvård och hälsotjänster för privatpersoner. Falcks tjänster inom hälsa och arbetsliv når 1,2 miljoner människor över hela Sverige och bidrar till ett hållbart arbetsliv och privatliv för alla.

Är du sjuksköterska med god erfarenhet och intresse av rehabilitering? Låter det spännande att jobba i en bred och varierad roll där en del av ditt jobb handlar om samordning i rehabärenden utan att släppa taget om sjuksköterskeuppgifter? Falck söker nu en ny stjärna till denna spännande kombinerade roll  på Falcks enheter i Halmstad/Varberg.

Som Företagssköterska/ Rehabsamordnare på Falck hälsa och arbetsliv kommer du att jobba nära erfarna och hjälpsamma kollegor som exempelvis företagsläkare, företagssköterskor, fysioterapeuter, psykologer mfl som jobbar samspelande med våra kunder och deras medarbetare med goda resultat. Våra kunder finns representerade från alla branscher, privat och offentlig sektor, stora och små verksamheter, vilket ger en intressant variation i ditt jobb och du kommer att möta en mängd olika kulturer och individer.

Du kommer bl.a. att arbeta med:

    Hälsoundersökningar, hälsorådgivning och individuella handlingsplaner
    Förebyggande och hälsofrämjande arbete
    Vaccinationer och provtagningar
    Missbrukshantering, Drogtestning
    Medicinsk rådgivning
    Koordinera och samverka med rehabiliteringsprocessens olika aktörer både externt och inom Falck
    Leda rehabmöten med kundteamet inom Falck samt hos kundföretagen för att säkerställa att processen går framåt
    Planering och samordning av rehabplaner som tas fram för att aktivt främja återgång i arbete
    Motiverande samtal och psykosocialt stöd till individer i deras rehabiliteringsprocess

Vi söker dig som;

    är minst legitimerad sjuksköterska, meriterande med utbildning till företagssköterska alt. distriktsköterska
    har goda IT-kunskaper och förmåga och intresse av att leverera i digitala verktyg
    behärskar svenska och engelska i tal och skrift

Meriterande:

    erfarenhet av rehabiliteringsfrågor i relation till arbetsgivarens arbetsmiljöansvar, gärna från företagshälsovården eller konsultbolag
    erfarenhet av projektledning/samordning ledning av arbete i team
    koordinatorutbildning tex KI:s koordineringsinsatser, att koordinera sjukskrivning och rehabiliteringsprocessen

För att trivas i rollen är du en självgående, strukturerad och målinriktad person som tar ett proaktivt ansvar för dina kunder. Du har en god kommunikativ förmåga, trivs med att samarbeta i team och kan anpassa dig när förutsättningarna ändras.

Du känner igen dig i våra Winning Behaviours: Vi bryr oss om, Vi bygger förtroende, Tillsammans skapar vi mer värde

Vi erbjuder dig:

    Kollektivavtal, bra marknadsmässiga förmåner
    Vara med och påverka i en av Sveriges framtidsbranscher i ett globalt bolag med muskler som fyller en viktig samhällsfunktion
    Självständigt arbete i en kompetent grupp med fantastiska kollegor
    Spännande arbetsplats med en enorm bredd av kompetens som borgar för ett kontinuerligt lärande i ett bolag under utveckling med interna möjligheter att växa
    Intressanta kunder, både inom privat och offentlig sektor och inom en gedigen bredd av branscher

Övrigt:

Tillsvidareanställning som inleds med 6 månaders provanställning. Tjänstgöringsgrad 100% och tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Arbetstid helgfria vardagar 8-17.

Tjänsten är placerad i Halmstad men kan innehålla resor till enheten i Varberg och till kunder i Halland efter verksamhetens behov, vilket innebär att du måste ha körkort och gärna tillgång till egen bil.

Är du intresserad?

Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta konsultchef Malin Löfström på mail malin.lofstrom@falcksverige.se. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail.

Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-08-31. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande så tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista datum för ansökan.

Vi undanber oss kontakt med annonserings- och rekryteringsföretag.

jobs.title: Vikarie till Domnarvets skola
jobs.description:
Domnarvets skola är en grundskola F-9 med knappt 630 elever. Vi arbetar framtidsinriktat med fokus på arbetslag med ansvar för årskursen och en flexibel syn på schema och förutsättningar för elevernas lärande.  

Hos oss är team-tanken bärande, där man är en del av en helhet och står tillsammans för lärande och utveckling. Pedagogisk mångfald med elevens eget lärande sätts i centrum.

Vi har nära till naturen och härliga miljöer som man med fördel kan använda sig av i sin undervisning. Vi arbetar också med ett gemensamt tydligt förhållningssätt kopplat till lektionsstruktur, vårt Grundläge, som bidrar både till förutsägbarhet och struktur samt trygghet och studiero.

Arbetsmiljön präglas av högt i tak, värme och glädje där relationerna är bärande, både i relation till elever, kollegor och ledning.

Hos oss arbetar vi tillsammans!

Vi behöver nu en egen vikarie som hjälper oss att lösa de vardagliga vikariebehoven på vår F-9 skola.

Självklart lockar vår värdegrund dig!

    • Jag finns här för Borlängebon
    • Jag gillar utmaningar
    • Jag möter varje människa med öppenhet

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Vi söker en vikarie till årskurs F-9 och fritidshemmet utifrån de vikariebehov vi har för dagen. När skolledning ser dagens frånvaro ges vikarieuppdraget och du kommer att täcka upp där behovet finns.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Som vikarie hos oss har du god erfarenhet av arbete med barn och ungdomar, gärna genom längre tids vikariat i grundskolan.

Du har fördjupade ämneskunskaper genom gymnasial utbildning. Vidareutbildning från högskola/Universitet är meriterande.

Vi hoppas att du nu känner att du vill komma till oss och arbeta tillsammans med lärare och elever och bidra till att Domnarvets skolas elever ska gå vidare i livet med en nyfiken inställning till fortsatt lärande.

Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet där kreativitet, nytänkande och flexibilitet är nyckelord.

Vi söker dig som är strukturerad, flexibel och positiv, med god samarbets- och kommunikationsförmåga. Du är lösningsfokuserad, initiativtagande och har lätt för att anpassa dig efter olika situationer.

Mycket bra muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i svenska.

Intervjuer kommer att ske löpande under ansökningsperioden. Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt!

Löneform: Månadslön.
Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.
Varaktighet: 6 månader eller längre, tillträde: Så snart som möjligt enligt överenskommelse, upphör: 2027-05-30  .
Arbetstid: Dagtid.

I samband med intervju behöver du som kandidat uppvisa bevis om medborgarskap i Sverige/EU/EES eller giltigt arbets- uppehållstillstånd.

För den som erbjuds anställning krävs enligt Lag om registerkontroll from 2001-01-01 utdrag ur Rikspolisstyrelsens belastningsregister.

För dig med skyddade personuppgifter erbjuder vi ett extra skyddat ansökningsförfarande. Kontakta rekryterande chef innan du skickar in din ansökan, så ser vi till att dina uppgifter hanteras på ett tryggt och korrekt sätt enligt gällande rutiner.

För att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen i Borlänge kommun samt möjliggöra god kommunikation med våra sökande ber vi dig skicka in din ansökan via länken digitalt och inte på annat sätt.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.description:
Vi söker just nu en ny medarbetare till vår kvinnliga uppdragsgivare i Jönköping. Känner du att egenskaperna stabil, trygg och lyhörd passar in på dig och vill du göra skillnad för en annan människa i vardagen? Tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Om tjänsten

Vår uppdragsgivare är en kvinna i 30-årsåldern som bor i egen lägenhet i Jönköping. På fritiden tycker hon om att bada, rida, åka på utflykter, titta på film och använda sin iPad. På grund av sina funktionsnedsättningar är hon i behov av assistans under dygnets alla timmar.

Arbetsuppgifterna varierar och kan innefatta personlig omvårdnad, stöd vid måltider, inköp, hushållssysslor samt assistans vid daglig verksamhet och andra aktiviteter. Din arbetsplats är där uppdragsgivaren befinner sig, och du blir hennes stöd i vardagens alla situationer.

Vad krävs av dig?

För att arbeta som personlig assistent hos vår uppdragsgivare behöver du vara lyhörd, stabil och lugn samt ha ett stort tålamod. Du har förmåga att ta initiativ och kan läsa av och förstå uppdragsgivarens behov. Flexibilitet och förmåga att ställa om dagens planering vid behov är också viktiga egenskaper.

Erfarenhet av arbete som personlig assistent eller liknande är meriterande men inget krav. Vi lägger störst vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper och att du kan skapa en god relation med uppdragsgivaren.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:

    Lågaffektivt bemötande
    Tydliggörande pedagogik
    Teckenkommunikation

För att vara aktuell för tjänsten krävs att du:

    Behärskar svenska i tal och skrift
    Är rökfri
    Inte har allergi mot pälsdjur eller klor
    Har körkort (automatkörkort är tillräckligt), då körning av uppdragsgivarens bil förekommer i tjänsten

Vad vi erbjuder

Vi erbjuder ett meningsfullt och varierat arbete med goda anställningsvillkor där du får möjlighet att göra skillnad varje dag. Vi satsar på kompetensutveckling och erbjuder flera utbildningar per år för att säkerställa hög kvalitet i den personliga assistansen.

Tjänsten innebär:

    Visstidsanställning på cirka 80 %
    Anställningsperiod: 6 månader
    Tillträde: 1 september
    Arbetstider dag, helg och dygnspass
    Pass kan förekomma kl. 08.15–16.00 samt dygnspass kl. 08.15–08.45
    Introduktion och bredvidgång med erfaren assistent

För frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta ansvarig arbetsledare Simon Lagärde: simon.lagarde@kooperativetolja.se

Skicka in din ansökan redan idag då urval och intervjuer sker löpande.

jobs.description:
ARBETSPLATS Individ- och familjeomsorgens vuxengrupp

Kom och arbeta med oss!

Vi söker ytterligare en medarbetare till individ- och familjeomsorgens vuxengrupp. Som

socialsekreterare i vuxengruppen kommer du ingå i en grupp om sju socialsekreterare, en

integrationshandläggare samt en enhetschef som ger stöd och handledning i det dagliga arbetet. Till individ- och familjeomsorgen hör även arbetsmarknadsenheten, en barn- och ungdomsgrupp samt öppenvård där arbetet sker i nära samarbete. Verksamheten har även flera handläggare som ger stort stöd med bl.a. administration och hantering av egna medel. Hos oss på vuxengruppen finns även Budgetskuldrådgivare. På arbetsplatsen finns en positiv teamkänsla där vi ställer upp och stöttar varandra i det dagliga arbetet.

Hos oss arbetar vi aktivt med kompetensförsörjning och erbjuder dig möjligheten att utvecklas i din yrkesroll. Vi tillämpar flexibel arbetstid för bättre möjlighet till balans mellan arbete och privatliv.

ARBETSUPPGIFTER OCH KVALIFIKATIONER

I vuxengruppen handlägger man främst ärenden gällande ekonomiskt bistånd,skadligt bruk och

beroende samt våld i nära relation. Du arbetar i nära samarbete med andra medarbetare inom individoch familjeomsorgen och tillsammans med externa myndigheter och aktörer.

Du har med fördel utbildning som socionom eller annan akademisk utbildning som bedöms som

likvärdig. Erfarenhet av arbetet är en viktig merit.

Du ska ha lätt att samarbeta och god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift. Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet. Du ska ha körkort med förarbehörighet B.

LÖN

Hagfors kommun tillämpar individuell lönesättning, ange löneanspråk.

FACKLIGA FÖRETRÄDARE

Företrädare för SSR och Vision når du genom Hagfors kommuns växel, 0563-185 00.

ÖVRIGT

Vi har gjort medieval för denna rekrytering och vi undanber oss därför kontakt med annonssäljare eller andra säljare av rekryteringstjänster.

Intervjuer sker löpande

Vårt handlingskraftiga näringsliv stärker kommunen och sätter Hagfors på kartan internationellt. Den lokala flygplatsen gör att det är nära till Stockholm och resten av världen, vilket skapar möjligheter i både jobbet och privatlivet.

Här hjälps vi åt att skapa ett rikt liv och tillsammans möjliggör vi en attraktiv kommun. Läs mer om arbetet i Hagforsstrategin.

Vid anställning kan utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister komma att begäras.

jobs.title: Product Owner Finance IT
jobs.description:
Do you thrive on driving digital transformation and shaping how finance works through technology? In this role, you’re at the center of strategic initiatives that turn business needs into scalable digital solutions for a global organization.



Why Sandvik?

Here, your work influences how finance IT supports decision-making and efficiency across our organization. You step into a role with real impact and broad stakeholder reach.

    Shape and lead digitalization initiatives within Finance IT
    Work cross-functionally with finance and IT teams in a global context
    Influence technology choices that support long-term scalability and value



About the job

As Product Owner for Finance IT, you lead the development and implementation of digital solutions for the finance organization. Acting as a strategic partner, you identify opportunities for digitalization, ensure integration of new technologies, and drive initiatives that improve efficiency and scalability across finance processes.



Job responsibilities

    Drive digital initiatives from concept to execution using agile ways of working
    Collaborate with finance and IT stakeholders to align solutions with business goals
    Lead change management and support adoption of new digital tools
    Monitor outcomes and report progress to senior stakeholders
    Ensure solutions meet quality standards and stay within agreed scope



You join our IT for Group Functions team, responsible for driving IT and digitalization for Sandvik’s corporate functions such as HR, Communication, Legal, and Finance. We manage application portfolios, lead digital transformation, and support our group functions in shaping their roadmaps.  



Location  

The position is based in Stockholm or Sandviken.



Your profile

You bring a strong foundation in IT and digital technologies and enjoy working where business and technology meet. With experience from large organizations, you’re comfortable leading complex transformation initiatives and navigating multiple stakeholders.



Your background includes

    Experience driving digital transformation within Finance IT
    Strong understanding of finance-related processes and systems
    Experience with ERP solutions, including SAP
    Knowledge of digital technologies such as cloud, data analytics, AI/ML or IoT
    A relevant academic degree in IT, engineering, computer science, or similar



You’re collaborative and communicative, with the ability to translate complex topics into clear direction. A solution-oriented mindset helps you focus on business value, while your leadership style builds trust and engagement across teams.



Our culture

At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences.  



Contact information

For further information about this position, please contact Thomas Bergman, hiring manager, thomas.bergman@sandvik.com.



Union contacts – Sweden

    Malena Rackner, Unionen, +46 (0)70 242 33 90
    Tord Engström, Akademikerföreningen, +46 (0)76 106 62 87
    Peter Olsson-Andrée, Ledarna, +46 (0)70 222 48 55



Recruitment Specialist: Lisbeth Häggström



How to apply

Send your application no later than August 23, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0092514.



We aim for an open and fair recruitment process and use different tools to ensure an objective assessment. Later in the process, you may be invited to complete a personality and logic test.



To learn more about our recruitment process, please visit our career site or contact HR Services at hrservices.sweden@sandvik.com.

ALHomecare is a specialist healthcare recruitment agency based in Ireland. We pride ourselves on the support we provide to our senior clients and to the carers we place in their homes. We are currently recruiting for the position of live-in Care Assistant in locations all across Ireland. Candidates must be enthusiastic and empathetic, wanting to make a real difference to people's lives, in return ALHomecare offers excellent working conditions as well as free ongoing training and support. Job requirements: Minimum one-year experience with the elderly (either with your family or/and professional carer experience). Clear verbal communication skills. Good command of the English language. Patience and the ability to remain calm in stressful situations. A desire to help people. Sensitivity and understanding. Willing to engage in continuous learning. Advantage to have a driver's licence, but not essential. Your duties will include: House-keeping, meal preparation, companionship, personal care, basic exercises/walks with your client, medication supervision etc. We offer: Full-time contract minimum 35 hours work per week. Possibility of overtime and other additional payments (e.g. couple care). Paid holidays (minimum four weeks a year). Double pay or an extra day off for statutory/bank holidays. Full support throughout recruitment and employment. Free accommodation and food provided. No need to commute to work every day. Plenty of free time to enjoy Ireland. Applicants must be willing to undergo Garda vetting processes. Applicants must be legally entitled to work within Ireland and the EU. Please send your CV to hr@alhomecare.ie Important Note: Our phone lines are very busy, so please send your CV by email rather than phone our number. Thank you.

jobs.title: Ønsker du en givende helgestilling? Voksen dame søker etter dyktige og engasjerte assistenter!
jobs.description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Snarest
📌 Stillingstype: Fast
⏰ Arbeidstid: Helg


Hei!

Jeg er en voksen kvinne på 58 år med diagnosen MS, multippel sklerose. Jeg sitter i rullestol og er nå på utkikk etter 2 nye fast assistenter. Jeg bor i Ås sentrum, kun 5 minutters gange fra Ås stasjon. Jeg er en engasjert, sosial og utadvendt dame som er glad i gode samtaler. Jeg jobber i halv stilling som avdelingsarkitekt i Ås kommune. På fritiden er jeg glad i kunst-, arkitektur- og kulturopplevelser som teater, kinobesøk samt ulike reiser. Dette være seg Ski- og Osloturer med kafe-, konsert- og galleribesøk som er spesielt hyggelig å kunne oppleve sammen med en assistent når det lar seg gjøre.

Jeg ser nå etter assistenter som blant annet kan hjelpe meg opp og i gang med dagen inkludert tilbereding av enkel frokost. I tillegg har jeg behov for assistanse til trening. Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper jeg at du søker.

Stillingsstørrelse og arbeidstider:

Jeg søker nå etter 2 faste assistenter som kan jobbe annenhver helg - lørdag og søndag kl.09-12. Det er en stor fordel at du kan være fleksibel i forhold til arbeidstid, samt stille opp for ekstra vakter ved behov, i ferier og ved sykdom.

Vi vurderer aktuelle kandidater fortløpende og ansetter så snart vi finner den rette personen.

Oppstart for den faste stillingen vil være omgående, men spesifiser gjerne i din søknad når du eventuelt har anledning til å starte.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Matlaging og annet forefallende husarbeid

  • Hjelpe til trening i stå-stativ og ergometersykkel

  • Noe hjelp til personlig hygiene og pleie

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Personlig egnethet og kjemi vektlegges

  • Gode norskkunnskaper (minimum B1)

  • Plettfri politiattest

  • Førerkort klasse B manuell (fordel, ikke et krav)

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Ryddig og strukturert

  • Utadvendt

  • Selvdreven

  • Initiativrik

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Hanna Brurås på epost: hanna.bruras@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

jobs.title: Helsefagarbeider i turnus – bli en del av laget på Hosle!
jobs.employer: BÆRUM KOMMUNE HJEMMEBASE TJENESTER ØSTERÅS DISTRIKT AVD ØVREVOLL
jobs.description:
Er du helsefagarbeider og ønsker en jobb der du blir sett, verdsatt og får utvikle deg faglig? Da håper vi du leser videre.

Hos oss møter du en humørfylt, engasjert og faglig sterk gjeng. Vi tror at godt humør, samarbeid og faglig stolthet skaper de beste tjenestene – både for pasientene våre og for oss som jobber her. Her er det rom for både latter og alvor når det trengs, og vi stiller alltid opp for hverandre.

Vi søker nå en helsefagarbeider som ønsker en meningsfull og variert arbeidshverdag. Enten du er nyutdannet og ønsker en trygg start på yrkeslivet, eller har flere års erfaring, vil du bli en viktig del av laget vårt.

I hjemmebaserte tjenester møter vi pasientene i deres eget hjem. Det gir oss en unik mulighet til å se hele mennesket, bygge tillitsfulle relasjoner og bidra til at flere kan bo trygt hjemme så lenge som mulig. Arbeidshverdagen er variert, selvstendig og faglig utfordrende. Samtidig står du aldri alene – hos oss er det alltid en kollega som spør: «Hva tenker du?» eller sier: «Jeg blir med deg.»

Hos oss får du en sentral rolle i den daglige oppfølgingen av pasientene våre. Arbeidsoppgavene omfatter blant annet personlig stell og pleie, observasjoner, ernæring, mobilisering, dokumentasjon og legemiddelhåndtering etter gjeldende kompetansekrav. Etter nødvendig opplæring og vurdert kompetanse vil du også få utføre flere faglige prosedyrer, noe som gir gode muligheter for faglig utvikling og mestring. Du vil møte mennesker med ulike diagnoser og behov, blant annet personer med demens og kognitiv svikt. Derfor ser vi etter deg som møter mennesker med respekt, trygghet og omsorg.

På avdeling Hosle er vi stolte av samholdet vårt. Vi heier på hverandre, deler kunnskap og vet at ingen kan alt alene. Vi investerer i hverandre fordi vi vet at et godt arbeidsmiljø gir bedre tjenester for pasientene våre.

Hos oss får du mulighet til å utvikle deg gjennom ukentlig internundervisning, faglig veiledning og tett samarbeid med sykepleiere, HUK-sykepleiere, kreftsykepleiere, fastleger og andre samarbeidspartnere. Vi tar også i bruk moderne velferdsteknologi der det skaper verdi, blant annet elektroniske dørlåser, medisindispensere og digital sårbehandling.

Stillingen har todelt turnus med arbeid hver tredje helg etter kalenderplan.

Arbeidsstedet ligger sentralt til, rett ved Østerås T-banestasjon, og vi har gode parkeringsmuligheter.

Vi vet at du har mange arbeidsplasser å velge mellom. Derfor håper vi du velger en arbeidsplass der du blir sett, får utvikle deg faglig, kan være deg selv og kjenner at du gjør en forskjell – hver eneste dag.

Vi gleder oss til å bli kjent med deg og ønsker deg hjertelig velkommen til avdeling Hosle!


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Utføre faglige prosedyrer etter opplæring
  • Bistå hjemmeboende pasienter med grunnleggende behov og behandling
  • Administrere medisiner
  • Dokumentere i pasientjournal
  • Hjelpe pasienten til å mestre eget liv
  • Veilede og følge opp lærlinger og studenter
  • Jobbe med velferdsteknologi ute i brukers hjem
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Utdannet helsefagarbeider med norsk autorisasjon. HPR-nummer registreres i CV
  • Du er fortrolig med bruk av relevante IT-verktøy
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Kjennskap til relevant lovverk for tjenesteområdet
  • For stillingen kreves gode norskkunnskaper. Søkere fra land utenfor Skandinavia skal som et minimum ha bestått norskprøve B2 skriftlig og muntlig
  • Det er ønskelig med relevant erfaring
Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter deg som

  • er selvstendig og løsningsorientert
  • er pliktoppfyllende og fleksibel
  • har gode kommunikasjonsevner
  • har faglig innsikt
  • har god arbeidskapasitet
  • har godt humør og som bidrar positivt inn i arbeidsmiljøet

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt

Vi tilbyr
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Kalenderplan
  • En variert arbeidsdag med spennende og faglige utfordringer
  • Individuelt tilpasset opplæringsplan
  • Offentlig tjenestepensjon
  • Mulighet for kompetanseutviklingsstipend

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sammen skaper vi et godt og inkluderende samfunn for over 130 000 innbyggere, både i dag og i årene som kommer. Vi skaper rammer som bidrar til at de aller minste kan leke og lære og at de som trenger en hjelpende hånd får en hverdag preget av mestring, mening og verdighet. Vi gjør et bredt spekter av arbeidsoppgaver, og felles for oss alle er at vi får tillit og myndighet til å påvirke vår egen arbeidshverdag for å skape et samfunn som er godt å leve i. Hos oss kan du bli med og sette spor.

Begrunnelsen vil bli vurdert i forhold til offentlighetsloven § 25, jfr §11. Hvis ditt ønske ikke imøtekommes, vil du få mulighet til å trekke søknaden før offentliggjøring.

jobs.title: Ingénieur DevOps   (H/F)
jobs.description:
Dans le cadre de l'automatisation de l'intégration et du déploiement des applications informatiques de nos clients, tu seras en charge de :
- Construire, maintenir en conditions opérationnelles et améliorer les différentes plateformes d'intégration et déploiement continu
- Définir les processus de déploiements
- Déployer des releases applicatives sur les environnements de test et de production
- Assurer la disponibilité des applications au quotidien.
- Analyser l'infrastructure et le fonctionnement (monitoring, optimisation de la performance, etc)
- Investiguer et corriger les anomalies et faits techniques
- Intégrer, maintenir, administrer et documenter les outils de déploiement, automatiser les tâches courantes
- Administrer le traitement des tickets d'incidents
- Appliquer les changements validés sur les environnements Linux, Oracle
- Intégrer et valider les patchs ou les correctifs fournis par l'équipe de réalisation.
- Accompagnement des équipes de développement et opérationnelles vers la méthodologie DEVOPS
Compétences requises ou à acquérir
- Tu as développé des compétences polyvalentes dans les domaines de l'administration Linux et des connaissances sur les outils CI/CD couramment utilisés
- La démarche DevOps n'a plus de secret pour toi
- Tu maîtrises les sujets suivants : administration d'outils d'intégration continue comme Jenkins ou Gitlab-CI, Nexus/Artifactory, Sonarqube etc
- Des technologies autour des conteneurs, Docker, Kubernetes, Rancher, Openshift/okd
- Des providers Cloud, AWS, Azure, GCP
- Anglais TB niveau

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Human-Centered Interactive AI Agents for Maritime Simulator Training
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0About the position

The maritime industry faces increasing demands for safe and efficient operations due to growing traffic, more complex vessels, and higher safety requirements. Simulator-based training is essential for preparing maritime professionals, but it relies heavily on experienced human instructors, whose availability is limited.

Recent advances in artificial intelligence, especially large language models (LLMs), enable the development of interactive AI agents that can support human learning in complex, safety-critical environments. Human-centered AI in this project means that the agent will learn from simulator data and expert knowledge, and will be designed to work collaboratively with trainees and instructors rather than replacing them. The AI agents will leverage LLMs for knowledge acquisition, natural language interaction, and decision support, while integrating simulator data and multimodal inputs to provide timely guidance, feedback, and post-training analysis.

This PhD project aims to develop human-centered interactive AI agents for maritime simulator training. The research will investigate how LLM-driven agents can perceive and interpret dynamic maritime environments, collaborate with human trainees during simulator sessions, provide transparent explanations for their actions, and adapt their support to individual training needs

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Set up research plans with the help of the supervision team and conduct them accordingly
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Take lead in research idea generation and research paper writing
  • Collaborate closely with other PhD candidates and project partners to share knowledge, integrate findings, and coordinate research activities
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in computer science, automation, maritime-related engineering or equivalent. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at master's level. Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position.
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you maybe considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme in Engineering

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions and Regulations for the degrees philosophiae doctor (ph.d.) and philosophiae doctor (ph.d.) in artistic development work at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • You demonstrate a strong motivation for the position
  • You have experience of LLM and and related applications, preferably in maritime-relevant projects
  • You demonstrate knowledge/experience in AI and data-driven approaches

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently as well as in a cross disciplinary team
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback 
  • Show enthusiasm and a strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • Communicate well in English

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. (delete if not applicable)


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 550 800,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Houxiang Zhang, email: hozh@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact PhD Coordinator Lara Bromann, e-mail: lara.bromann@ntnu.no

Application deadline: 20.09.2026

Job description:  At Volvo Group, our Cyber Defense Center (CDC) brings together the people, processes, and capabilities needed to protect our business and strengthen resilience in an increasingly digital world.  

This is an opportunity to lead one of the CDC's core operational capabilities, working alongside experienced cybersecurity professionals dedicated to detecting, responding to, and mitigating cyber threats that could impact our global operations.



The Head of the Cybersecurity Operations Center (CSOC) is a strategic and technical leader responsible for overseeing the operations, direction, and continuous improvement of the organization’s global Cybersecurity Operations Center. This role is responsible for ensuring the organization’s cyber defense capabilities remain cutting-edge, resilient, and responsive to emerging threats. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in cybersecurity, incident response, threat intelligence, and operational leadership.







What you will do



Strategic Leadership & CSOC Management:•    Develop and execute the CSOC strategy, ensuring alignment with overall cybersecurity and business objectives.•    Oversee and manage CSOC operations, including incident response, threat intelligence, and proactive monitoring.•    Define and refine security monitoring, threat detection, and response strategies to address evolving cyber threats.•    Continuously assess and improve CSOC processes, tools, and methodologies to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.•    Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing CSOC team, ensuring continuous skills development and knowledge sharing.•    Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to measure CSOC effectiveness and drive operational improvements.



Incident Response & Threat Management:•    Serve as the primary escalation point for major security incidents, overseeing coordination, investigation, containment, and remediation efforts.•    Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners to ensure swift and effective response to cybersecurity threats.•    Guide post-incident analysis and forensic investigations, ensuring lessons learned are integrated into future strategies.•    Maintain and enforce incident response procedures, ensuring adherence to regulatory and industry best practices.

      

Threat Intelligence & Emerging Threats:




    Stay ahead of evolving cyber threats, attack techniques, and emerging security trends.
    Leverage threat intelligence sources to enhance detection capabilities and proactively mitigate risks.
    Work with industry groups, government agencies, and vendors to strengthen the Volvo Group’s cyber defense posture.
    Ensure alignment with frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, and the Cyber Kill Chain to improve threat detection and response.



Collaboration & Compliance:




    Partner with IT, cybersecurity architecture, and compliance teams to ensure CSOC capabilities align with enterprise cybersecurity needs.
    Ensure CSOC operations comply with industry regulations, standards, and best practices (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR).
    Communicate cybersecurity risks and CSOC performance to executive leadership, providing insights and recommendations.
    Develop strong relationships with third-party vendors, service providers, and law enforcement as needed.







Who are you?







Do you dream big? We do too, and we are excited to grow together. In this role, you will bring:








    Education & Experience


    Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).
    Experience: Minimum 7+ years of cybersecurity experience, with at least 4+ years in a SOC leadership role.
    Certifications: Preferred certifications include CISSP, CISM, CISA, GIAC (GCIA, GCIH, GSEC), or equivalent.






      
    Technical Expertise


    Extensive experience in security operations, incident response, digital forensics, and threat intelligence.
    Strong knowledge of SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, SOAR, and other security monitoring technologies.
    Deep understanding of cybersecurity frameworks, regulations, and best practices.
    Familiarity with scripting and automation (Python, PowerShell, etc.) to optimize SOC workflows.

  

      

Preferred Qualifications: •    Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and develop a high-performing SOC team.•    Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making capabilities.•    Ability to communicate complex cybersecurity issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.•    Experience working in a global enterprise environment, managing security operations across multiple regions.•    A forward-thinking mindset with the ability to anticipate and proactively address security challenges.
