jobs.title: Senior Automation Manager, Nørresundby, Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you our new Automation Manager with a passion for technology, leadership, and scalable automation solutions?

At DESMI, you will play a key role in strengthening and scaling our automation capabilities across the organization. You will be part of product development & innovation leading a skilled engineering team in Denmark and China to develop reliable and future-proof automation solutions for both products and customized needs.
Working closely with Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, you will ensure strong alignment between technical solutions and business requirements. You will be responsible for setting direction, creating structure across projects, and ensuring high quality delivery of automation solutions across DESMI's global operations.
DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where collaboration, continuous learning, and professional development are at the core of our culture. In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence the direction of our automation landscape, develop your team, and contribute to building scalable and efficient solutions that support our continued growth.

Ideally, we are looking for someone who is:
Technically grounded
Possess strong leadership and people management skills
Structured and organized

A glimpse into the role
You will lead a team of automation engineers while ensuring that our solutions are robust and aligned with business needs. Your primary responsibilities will include:
-Team Leadership & Development: Lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing automation team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
-Project Execution & Prioritization: Plan, structure, and drive execution across multiple automation projects, ensuring clear priorities, efficient resource allocation, and on-time delivery.
-Technical Direction & Quality Assurance: Set the technical direction for automation solutions across hardware and software, ensuring reliable, serviceable, and future-proof designs.
-Operational Ownership of Automation Solutions: Oversee the development and maintenance of automation systems, translating business and product requirements into standardized, scalable technical solutions.
-Stakeholder Management: Act as the key point of contact for stakeholders across Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, ensuring alignment and clear communication on scope, expectations, and deliverables.
-Process & Solution Optimization: Drive structured and transparent workflows across projects, continuously improving processes and enabling efficient and consistent delivery of automation solutions.
-Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Support the ongoing development of DESMI's automation portfolio by promoting a solution-oriented mindset and identifying opportunities for innovation and standardization.

Your next opportunity starts here
We're looking for an experienced and driven leader with a strong technical foundation in automation and a passion for developing both people and solutions. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

We also imagine that you:
Have minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
Bring a strong technical background within automation, electrical engineering, or a similar field, combined with hands-on experience in both hardware and software design
Are structured and capable of creating clarity and overview in complex project environments with multiple ongoing activities
Have strong planning and resource management skills, enabling you to prioritize effectively and ensure successful project execution
Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders across functions and organizational levels
Take a solution-oriented approach and are comfortable setting direction while supporting your team in delivering robust and scalable solutions
Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success
Are fluent in English, as it is DESMI's corporate language

The perks of being at DESMI
Flexible working hours - including possibilities for remote work.
Global career prospects - work with colleagues across Europe, Asia, and the U.S.
Skills development and career growth - Training, job rotation, and internal mobility
Pension - attractive employer contributions
Private healthcare and life insurance
On-site canteen - light breakfast, lunch buffet, and snacks
Company sports & social activities - from badminton and bowling to art clubs and summer parties

What we're about
But we're more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.
When you join DESMI, you can expect:
A collaborative and supportive team environment.
Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
A company that values sustainability and innovation.

We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive - if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.

jobs.title: Kokki, Rosso Porvoo / Kock, Rosso Borgå
jobs.description:
Primary location:
PORVOO

KOKKI PORVOON ROSSOON, 30 H/ VK, VAKITUINEN TYÖSUHDE

Etsimme kokkia Porvoon Rossoon vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Rosson monipuoliselta ruokalistalta löytyy herkullisia á la carte -annoksia, pastaruokia sekä suosittuja pizzoja, joten toivomme sinulla olevan jo kokemusta näiden valmistuksesta. Lisäksi työpäivään kuuluu esivalmisteluja, astiahuoltoa sekä varastojen hallintaa. Tehtävä sopii henkilölle, joka viihtyy vauhdikkaassa ympäristössä ja on halukas työskentelemään silloin kuin meillä parhaiten viihdytään, eli iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin.

Työskentelet pääasiassa Porvoon Rossossa, mutta pääset tarvittaessa tekemään vuoroja myös Porvoon Amarillossa. Amarillon monipuoliselta ruokalistalta löytyy herkullisia meksikolaisia annoksia, kuten tacoja ja burritoja sekä meheviä hampurilaisia.

Tervetuloa ihan tavallisiin töihin - harvinaisen maukkaiden tehtävien pariin.Tavallisuus ei toki tarkoita, että meillä olisi täällä jotenkin tylsää tai tylsää porukkaa töissä-päinvastoin!

Mitä toivomme sinulta?
- Kohtaat sekä asiakkaat että työkaverit sydän kohdallaan <3
- Kokemusta kokin työstä sekä à la carte -annosten ja pizzojen valmistuksesta.
- Reipasta ja oma-aloitteista työotetta: osaat tarttua tehtäviin ja pidät huolta työpisteestäsi.
- Työssä kävellään ja kannetaan paljon, joten hyvä fyysinen kunto on eduksi.
- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä osana tiimiä.
- Suomen kielen taitoa, sillä työskentelemme suomeksi.

Mitä ihan tavallinen työ meillä tarkoittaa?
- Työpaikan, johon kiva tulla ja myös kiva lähteä kotiin.
- Tiimiä, jossakaveria ei jätetäja jossa esihenkilöt ovat mukana arjen tekemisessä.
- Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista eli esimerkiksi ruoasta, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja monesta muusta mukavasta asiasta.
- MaRa:ntyöehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkausta, joka on kokemusvuosista riippuen 13,32 €/h - 14,62 €/h + työaikalisät
- 5 % kielilisä, jos asiakaspalvelu onnistuu vähintään suomeksi ja ruotsiksi.
- Koko henkilökunnan yhteistä tulospalkkiota, jopa 1,70 € / tehty työtunti yrityksentuloksen ja toimialakohtaisten mittarienperusteella.
- Kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi- ja liikuntaetuja.

Jätä siis hakemuksesi, jos tykkäät ihan tavallisesta arjesta, vauhdikkaasta tekemisestä, hyvästä ruoasta ja poikkeuksellisen hyvistä työkavereista.

Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään tiistaina 18.8.2026. Lisätietoja tehtävästä saat sähköpostitse osoitteesta vbo.rekry@sok.fi. Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

***

KOCK TILL ROSSO I BORGÅ, 30 H/VECKA, FAST ANSTÄLLNING

Vi söker en kock till Rosso i Borgå för en fast anställning. På Rossos mångsidiga meny hittar du läckra á la carte-rätter, pastarätter och populära pizzor, så vi önskar att du redan har erfarenhet av att tillreda dessa. Dessutom hör förberedelser, diskunderhåll och lagerhantering till din arbetsdag. Jobbet passar dig som trivs i en fartfylld miljö och vill arbeta när vi har som mest liv och rörelse, alltså kvällar och helger.

Du arbetar huvudsakligen på Rosso i Borgå, men vid behov kan du också ta arbetspass på Amarillo i Borgå. På Amarillos mångsidiga meny finns läckra mexikanska rätter såsom tacos och burritos samt saftiga hamburgare.

Välkommen till ett helt vanligt jobb - med ovanligt välsmakande uppgifter.Vanlighet betyder förstås inte att vi skulle ha det tråkigt eller att vi skulle vara ett tråkigt gäng - tvärtom!

Vad önskar vi av dig?
- Du möter både kunder och kollegor med hjärtat på rätt ställe. <3
- Erfarenhet av arbete som kock och tillredning av á la carte-rätter och pizza
- Du har ett raskt och självgående arbetssätt: du tar tag i uppgifter och håller ordning på din arbetsstation.
Arbetet innebär mycket gående och bärande, så god fysisk kondition är en fördel.
- Du har vilja att lära dig nytt och utvecklas som en del av teamet.
- Kunskaper i finska, eftersom finska är vårt arbetsspråk.

Vad innebär ett helt vanligt jobb hos oss?
- Ett jobb som får dig på gott humör både före och efter arbetsdagen.
- Ett team där man inte lämnar kollegorna i sticket och där cheferna jobbar sida vid sida med teamet.
- Personalrabatt på S-gruppens produkter och tjänster, till exempel på mat, dryck, elektronik, restauranger, hotell och mycket annat trevligt.
- Lön i enlighet med kollektivavtalet för restaurangtjänster, vilket betyder mellan 13,32 och 14,62 euro/timme + arbetstidstillägg.
- Ett språktillägg på 5 procent om du kan betjäna kunder på åtminstone finska och svenska.
- En gemensam resultatpremie för hela personalen, upp till 1,70 € per arbetad timme beroende på företagets resultat och branschspecifika mätare.
- Kultur-, välbefinnande- och motionsförmån.

Så lämna in din ansökan om du gillar en vanlig vardag, fartfyllt arbete, god mat och exceptionellt trevliga kollegor.

Vi går vidare med rekryteringen redan under ansökningstiden, så skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, men senast tisdagen den 18.8.2026. Mer information om uppgiften får du per e-post på adressen vbo.rekry@sok.fi. Anställningen börjar enligt avtal.

jobs.title: Dygtig freelance mødebooker
jobs.description:
Freelance mødebooker søges til B2B-mødebooking

Har du solid erfaring med mødebooking og kold kanvas – og motiveres du af frihed, ansvar og resultater?

Hjælp til salg søger en dygtig og stabil freelance mødebooker til booking af kvalificerede B2B-møder for vores kunder.

Stillingen er for dig, der allerede ved, hvad der skal til for at komme igennem til den rette beslutningstager, skabe en god dialog og booke et relevant møde.

Arbejdet udføres hjemmefra, og du kan derfor befinde dig hvor som helst i Danmark eller resten af verden.

Om arbejdet

Du kommer til at arbejde med udgående telefonisk mødebooking for forskellige danske B2B-virksomheder.

Opgaverne vil typisk bestå af:

  • Telefonisk kontakt til potentielle erhvervskunder

  • Kold kanvas og dialog med relevante beslutningstagere

  • Præsentation af kundens løsning på en professionel og troværdig måde

  • Booking af kvalificerede møder

  • Løbende opfølgning og registrering af aktiviteter

  • Tæt dialog med Hjælp til salg omkring kvalitet, resultater og kundernes ønsker

Vi leder efter dig, der

  • Har dokumenteret erfaring med B2B-mødebooking, telefonsalg eller kold kanvas

  • Har eget CVR-nummer og arbejder som selvstændig freelancer

  • Er stabil, selvkørende og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Kan arbejde struktureret og følge op på dine leads

  • Er god til at skabe tillid og føre en naturlig samtale

  • Taler og forstår dansk

  • Har en professionel telefonstemme og en god forretningsforståelse

  • Kan håndtere afvisninger uden at miste motivationen

  • Har de nødvendige rammer til at arbejde hjemmefra, herunder en stabil internetforbindelse og rolige omgivelser

Erfaring er et krav

Dette er ikke en oplæringsstilling.

Det er et krav, at du allerede har praktisk erfaring med mødebooking, kold kanvas eller opsøgende B2B-telefonsalg. Har du ikke denne erfaring, er stillingen desværre ikke det rette match.

Vi forventer ikke, at du kender alle vores kunder eller brancher på forhånd. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du kender håndværket, kan sætte dig ind i nye løsninger og hurtigt omsætte et manuskript til en troværdig samtale.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fleksibelt freelancearbejde hjemmefra

  • Mulighed for at arbejde fra hele verden

  • Aflønning pr. godkendt og kvalificeret møde

  • Forskellige B2B-kunder og brancher

  • Grundig introduktion til den enkelte kunde og opgave

  • Sparring, feedback og løbende dialog

  • Mulighed for et længerevarende samarbejde for den rette person

  • Frihed under ansvar og mulighed for selv at strukturere din arbejdsdag

Aflønning

Du aflønnes pr. booket møde, der lever op til den enkelte kundes aftalte kriterier.

Den konkrete pris pr. møde afhænger af opgaven og aftales inden opstart. Som freelancer fakturerer du Hjælp til salg fra dit eget CVR-nummer.

Om Hjælp til salg

Hjælp til salg har siden 2017 hjulpet danske virksomheder med professionel B2B-mødebooking.

Vi har fokus på møder med kvalitet. Derfor handler arbejdet ikke blot om at få en aftale i kalenderen, men om at booke relevante møder med de rette beslutningstagere og skabe et godt grundlag for kundens videre salgsdialog.

Vi lægger stor vægt på kvalitet, ærlighed, stabilitet og et professionelt samarbejde.

Sådan søger du

Send en kort ansøgning, hvor du beskriver:

  • Din erfaring med mødebooking og kold kanvas

  • Hvilke typer virksomheder eller brancher du tidligere har arbejdet med

  • Hvilke resultater du tidligere har skabt

  • Hvor mange timer du forventer at kunne arbejde om ugen

  • Hvornår du kan starte

  • Bekræftelse på, at du har eget CVR-nummer

Vedlæg gerne dit CV eller et link til din LinkedIn-profil.

Vi kontakter kun ansøgere, der har relevant erfaring og matcher kravene til stillingen.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Hjælp til salg
Møder med kvalitet

jobs.description:
Haemme Keski-Suomen hyvinvointialueen henkilökohtaisen avun keskuksen kautta avustajaa liikuntavammaiselle 16-vuotiaalle tytölle toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen Jyväskylän Palokkaan.

Avustettava istuu pyörätuolissa ja tarvitsee apua arjen toiminnoissa. Avustettava on luonteeltaan kiltti, iloinen ja tulee toimeen kaikkien kanssa.

Työ tapahtuu pääsääntöisesti avustettavan kotona, harrastuksissa tai vapaa-ajalla.

Työtehtävät sisältävät hoitotoimenpiteitä (mm. letkuruokintaa), pukeutumisessa ja ruokailussa avustamista, ostoksilla, elokuvissa ja ulkoilemassa avustamista. Työ sisältää nostoja ja siirtoja, joten hyvä fyysinen kunto on työssä eduksi.

Työtä tarjolla 0–30 h/kk, työvuorot pääsääntöisesti arki-iltaisin sekä viikonloppuisin päiväaikaan.

Palkkaus: Heta TES C + mahdolliset lisät.

Työ alkaa 1.9.2026.

Kyseisessä työssä työkokemus/ sopiva koulutus on eduksi , samoin eri kuntoutusalojen koulutus/ työkokemus sekä viittomien tuntemus. Työ sopii hyvin myös alasta kiinnostuneelle opiskelijalle tai osa-aikatyötä tekevälle. Työhön perehdytetään.

Tehtävä edellyttää hyvää suomen kielen taitoa ja täysi-ikäisyyttä. Avustajan toivotaan olevan avoin, positiivinen, oma-aloitteinen ja huumorintajuinen.

Työnantajalla on velvollisuus pyytää työhön valitun työntekijän rikosrekisteriote nähtäväksi, kun avustajan työtehtävään kuuluu alle 18-vuotiaiden lasten kanssa työskentely tilanteissa, joissa lapsen huoltaja ei ole läsnä (Laki lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä 504/2002).

Työnantajalla on oikeus pyytää iäkkäiden ja vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työhön valitulta työntekijältä rikosrekisteriote nähtäväksi kerran työsuhteen alkaessa (Laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta 741/2023, 28 §).

Rikosrekisteriote on salassa pidettävää tietoa ja sitä ei tule lähettää hakemuksen yhteydessä.

Hae paikkaa tai kysy lisätietoja ottamalla yhteyttä avustettavan äitiin p. 0407276382 tai sähköpostitse jenni.e.tuuli@gmail.com.

jobs.title: CNC-SORVAAJA Iisalmeen/CNC LATHE OPERATOR to Iisalmi
jobs.description:
CNC-SORVAAJA Iisalmeen (job description in English below)

Etsimme asiakkaallemme Iisalmeen ammattitaitoista CNC-sorvaajaa työskentelemään monipuolisessa konepajaympäristössä yksittäiskappaleiden ja pienten valmistussarjojen parissa.

Käytettävät koneet

Tehtävässä voit työskennellä kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi mukaan yhdellä tai useammalla seuraavista CNC-koneista:

* Okuma Multus B750, OSP3000-ohjaus
* MoriSeiki SL35MC / SL253 / SL150, Fanuc-ohjaus

Mainitsethan hakemuksessasi, minkä koneiden ja ohjausjärjestelmien kanssa sinulla on kokemusta.

Työtehtävät

* CNC-sorvien käyttö ja asetusten tekeminen
* Ohjelmien laatiminen, muokkaaminen ja koneistusprosessien kehittäminen
* Työpiirustusten mukaisten kappaleiden valmistus
* Valmistettujen tuotteiden laadun varmistaminen
* Yhteistyö muun tuotantotiimin kanssa

Odotamme sinulta

* Soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta (esim. kone-, tuotanto- tai metalliala)
* Käytännön kokemusta CNC-sorvauksesta
* Kykyä lukea ja tulkita teknisiä piirustuksia itsenäisesti
* Kokemusta koneiden asetuksista, ohjelmoinnista ja mittauksista
* Fanuc-ohjausten tuntemus katsotaan eduksi
* Huolellista, oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista työskentelytapaa
* Hyviä yhteistyö- ja kommunikointitaitoja
* Riittävää englannin tai suomen kielen taitoa työtehtävien hoitamiseen

Tarjoamme

* Vakituisen kokoaikatyön (40 h/vko)
* Työsuhteen Suomen työehtojen ja teknologiateollisuuden TES:n mukaisesti
* Palkan alkaen 14,87 €/h (+ TES:n mukaiset lisät)
* Apua majoitusjärjestelyihin
* Monipuolisen ja hyvin varustellun konepajan Iisalmessa
* Osaavan työyhteisön, jossa arvostetaan ammattitaitoa ja työn laatua

Kiinnostuitko?

Täytä hakemus ilmoituksessa olevan linkin kautta ja liitä mukaan CV.

Työtä koskevissa kysymyksissä pyydämme ensisijaisesti ottamaan yhteyttä sähköpostitse: sanna.rinkinen@vps.fi
Puh. +358 50 462 3615

Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia.

Jos olet jo aiemmin täyttänyt VPS:n sähköisen hakemuslomakkeen, kirjaudu omilla tunnuksillasi ja liitä hakemuksesi tähän työpaikkailmoitukseen.

VPS Henkilöstöpalvelu kuuluu VPS Yhtiöihin ja on vuonna 1987 perustettu suomalainen perheyritys. Olemme henkilöstövuokraukseen ja rekrytointeihin erikoistunut toimija, joka palvelee asiakkaitaan koko Suomessa sekä kansainvälisesti. VPS on HELA Henkilöstöpalveluyritysten Liiton jäsen.

Toimintamme perustuu eettisyyteen, laatuun ja hyvään asiakaspalveluun. Tunnuslauseemme on "Valitsemme parhaat sinulle."

Lisätietoja yrityksestämme: www.vps.fi

Huom. Tämä työpaikkailmoitus on ollut julkaistuna aiemmin ajalla 11.5.-14.6., ja hakuaikaa on jatkettu. Kaikki aiempaan ilmoitukseen lähetetyt hakemukset huomioidaan myös tässä rekrytoinnissa.

___________________________________________________________________________________________

CNC LATHE OPERATOR / TURNING CENTER OPERATOR

Iisalmi, Finland

Our client in Iisalmi, Finland is looking for a skilled CNC Lathe / Turning Center Operator to join their machining team. The work includes machining individual components and small production batches using versatile CNC equipment.

This position is ideal for professionals who value accuracy, independence, and high-quality manufacturing standards.

Machines you will operate

Depending on your background and experience, you may work with one or more of the following machines:

* Okuma Multus B750 with OSP3000 Control System
(used for machining large and demanding components with multi-axis capabilities)

* MoriSeiki lathes: SL35MC / SL253 / SL150
(experience with Fanuc controls is considered an advantage)

Please indicate in your CV which machines and control systems you have previously worked with.

Responsibilities

* Operating and setting up CNC lathes and turning centers
* Programming, modifying, and improving machining processes
* Manufacturing parts according to technical drawings and specifications
* Performing quality checks and ensuring finished product accuracy
* Keeping the work area organized and safe
* Cooperating with colleagues in production

What we expect

* Relevant technical education in machining, metalworking, or a related field
* Previous experience in CNC turning operations
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings independently
* Knowledge of machine setup, programming, tooling, and measurements
* Experience with Fanuc and/or Okuma control systems is an asset
* Reliable, detail-oriented, and self-motivated approach to work
* Good communication and teamwork skills
* Sufficient English or Finnish language skills for daily work

What we offer

* Permanent full-time employment (40 hours/week)
* Employment in accordance with Finnish labor legislation and the Technology Industry Collective Agreement
* Hourly salary starting from €14.87/hour (+ shift and other collective agreement allowances)
* Assistance with accommodation arrangements
* A well-equipped machine shop in Iisalmi with a versatile CNC machine fleet
* Supportive colleagues and a professional work environment where quality craftsmanship is valued

Apply

Please submit your application through the link provided in the advertisement and attach your CV.

For questions regarding the position, please contact primarily by email: sanna.rinkinen@vps.fi
Phone: +358 50 462 3615

Please do not send applications by email.

If you have previously completed VPSs electronic application form, simply log in and attach your application to this specific vacancy.

VPS Henkilöstöpalvelu, part of VPS Group, is a Finnish family-owned recruitment and staffing company established in 1987. We provide personnel services across Finland and also support international recruitment projects. VPS is a member of HELA, the Finnish Staffing Agencies Association.

We are committed to ethical operations, quality service, and customer satisfaction. Our motto is:

"We choose the best for you."

jobs.description:
AALTOVOIMA - JOIN US THROUGH THE POWER OF THE WAVE

We are looking for energetic and professional Chefs for the upcoming winter season for our client company in Rovaniemi. Our client is a unique, high-quality lodge located in the beautiful nature of Lapland, offering unforgettable experiences for international guests.

Isla Lumme

jobs.title: Metallien talteenoton käyttövarmuusinsinööri (ODR-insinööri)
jobs.description:
Olemme edelläkävijänä rakentamassa vastuullista ja ilmastoystävällistä akkuarvoketjua Eurooppaan. Liity joukkoomme!

Haemme Terrafamelle Sotkamoon

Metallien talteenoton käyttövarmuusinsinööriä

työskentelemään metallien talteenoton käyttövarmuuden parissa. Työsuhde on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva ja työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian. Kyseessä on päivätyö, jossa on hybridityömahdollisuus.

Tehtävässä vastaat metallien talteenoton laitteiden ja prosessien käyttövarmuuden kehittämisestä ja valvonnasta. Toimit tärkeässä roolissa tuotannon tukena varmistaen, että laitteistot toimivat turvallisesti, tehokkaasti ja tavoitteiden mukaisesti. Kunnossapidon kehittäminen ja ODR-toimintamallin (_Operator Driven Reliability_) jatkuva parantaminen ovat keskeinen osa tehtävääsi. Toimit tuotannon ja tehdaspalvelun välisenä linkkinä kehittäen käyttäjäkeskeistä kunnossapitoa sekä varmistaen, että laitteiden päivittäiseen operointiin, tarkastuksiin ja kunnonhallintaan liittyvät toimintamallit tukevat käyttövarmuuden tavoitteita.

Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä tuotanto-organisaation, tehdaspalvelun, teknisten asiantuntijoiden sekä projektiorganisaation kanssa.

Keskeiset työtehtäväsi:

- Metallien talteenoton laitteiden ja prosessien käyttövarmuuden seuranta, analysointi ja kehittäminen

- Käyttäjäkeskeisen kunnossapidon toimintamallien kehittäminen yhteistyössä tuotannon ja tehdaspalvelun kanssa

- ODR-toimintamallin ylläpitäminen, kehittäminen ja jalkauttaminen tuotanto-organisaatioon

- Laitteiden kunnonhallinnan, tarkastuskäytäntöjen ja vikojen ennakkohavainnoinnin kehittäminen

- Käyttövarmuuteen liittyvien häiriöiden ja vikojen juurisyyanalyysien toteuttaminen

- Kehitystoimenpiteiden määrittäminen ja toteutuksen seuranta yhteistyössä tehdaspalvelun kanssa

- Osallistuminen käyttövarmuuteen liittyviin investointi- ja kehitysprojekteihin

- Käyttö- ja kunnossapitohenkilöstön kouluttaminen sekä osaamisen kehittäminen

- Turvallisuuden, käyttöasteen ja kustannustehokkuuden jatkuva parantaminen


Odotamme sinulta:

- Prosessitekniikan- tai konetekniikan tai vastaavan alan korkeakoulututkintoa

- Kehityshenkistä ja järjestelmällistä työotetta

- Analyyttistä työskentelytapaa

- Hyviä kommunikaatiotaitoja ja halua oppia uutta

- Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa


Meillä pääset kehittämään toimintaa siellä, missä tuotanto ja kunnossapito kohtaavat. Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen prosessi-, metalli- tai kaivosteollisuudesta, käyttövarmuuden ja kunnossapidon kehittämisestä sekä kunnossapitojärjestelmien hyödyntämisestä. Jos lisäksi IT-osaamisesi on erinomaisella tasolla, saat tehtävässä loistavan startin.

Tarjoamme sinulle :

- Vastuullisen tehtävän ainutlaatuisessa akkukemikaalien tuotantoketjussamme

- Laajan perehdytyksen ja ammattitaitoiset työkaverit

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa metallien talteenoton kehittämiseen ja omaan ammatilliseen kehittymiseen

- Kattavan työterveyshuollon ja mielen hyvinvointia tukevat palvelut

- Osallistumismahdollisuuden liikunta- ja kulttuurietuihin ja yhteisiin tapahtumiin

jobs.title: Analyste développeur Odoo (m/f) (réf. E) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Employé de l'État Qui recrute ? Vous vous intéressez à la transformation digitale et vous êtes passionné par l'analyse ? Rejoignez l'Administration des contributions directes qui est en pleine transformation digitale et offrez-vous l'opportunité unique de jouer un rôle stratégique dans la transformation digitale d'une des plus grandes administrations du pays, essentielle au fonctionnement de l'Etat. Le poste d'analyste développeur Odoo sera affecté à la division informatique de l'ACD qui travaille activement à la digitalisation des démarches et du parcours client, en se focalisant sur une refonte des systèmes existants, une optimisation des processus tout en assurant un environnement de travail optimal pour les agents. Vous contribuerez directement à moderniser le service public et à améliorer l'expérience des citoyens. L'Administration des contributions directes, forte de plus de  agents, répartis sur  équipes, dans  immeubles et  communes, a pour mission de collecter les impôts et taxes nécessaires au financement des services publics et au bon fonctionnement de l'Etat. Ce rôle vous place au carrefour de l'innovation technologique et de l'impact sociétal, en participant activement à l'avenir numérique et stratégique de l'Etat. Missions En tant qu'analyste développeur, vous ferez partie d'une équipe de développement en charge de la mise en place de solutions logicielles basées sur des technologies modernes. Vous contribuerez activement à la digitalisation et à l'optimisation des processus métiers de l'ACD à travers le développement d'applications répondant à des besoins fonctionnels complexes. Le poste concerne plus particulier/ièrement les missions suivant/antes : Participation au processus d'élaboration des exigences fonctionnelles et non-fonctionnelles ; Définition de l'architecture et des spécifications techniques ; Réalisation et déploiement de nouvelles applications informatiques ; Maintenance et évolution des applications existant/antes ; Participation aux tests d'intégration et à la gestion des releases ; Application des bonnes pratiques de développement (clean code, qualité logicielle, sécurité) ; Collaboration étroite avec les équipes internes et les parties prenant/antes métiers ; Interaction avec le métier afin de comprendre leurs besoins et proposer des solutions adaptées ; Contribution à l'amélioration continue et veille technologique. Profil Compétences techniques Expérience professionnelle minimale de plus de 5 ans en développement ; Excellente maîtrise de Python (langage et frameworks associés) ; Bonne maîtrise des technologies web (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, etc.) ; Expérience dans le développement d'ERP (Odoo ou équivalent) ; Connaissances solides en bases de données relationnelles et maîtrise du SQL ; Connaissance des standards et bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel (de la conception à la production) ; Expérience avec des outils de gestion de version (Git ou équivalent) ; Maitrise obligatoire des langues françaises et anglaises. Compétences comportementales Passion pour le développement logiciel et les technologies Open Source ; Intérêt pour le clean code et les architectures logicielles modernes ; Curiosité pour les technologies émergentes ; Capacité à analyser et vulgariser des sujets techniques complexes ; Facilité de collaboration en équipe et bonnes capacités de communication ; Capacité à travailler en autonomie et de manier/ière proactive ; Rigueur, sens de la méthode et respect des échéances. Atouts Contributions à des projets Open Source ; Expérience avec des outils tels que PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes ; Connaissances ou expérience avec des architectures modernes (microservices, etc.) ; Expérience en administration de systèmes Linux ; Expérience dans des environnements de développement collaboratifs et agiles ; La maîtrise des langues luxembourgeoise et allemande constituant un avantage. Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut de l'employé de l'État. Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission pour devenir employé de l'État. Diplômes Vous êtes titulaire d'un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu par l'État du siège de l'établissement et sanctionnant l'accomplissement avec succès d'un bachelor en informatique ou de son équivalent. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 6 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. Langues Vous répondez aux exigences de connaissances des 3 langues administratives pour le groupe d'indemnité A2.  Vous avez la  luxembourgeoise.

Dreaming of spending the winter in Finnish Lapland while working in a professional kitchen? This is your opportunity!

Haemme asiakkaallemme motivoituneita lounaskokkeja sekä À la Carte -kokkeja Leville talvikaudelle 2027. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden työskennellä vilkkaassa ja laadukkaassa ravintolassa, jossa arvostetaan ammattitaitoa, hyvää asennetta ja tiimityötä.

We are looking for motivated Lunch Chefs and À la Carte Chefs for our client in Levi for the 2027 winter season. Join a busy, high-quality restaurant where professionalism, teamwork and a positive attitude are valued every day.

------------------------------------------------------------------------


Lounaskokki | Lunch Chef


Työtehtävät | Your responsibilities

 * Päivittäisen lounasbuffetin valmistus
 * Suosittujen à la carte -annosten valmistus, mukaan lukien ravintolan tunnetut kanakorit
 * Työpisteen siisteydestä ja hygieniasta huolehtiminen
 * Työskentely osana suurta ja ammattitaitoista keittiötiimiä
 * Preparing the daily lunch buffet
 * Preparing popular à la carte dishes, including the restaurants well-known chicken baskets
 * Maintaining a clean and hygienic workstation
 * Working as part of a large and professional kitchen team

Työvuorot sijoittuvat pääasiassa aamusta alkuiltaan. Ravintola on avoinna viikon jokaisena päivänä.

Shifts are mainly scheduled from morning until early evening. The restaurant is open seven days a week.

------------------------------------------------------------------------


À la Carte -kokki | À la Carte Chef


Työtehtävät | Your responsibilities

 * Laadukkaiden ja näyttävästi esille laitettujen annosten valmistus
 * Sujuva työskentely myös kiireisimpinä palveluaikoina
 * Korkean laadun ylläpitäminen jokaisessa annoksessa
 * Yhteistyö muun keittiötiimin kanssa sujuvan palvelun varmistamiseksi
 * Preparing high-quality, beautifully presented dishes
 * Performing efficiently during busy service hours
 * Maintaining the highest quality in every dish served
 * Working closely with the kitchen team to ensure smooth service
------------------------------------------------------------------------


 Odotamme sinulta | What we expect

 * Vähintään 2 vuoden työkokemusta kokin tehtävistä Suomessa
 * Kokin koulutus katsotaan eduksi
 * Sitoutumista koko talvikaudeksi
 * Hyvää työasennetta, oma-aloitteisuutta ja tiimityötaitoja
 * At least two years of professional chef experience in Finland
 * Culinary education is considered an advantage
 * Commitment for the entire winter season
 * Positive attitude, initiative and strong teamwork skills
------------------------------------------------------------------------


 Tarjoamme | What we offer

 * Kilpailukykyisen palkan
 * Asumismahdollisuuden (veloitus asumismuodon mukaan)
 * Mahdollisuuden henkilöstöhintaisiin hissilippuihin, lasketteluvälineisiin ja muihin henkilöstöetuihin
 * Rennon mutta ammattimaisen työympäristön
 * Kokoaikatyötä joulukuun puolivälistä pääsiäiseen saakka
 * Mahdollisuuden viettää unohtumaton talvi Suomen suosituimmassa hiihtokeskuksessa
 * Competitive salary
 * Accommodation available (cost depends on accommodation type)
 * Staff benefits including ski passes, ski equipment and other employee perks
 * A relaxed yet professional working environment
 * Full-time employment from mid-December until Easter
 * A unique opportunity to spend the winter in Finlands most popular ski resort
------------------------------------------------------------------------


Tule viettämään talvi Leville!


Spend Your Winter in Levi!

Työskentely Lapissa on paljon enemmän kuin pelkkä työpaikka – se on elämys. Päiväsi voivat alkaa tunturin juurella ja päättyä revontulten loisteeseen. Jos etsit unohtumatonta talvikautta ja haluat kehittää osaamistasi huippusesongin keskellä, tämä työ on sinua varten.

Working in Lapland is more than just a job—it is an experience. Imagine starting your day at the foot of the fells and ending it beneath the Northern Lights. If youre looking for an unforgettable winter season while developing your culinary skills in one of Finlands busiest destinations, wed love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
jobs.description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

Positionné(e) comme le bras droit de la Direction, vos principales missions sont les suivantes Participer à la commercialisation de la résidence : visites, relances, rédaction et signature des contrats, suivi des arrivées et des départs Contribuer à la mise en place de la politique commerciale et marketing du site (animation des réseaux sociaux, partenariats locaux avec les entreprises, écoles et acteurs du territoire Assurer le suivi quotidien des réservations de court séjour et long séjour en accompagnant l'équipe de réception Coordonner l'activité quotidienne des équipes et des prestataires externes (maintenance, entretien, intervenants événementiels Participer à l'animation de la vie du site : organisation d'évènements, développement de la communauté de résidents, suivi de la satisfaction Définir avec la direction les KPI's spécifiques au co-living et aider au clôtures mensuelles Veiller au respect des procédures et des critères de qualité, d'hygiène et de sécurité Assurer le remplacement du Directeur en cas d'absence Description du profil :

Issu(e) d'une formation en hôtellerie, tourisme ou gestion, vous justifiez d'au moins deux ans d'expérience dans le domaine de l'hôtellerie, de l'hébergement ou de l'exploitation de résidences.


Reconnu(e) pour votre relationnel et votre sens du service, vous êtes à l'aise aussi bien dans la relation client et la vente que dans le suivi administratif. Organisé(e) et rigoureux(se), vous savez prioriser les urgences et gérer les imprévus du quotidien d'un site en exploitation.


La résidence accueillant une clientèle internationale, la maîtrise de l'anglais est exigée pour le poste.


Vous rejoignez un groupe dont le réseau de résidences s'étoffe chaque année, et où les parcours d'évolution interne (vers des fonctions de direction de site ou des périmètres élargis) sont une réalité.


Processus de recrutement : Pré-sélection sur CV > Echange téléphonique > Entretien EOSIUM > Références > Entretiens Client. Une prise de références professionnelles sera réalisée, avec votre accord, : elle permettra d'attester la rigueur et le sérieux dont vous avez fait preuve dans de précédentes fonctions.

jobs.title: Store Manager - dubbu
jobs.description:
About the job

dubbu is expanding in Copenhagen, and we are looking for a Store Manager (37 hours/week) to lead our upcoming store — a new version of a familiar location, now including a small serving area inspired by Korean café culture.

As Store Manager, you will be responsible for the daily operations, the team, and ensuring that both the retail space and the serving area run smoothly every day.

You will work closely with the founder team and have significant influence on how the store develops in the coming years.

Your responsibilities

Leadership & team

  • Daily leadership of the team (scheduling, onboarding, training, and feedback)

  • Ensuring a high standard of customer service and sales

  • Coaching the team to improve performance on the sales floor

Store operations

  • Overseeing daily operations (opening/closing, stock deliveries, inventory, routines)

  • Ensuring the store always appears well-organized and ready for customers

  • Working with simple KPIs (sales, conversion rate, AOV)

Serving area

  • Responsible for the operation of the store’s small café area

  • Ensuring consistent quality and service speed

  • Daily cleaning, hygiene, and maintenance of equipment

  • Training staff in workflow and standards

  • Contributing to the development of new drinks inspired by Korean café culture

We are looking for someone who

  • Has 2–3 years of experience in retail or café environments, preferably with operational responsibility

  • Is structured and comfortable working with routines, checklists, and clear standards

  • Can lead a team and maintain calm and overview in a busy environment

  • Is hands-on and takes ownership of both people and operations

  • Has an eye for detail and understands the importance of a well-executed customer experience

It is a plus if you

  • Have experience with barista work, matcha, or espresso

  • Have worked with food hygiene or basic food safety procedures

  • Have experience with merchandising or retail visuals

  • Have an interest in Korean culture, cafés, or beauty

What we offer

  • A central role in a growing company

  • Close collaboration with the founder team

  • Significant influence on the store’s development

  • A strong team and an ambitious brand universe

  • Staff discount across our entire product range

Application

Start date: as soon as possible

Please send your CV and a short application to:

job@dubbu.dk

Subject line: “Store Manager”

In this field, you will analyse financial data, interpret tax laws, and provide guidance on tax reporting requirements, aiming to optimise tax positions and minimise risks for businesses.

Senior Associate - FATCA/CRS - Operational tax team

PwC Luxembourg is hiring a Senior in Operational tax team (m/f/d). What if it was you?

We are the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg, providing audit, tax and advisory services to a wide variety of clients. To make it happen, we count on the expertise of over 3,600 people from more than 90 different countries, who strive every day to reach excellence and team up to solve important problems through innovative solutions. We value diverse and singular career paths, embrace everyone's unique self and encourage our People to fuel their potential in a work environment that is inclusive, stimulating, and motivating.  
Our Operational Tax department is growing and we are looking for a motivated professional eager to take on real responsibility in a dynamic and international environment. As a Senior Associate within our FATCA/CRS dedicated team, you will be a trusted advisor to financial institutions navigating complex regulatory landscapes — from private equity and real estate to banking and asset management.

Your mission:

Your role sits at the intersection of tax, operations, and compliance. Concretely, you will:
Advise and support clients on their FATCA, CRS, QI and DAC6 obligations - from entity classification and investor on-boarding to due diligence and annual reporting. You will be their go-to contact for technical questions, guiding them through regulatory requirements with clarity and confidence.
Review and validate a wide range of client documentation - self-certification forms, U.S. withholding certificates, account opening forms, master files, and XML FATCA/CRS reports - ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with applicable legislation.
Drive quality and oversight by preparing gap analyses, controls reports and sign-off reports, QI  and DAC6 reports, monitoring regulatory update impacting our clients and consulting and reporting services.
Contribute to projects and initiatives that shape how the team operates - from building and refining internal processes and methodologies to exploring how to bring more efficiency and intelligence to compliance work.  
Collaborate and grow in close cooperation with colleagues across the Operational Tax department and beyond. You will contribute to tailored client solutions, support junior team members, and benefit from a training programme that you can shape according to your own development goals.

Let's talk about you

You will thrive in this role if you:

• Hold a Master's degree in Tax, Law, Economics, Business Administration or a related field;
• Bring at least 3 years of relevant experience, ideally gained in the financial services industry;
• Have solid knowledge of FATCA, CRS and/or QI legislation;
• Are comfortable working with data — databases, structured reports, and XML environments;
• Are a strong communicator who enjoys daily client interactions and can explain complex topics with clarity;
• Have a proactive mindset and a genuine interest in process improvement, project work, and new technologies including AI;
• Are fluent in English and French - any additional language is a plus.

PwC Luxembourg (www.pwc.lu) is the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg with over 3,600 people employed from 90 different countries. PwC Luxembourg provides audit, tax and advisory services including management consulting, transaction, financing and regulatory advice. The firm provides advice to a wide variety of clients from local and middle market entrepreneurs to large multinational companies operating from Luxembourg and the Greater Region. The firm supports its clients in creating the value they are looking for by contributing to the smooth operation of the capital markets and providing advice through an industry-focused approach.

At PwC, we help clients build trust and reinvent so they can turn complexity into competitive advantage. We're a tech-forward, people-empowered network with more than 364,000 people in 136 countries and 137 territories. Across audit and assurance, tax and legal, deals and consulting, we help clients build, accelerate, and sustain momentum. Find out more at www.pwc.com and www.pwc.lu.

jobs.title: Relationship Manager (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:


At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction—we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our corporate and institutional business.


What you will do:

Reporting to the Head of Banking, you will be responsible for managing and growing a hybrid client portfolio covering:
• GRM-covered relationships (supporting and, where applicable, co-managing selected strategic relationships in partnership with the Global Relationship Manager), and
• GNB – Global Network Banking (Luxembourg and Continental Europe booking needs), including onboarding and ongoing relationship management.


You will focus on delivering sustainable revenue growth through the sale of transactional banking products booked in Luxembourg and Continental Europe, notably Cash Management (GPS) and Securities Services (SSv), as well as identifying opportunities across Global Markets (GM), Credit & Lending, and Asset Management.


In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Manage and grow revenues from the assigned hybrid portfolio (GRM-supported and GNB inbound corporate clients), including identifying cross-sell opportunities and supporting new client acquisition where relevant.
• Act as a key point of contact for day-to-day relationship coverage for designated clients, ensuring a consistent client experience across GRM, GNB and product partners.
• Support Global Relationship Manager (GRM) on selected strategic relationships by coordinating local execution in Luxembourg/Continental Europe (e.g., product delivery, pipeline tracking, client service issues, and internal stakeholder alignment).
• Cover GNB inbound corporate relationships end-to-end, including client engagement, solutioning, and coordination of onboarding and account maintenance activities.
• Take ownership of onboarding, KYC/CDD, periodic reviews and renewals, working closely with internal teams to ensure timely completion and high-quality submissions.
• Support credit-related activities (where applicable) and regularly monitor the portfolio and generate quality assets by utilising appropriate risk management tools, ensuring alignment with HSBC's risk appetite and pricing appropriately for risk.


You should apply if you have:

• Relevant experience in a client-facing relationship management role, ideally with exposure to global coverage models (e.g., GRM/local coverage) and international stakeholders.
• Strong business acumen and commercial awareness, including economic, cultural, procedural and regulatory issues.
• Ability to interact with Corporate and Institutional customers; product knowledge of credit – experience of writing draft credit applications and performing credit analysis is an advantage.
• Solid knowledge of onboarding, KYC and CDD processes, with a track record of driving timely completion across multiple stakeholders.
• Good knowledge of transaction banking products, primarily Cash Management and Payment Solutions (GPS), Securities Services (SSv) and Global Markets (GM) products.
• Strong IT skills to produce quality presentations and other material for client meetings/pitches (Excel, PowerPoint etc.) and strong written and spoken communication skills in English - knowledge of French or German is not mandatory but can be an asset.

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.


What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is EUR 87,200 – 120,000.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Please note that every selected candidate will have to provide us with a valid criminal record check in due time.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. For any GDPR request, please send it to: lux.data.privacy@hsbc.com

For further information on building your career at HSBC, please visit: www.hsbc.com/careers

Job Description

Husky Technologies is a global leader in Injection Molding Manufacturing, committed to delivering high-quality products and services to our customers. Based in Bolton, Canada, we are seeking a Finance Director to join our dynamic team. This role will play a crucial part in providing financial leadership for our Operations and Supply Chain divisions, working closely with various functions including Purchasing, Logistics, Manufacturing, Quality, and Central Operational Support.

You will be responsible for overseeing and managing all financial aspects of our Operations & Supply Chain, ensuring that financial goals are met and that financial strategies align with the company's broader objectives. Reporting to the VP Finance, FP&A, you will serve as the right-hand finance partner to the Chief Operating Officer. This role will be based in Bolton, Canada. With five direct reports and a team of ~10 individuals based in Bolton and Luxembourg, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our organization's financial performance.

Key Accountabilities:

1.      Financial Planning and Analysis:

    Develop and manage the annual budget for the Operations and Supply Chain divisions.
    Provide financial guidance and insights to support decision-making processes.
    Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide monthly financial reports to the executive team.
    Lead the review and analysis of month-end and year-end financial close processes.
    Identify and analyze variances between actual results and budget/forecast, insights into the drives for variances.
    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand the underlying factors contributing to financial performance.
    Proactively identify financial risks and opportunities, making recommendations to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.
    Work closely with the executive team to refine financial strategies based on month-end and year-end insights.

2.      Cost Management:

    Transform current costing and methodology standards to improve transparency to product margins, life cycle costing and governance.
    Data and process design- Defining costing rules, master data requirements, controls, reporting definitions, and system-enabled workflows.
    Transformation accountability- Owning roadmap, requirements, testing, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
    Collaborate closely with Supply Chain leaders to identify cost-saving opportunities and implement cost control measures across various aspects of the supply chain, including procurement, logistics, warehousing, and production.
    Develop and monitor cost reduction initiatives and targets, ensuring alignment with the company's financial goals.
    Monitor and report on key cost-related performance indicators to the executive team, providing recommendations for continuous improvement.

3.      Strategic Planning:

    Work closely with the Leadership team to develop long-term financial strategies for the Operation and Supply Chain divisions.
    Transformation accountability- Owning roadmap, requirements, testing, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
    Assess financial impacts of potential investments in supply chain infrastructure, technology, and capabilities to improve cost and lead time.

4.      Cross Functional Leadership:

    Ability to lead Finance, Operations, IT, Service, Commercial, and regional teams through process/system change.

5.      Inventory Management:

    Collaborate with Supply Chain leaders to establish appropriate inventory targets, and improve inventory forecasting.
    Analyze the financial impact of inventory-related decisions and provide recommendations for improvement.

6.      Financial Support CAPEX (Capital Expenditures):

    Collaborate with the Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) team to assess the financial feasibility and impact of proposed capital projects within the Supply Chain division.
    Conduct thorough financial analysis and risk assessments for CAPEX investments, ensuring alignment with the company's financial goals and strategies.
    Assist in the preparation of CAPEX budgets, forecasts, and business cases.
    Provide financial insights and recommendations to guide decision-making on CAPEX projects, ensuring efficient allocation of resources and optimal return on investment (ROI).

Qualifications:

    Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field; MBA or CPA preferred.
    Proven experience (10+ years) in a senior finance role within a supply chain or manufacturing environment.
    Strong financial analysis, budgeting, and forecasting skills.
    Systems / ERP capability
        Hands-on or leadership experience with ERP costing modules, project accounting, service costing, data structures, integrations, and reporting architecture.
    Excellent leadership and communication skills.
    Ability to work collaboratively across functional teams.
    Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
    Fluent in English
    Additional language skills considered an asset

jobs.title: ASISTENT/ICA U PRODAJI I PRETPRODAJI
jobs.description:
Opis posla:
  • istraživati tržište i pronalaziti građevinske tvrtke koje odgovaraju našoj ciljanoj skupini
  • sastavljati i redovito ažurirati popise potencijalnih korisnika
  • pronalaziti vlasnike, direktore i druge osobe odgovorne za donošenje odluka
  • istraživati osnovne podatke o tvrtki prije prvog kontakta
  • kontaktirati potencijalne korisnike putem e-maila i telefona
  • predstaviti razlog javljanja i provjeriti postoji li interes za razgovor
  • voditi komunikaciju od prvog kontakta do dogovaranja prodajne prezentacije
  • zakazivati termine i pripremati prodaji informacije o potencijalnom korisniku
  • voditi urednu evidenciju svih kontakata i aktivnosti u HubSpotu
  • pratiti dogovorene rokove i planirati ponovne kontakte
  • pripremati i slati ponude, ugovore i fakture prema postojećim predlošcima
  • surađivati s prodajom i osobom zaduženom za odnose s korisnicima
  • na početku ćete upoznati Insidico, postojeće korisnike i probleme koje aplikacija rješava
  • proći ćete naš način pronalaska potencijalnih korisnika, primjere dosadašnjih e-mailova i poziva, pravila rada u hubspotu te način na koji se dogovorena prezentacija predaje prodaji
  • prve popise kontakata, e-mailove i pozive prolazit ćemo zajedno. Cilj je da nakon razdoblja uhodavanja možete samostalno organizirati svoj rad i voditi pretprodajne aktivnosti
  • opseg aktivnosti i očekivani rezultati prilagođavat će se dogovorenom broju radnih sati
Poslodavac traži:
  • tražimo osobu koja zna jasno komunicirati, dobro organizirati svoj rad i samostalno doći do potrebnih informacija
  • važno nam je da nemate problem nazvati osobu s kojom prethodno niste razgovarali.U ovom poslu bit će neodgovorenih e-mailova, odbijenih poziva i odgovora da tvrtka trenutačno nije zainteresirana. Očekujemo da takve situacije prihvatite kao normalan dio prodajnog procesa i nastavite raditi bez nepotrebnog pritiska na potencijalnog korisnika.
  • prethodno iskustvo u prodaji nije uvjet. Spremni smo raditi i s osobom koja tek ulazi u prodaju, ali očekujemo interes za učenje, samostalnost i odgovornost prema dogovorenim zadacima.
Uvjeti:
  • najmanje završena srednja škola
  • razvijene usmene i pisane komunikacijske vještine
  • organiziranost i sposobnost određivanja prioriteta
  • samostalnost, upornost i snalažljivost
  • urednost u vođenju podataka i praćenju rokova
  • dobro poznavanje rada na računalu
  • korištenje programa Microsoft Office i Outlook
  • spremnost na rad u HubSpotu, Google kalendaru, Google Meetu i internim alatima
  • aktivno znanje hrvatskog jezika
  • B2B prodaji ili telefonskom kontaktiranju potencijalnih korisnika
  • istraživanju tržišta i izradi baza kontakata
  • radu u CRM sustavu, posebno HubSpotu
  • građevinskoj industriji
  • prodaji softvera ili drugih poslovnih usluga
Poslodavac nudi:
  • rad na nepuno radno vrijeme uz mogućnost kasnijeg prelaska na puno radno vrijeme
  • mogućnost rada putem ugovora o radu ili studentskog ugovora
  • fleksibilan raspored unutar unaprijed dogovorenog broja sati
  • rad iz našeg ureda u Osijeku
  • mogućnost djelomičnog rada od kuće nakon razdoblja uhodavanja
  • dogovoreni sustav nagrađivanja prema rezultatima
  • rad u malom timu u kojem ćete izravno surađivati s prodajom i Customer Successom
  • detaljan onboarding i podršku tijekom prvih mjeseci
  • mogućnost napredovanja prema samostalnom vođenju prodajnih prezentacija i prodajnih procesa
Postupak odabira: Kandidati koji uđu u uži izbor bit će pozvani na razgovor i praktično testiranje. Testiranje će uključivati zadatke povezane s istraživanjem potencijalnih korisnika, pisanom komunikacijom, organizacijom rada i kratkom simulacijom telefonskog razgovora. Ne očekujemo da prije razgovora poznajete sve funkcionalnosti Insidica. Zanima nas kako razmišljate, pronalazite informacije, komunicirate i organizirate zadatke. Prijava Pošaljite životopis na matej@insidico.com najkasnije do 01. rujna 2026. Planirani početak rada je tijekom rujna 2026., prema dogovoru s odabranim kandidatom.

Are you an experienced chef looking for an exciting opportunity in Denmark?

• A unique opportunity to work in one of Denmark’s most popular tourist destinations

• A diverse workplace serving both international leisure guests and conference visitors

• A friendly, supportive, and multicultural team environment

• A fixed work schedule with the possibility of additional hours

• Employment under Danish collective agreements, ensuring fair working conditions and security

• Competitive salary: 29000 DKK -31000 DKK per month, depending on qualifications and experience

• Start date: 1 July 2026, or as soon as possible

• Employment until 30 September 2026, with the possibility of extension

• Assistance with practical arrangements, including accommodation, registration, and settling into life in Denmark

We Are Looking For

• Qualified chefs, or candidates with a minimum of 3 years’ experience in a professional kitchen

• Team players who are positive, reliable, and service-oriented

• Individuals who can work independently and take responsibility for their tasks

• Professionals who thrive in a busy, dynamic environment

• Candidates who can communicate in English or Danish

• Applicants who can start no later than 1 July 2026

Work Eligibility

To be eligible for this position, you must have the legal right to work in Denmark. This means you are either:

• A citizen of an EU/EEA country, or

• In possession of a valid Danish residence and work permit

Interested?

Please send us your CV as soon as possible.

For questions about the position, please contact Niels Switzer, Senoir head chef på

niels.switzer@legoland.dk.

If you have any general questions about your stay, please contact People Partner, Marie-Louise

Bredvig, at llb-hrsupport@legoland.dk

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and positions will be filled as soon as we find the right

candidates.

Join us for an exciting summer season in Denmark and become part of a team that creates

memorable experiences for guests from all over the world.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Hyderabad Infra team builds and maintains Notion's internal async task runner and configuration management platform. The async task runner plays a critical role in ensuring our millions of users have a fast, reliable, and secure experience. The configuration management platform enables safe, explicit configuration management for Notion's product and infrastructure engineers.



As part of the Hyderabad Infra Team, you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape how Notion manages and scales its async task runner and configuration management platform, enabling innovation across the company.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - You will contribute to the evolution and maintenance of our async task runner to meet the needs of over 100 million global users and support the rapid growth of our product and business. 

 - With guidance from senior team members, you'll help ensure our systems remain reliable, efficient, and scalable. You'll evaluate and integrate new technologies to keep us ahead of emerging challenges. 

 - Your work will empower our engineering team to build features confidently while you grow your skills in distributed systems and infrastructure.

 - You will develop the skills and confidence to debug live production systems with minimal disruption, whether replacing components or managing failovers. You will participate in an on-call rotation, responding to incidents to uphold service reliability and quickly restore normal operations.

 - You will partner with product engineers and other infra teams to ensure our platforms align with evolving business needs and product goals.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - A software developer with at least 4 years of experience and the ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.

 - Systems thinker: You understand distributed systems and can design solutions that account for tradeoffs like consistency, latency, and scalability.

 - Pragmatic problem-solver: You prioritize business impact and understand the balance between craft, speed, and long-term maintainability. You’re opinionated but not ideological, and you learn new technologies as you go.

 - Ownership and initiative: You thrive in a fast-moving, unstructured environment and are comfortable taking ownership of ambiguous problems. You act with a bias toward action and focus on results.

 - Customer Empathy: You excel at collaborating across teams, offering guidance and solutions to unblock engineers and support them in building reliable systems. With empathy at the core of your approach, you focus on addressing the needs of those who depend on the async task runner.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Production Designer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We’re looking for a Designer with strong visual taste to help scale Linear’s creative work across web, brand, and marketing. You’ll create polished, high-quality designs across a wide range of surfaces — from landing pages and ad campaigns to sales decks and launch materials — helping bring Linear’s visual language to life everywhere people experience our brand.

When it comes to design, we’re looking to work with people who can pick up any problem and solve it. For us, it’s both how it works and how it looks. At its core, Linear is a developer tool where speed, interactions, and small details matter. We expect a broad set of design skills and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes.

In this role, you will help communicate Linear's story (what we're building and why it matters) as part of our internal creative agency: the Magic Team.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in North American or European time zones. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Work with Marketing to design landing pages, ad campaigns, sales decks, and launch materials

 - Partner with the Magic Team to extend and scale Linear’s visual language across new campaigns and creative surfaces

 - Collaborate with designers, developers, and copywriters to create cohesive marketing experiences across web, social, and brand

What we're looking for

 - Around 2+ years of experience designing for web, marketing, or brand.

 - Excellent visual, UI, motion and interactive design skills

 - Eye for good design, attention to detail, and a genuine love for the craft

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

 - Our hiring process: How we hire at Linear https://linear.app/now/how-we-hire-at-linear

 - Crafting quality that endures https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pCil7YNhNCU Config keynote by our Co-founder & CEO, Karri Saarinen

 - Building for quality: Our Investment in Linear https://accel.com/noteworthy/our-investment-in-linear Accel Series B blog post

jobs.title: Part-time Tea House Assistant
jobs.description:
We're looking for a part-time Tea House Assistant.

You'll be working directly with the owner in a small independent tea house. This is a hands-on role where you'll be involved in every part of the daily operation. There isn't a separate person for each task, so everyone helps wherever needed.

Your responsibilities

Your responsibilities may include:

- Preparing and serving tea using Gongfu brewing methods

- Introducing our teas and sharing basic tea knowledge with customers

- Helping customers choose teas and tea products

- Preparing tea drinks and desserts

- Operating the cashier and processing payments

- Handling takeaway and delivery orders independently

- Packing loose-leaf tea for retail sales

- Restocking products and organising inventory

- Washing dishes and maintaining a clean workspace

- Cleaning the shop

- Supporting other day-to-day operational tasks as needed


During busy periods, you'll often be serving customers, preparing drinks, handling takeaway and delivery orders, and managing multiple tasks at the same time. During quieter periods, you'll help with packing tea, restocking, cleaning, organising, and preparing the shop for the next rush.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who is:

- Friendly, reliable, and responsible

- Comfortable talking with customers

- Able to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment

- Comfortable multitasking and adapting to different responsibilities

- Proactive and able to work independently

- Interested in learning about tea and providing excellent customer service


Language requirements

- Fluent Finnish

- Good English

- Basic Chinese listening skills are a plus, but not required


Position

- Part-time

- Weekend and evening availability is preferred

- Full training will be provided


Before you apply

This is an independent tea house, not a large chain with separate roles for each employee. You'll be working directly with the owner, and the role requires flexibility, efficiency, and the ability to manage different responsibilities throughout the day. If you're looking for a position with only one fixed responsibility or prefer a slower-paced working environment, this role is unlikely to be the right fit.

If this sounds like the kind of work you enjoy, we'd love to hear from you.

Please send your CV and a short introduction to \[info@teetao.fi\].

As we're a small independent business, we're unfortunately unable to reply to every application individually. If your experience matches what we're looking for, we'll contact you within **two business days** to arrange the next step.

If you don't hear from us within two business days, it means we've decided to move forward with other applicants. We sincerely appreciate your interest and thank you for taking the time to apply.

A Note from the Founder

Why Sticky is Free to Use

Hey â I'm Hamza Saleem, the solo developer behind Sticky.today.

In May 2026, I made a decision most SaaS founders won't make: I fired our payment processor and made Sticky completely free for everyone.

Here's why.

Software Should Be Free

Sticky started as a paid product. Pro plans, trials, subscriptions â the usual SaaS playbook. And it worked. People paid. But something felt off.

The best tools I've ever used didn't ask for my credit card. They just worked. Obsidian, VS Code, Blender â tools that respected me enough to not put a gate between me and my work. I wanted Sticky to be that kind of tool.

So I tore out every line of billing code. No more trials. No more upgrade prompts. No more payment gateways. Just a fast, free canvas for your ideas.

The Internet Has Enough Gatekeepers

Look around â every productivity tool wants $10-20/month from you. Per seat. Per feature. It adds up. And for what? Most of them are glorified text editors with a subscription attached.

Sticky is different. It's a spatial thinking tool built by one person who actually uses it every day. There's no board of investors demanding recurring revenue. There's no pressure to add "enterprise features" nobody asked for. There's just me, building software I believe in, and you, using it however you want.

I don't think thinking should cost money. Your brain doesn't charge you rent. Neither should your canvas.

What You Get (For Free)

Unlimited Boards

Create as many canvases as you need. No caps, no limits.

Real-Time Collaboration

Share boards and work together with live cursors.

AI Idea Generator

Brainstorm with GPT-4o-mini. 10 free generations per day.

Self-Hosting

MIT licensed. Run it on your own infrastructure.

Dynamic Tables

Insert editable tables alongside your sticky notes.

Dark Mode

Easy on the eyes. Built in from day one.

What's Next?

Sticky will keep improving. I'm building it in public â follow along on Twitter/X or check out the source code on GitHub. No investors. No roadmap dictated by revenue targets. Just a guy building software he believes in, for people who actually want to use it.

If you read this far, thanks. If Sticky helps you think, that's the win.

Follow on X View on GitHub

â Hamza Saleem, May 2026
