jobs.title: Sales Jedi
jobs.description:
Great salary | Profit share | 100% remote |
Work from anywhere in Europe | SaaS

 

Awesome opportunity for a self-motivated and energetic people person to join our remote team and help sell our world-leading SaaS products, from anywhere in Europe.

We pay a great salary, based on experience and location. We don’t pay commissions, because good sales are a team effort—from engineering, to operations, marketing, and support, our high-performing team all contribute to a great product and service that our clients love. Everybody in the company is rewarded with a share of profit each December—we succeed together.

Our much-loved products are in demand and are proven to make a difference to our clients’ lives. You’ll be selling world-leading software through a well-considered process that leaves room for personal flair.

 

SaaS experience is extremely beneficial but strong communication skills, patience, curiosity, keenness to learn and friendliness are key to success in this role.

Join our Rebel Alliance

Creative Force is experiencing strong growth and as we scale our efforts in 2026 and beyond, we’re looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our diverse team of Jedis to help recruit new clients as they navigate the decision process, and transform them into long-term supporters.

You’ll be a respected member of our remote global sales team and will be well supported with the tools, knowledge and answers you need to provide exceptional levels of service, and to make the most from solid sales traction with our two in-demand products.

As you master the Force and the multitude of skills needed in this role, attracting clients to join our mission, you will be recognised and rewarded with strong career and salary progression.

Responsibilities

 

  • Help prospects find the specific value they seek (this is the product you are looking for)

  • Must live in Europe
  • Digital native, with enthusiasm for technology
  • Discipline and self-motivation (key to success in remote work)
  • Loads of energy, humour, passion, and empathy
  • Genuine interest to help provide amazing value for people
  • Superior communication skills

What we offer

Work-life balance

  • 20 days paid annual leave
  • 20 days paid parental leave (available after one year)
  • 12 days paid public holidays (your local country/region public holidays)

Personal development and wellbeing

  • Commitment to continued learning and development

Location and compensation

  • Full-time role, based remotely, work anywhere within Europe
  • No commission structure. Competitive salary, indexed to your experience and location
  • Budget for computer and office equipment (pending 6 month probationary period)

 

Respect, growth and stability

  • Friendly, sociable, responsible, collaborative team (a great place to be)
  • Respect for each other’s time, value and contribution
  • Regular communication with global team via chat and video calls
  • Dynamic, young, growing tech company leveraging all the latest tech tools and leading industry trends
  • Stable, bootstrapped, independent business (no VCs calling the shots)

jobs.title: Rustfri Smed
jobs.description:
Rustfri smed

 

Er du erfaren indenfor rustfri svejsning ? Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis at være udlært smed – det vigtigste er, at du har praktisk erfaring og kan levere et godt stykke håndværk, og er en kompetent og alsidig håndværker, som har fokus på kvalitet. Vil du gerne indgå som et ansvarligt medlem af et team i en professionelt ledet virksomhed? Så er du måske én af vores nye medarbejdere.

 

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet bestå af:

  • Svejsning og bearbejdning af emner i rustfrit stål

  • Arbejde ud fra tegninger og arbejdsbeskrivelser

  • Kontrol af kvaliteten på de færdige emner

  • Samarbejde med kolleger om at få opgaverne sikkert og effektivt gennem produktionen

Har du også erfaring med aluminium, er det en fordel – men det er ikke et krav.

 

IQ Metal er i vækst, og for at møde vores kunders forventninger om leveringsfleksibilitet og -sikkerhed, har vi besluttet at øge antallet af medarbejdere og investere i en række nye maskiner. Du vil blive en del af et team med mere end 450 medarbejdere i IQ Metal, som samarbejder med store kunder i hele Europa. Vi leverer typisk samlede løsninger af produkter og fokuserer på at give kunderne den bedste oplevelse ved at sikre komplet levering til tiden, i rette kvalitet.

Kan du se dig selv i virksomheden?

Du indgår som en fast del af et godt team med 10-15 mand, som selv planlægger hverdagen og skaber overblik over ordreplanen. Vores maskinpark sikrer, at alt kører som det skal. En del af vores maskiner er fuldautomatiske, mens andre er semi-automatiske. Vi inviterer gerne på en kop kaffe og tur rundt i produktionen, hvis du er interesseret i et job hos os.

Vi tilbyder:

Løn og ansættelsesforhold er gode og konkurrencedygtige, og indeholder udover pension også en sundhedssikring. Alle fastansatte på nathold tilbydes årligt sundhedstjek. Der er kaffe og vand tilgængeligt i kantinen, og vi har en god stemning på virksomheden, som er professionelt ledet.

Kan du se dig selv i jobbet?

Vi tilbyder selvstændigt arbejde i moderne faciliteter. Det er et krav, at du er en erfaren smed, som har arbejdet inden for faget inden for de sidste par år. Du skal have tegningsforståelse, samt selv kunne udvikle og fremstille fiksturer og værktøjer til at sikre optimal håndtering af emner.

Vi forventer at du er en god kollega, som hjælper til når det er krævet af hensyn til teamet og opfyldelse af kunders forventninger. Du har humor og smil på læben i hverdagen, også når der er travlt. Bopæl nær Hasselager/Århus vil være en fordel, men ikke nødvendigvis et krav.

Interesseret?

Læs mere om virksomheden hjemmesiden www.iqmetal.com eller kontakt vores produktionsleder Lars Holm på telefon 8738 9036 for en uforpligtende og fuldt fortrolig snak. Ansøg ved at sende dit CV eller skriv lidt om din erfaring på: lh@iqmetal.com.

jobs.title: Kreditor- og administrationsassistent
jobs.description:
Har du styr på detaljerne – og trives du med en hverdag, hvor administration og økonomi går hånd i hånd?

Hos Kids-World søger vi en engageret og struktureret kreditor- og administrationsassistent til vores økonomiafdeling.

Stillingen kombinerer kreditorbogholderi, ejendomsadministration og øvrige administrative opgaver. Fælles for opgaverne er, at de kræver struktur, overblik og en god økonomisk forståelse.

Du bliver en del af en mindre økonomiafdeling, hvor du får et bredt ansvarsområde og sammen med dine kolleger er med til at sikre en effektiv og velfungerende økonomi- og administrationsfunktion på tværs af koncernens selskaber.

En væsentlig del af stillingen er den daglige håndtering af kreditorprocessen via digitale workflows. Du håndterer undtagelser, følger op på manglende godkendelser, sikrer korrekt kontering og momsbehandling samt afklarer eventuelle afvigelser i dialog med både leverandører og kolleger på tværs af organisationen.

Samtidig får du ansvaret for en række administrative opgaver inden for koncernens bolig- og erhvervsejendomme, herunder huslejeopkrævning, lejekontrakter og den løbende dialog med lejere, håndværkere og leverandører.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Registrering, kontering og betaling af kreditorfakturaer.

  • Løbende bogføringsopgaver og vedligeholdelse af bogholderiet for koncernens ejendomme.

  • Administration af en portefølje af bolig- og erhvervsejendomme.

  • Udarbejdelse og administration af lejekontrakter samt oprettelse af ejendomme og lejere i vores systemer.

  • Huslejeopkrævning, varsling og regulering af husleje samt opfølgning på restancer.

  • Udarbejdelse af forbrugsregnskaber samt administration af vand- og varmeregnskaber.

  • Løbende dialog og samarbejde med lejere, håndværkere, leverandører, viceværter og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.

  • Vedligeholdelse af data og dokumentation i Business Central, Boligflow og øvrige administrative systemer.

  • Administrative og økonomiske ad hoc-opgaver på tværs af koncernens selskaber.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde i Business Central og Boligflow. Erfaring med et eller begge systemer er en fordel, men ikke en forudsætning. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære nyt og trives med digitale arbejdsprocesser – vi sørger naturligvis for en grundig oplæring.

 

 

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring fra en administrativ eller økonomisk funktion, hvor du har arbejdet med både administrative og regnskabsmæssige opgaver. Du behøver ikke være uddannet bogholder eller ejendomsadministrator, men du har en god forståelse for, hvordan administration og økonomi hænger sammen, og du motiveres af at få tingene til at fungere.

Derudover forventer vi, at du:

  • Trives med en hverdag, hvor nogle opgaver er faste rutiner, mens andre varierer.

  • Har en god økonomisk og regnskabsmæssig forståelse og arbejder sikkert med kreditorhåndtering, opkrævninger og afstemninger. Har du erfaring med moms, er det en fordel.

  • Trives med administrative opgaver og motiveres af at skabe orden og overblik.

  • Arbejder struktureret, omhyggeligt og har blik for detaljen.

  • Har let ved at skabe gode relationer og kommunikerer naturligt og professionelt med lejere, håndværkere, leverandører og kolleger.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt, men trives samtidig i et mindre team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og deler viden.

  • Er ansvarsbevidst og følger dine opgaver helt til dørs.

  • Har flair for IT og lyst til at lære nye systemer. Erfaring med Business Central, Boligflow eller lignende systemer er en fordel, men ikke en forudsætning.

Hvorfor os?

Hos Kids-world er vi et team på 115 dedikerede medarbejdere, som alle brænder for at gøre en forskel. Vi værdsætter fleksibilitet, personlig udvikling og et arbejdsmiljø med højt til loftet. Hos os bliver du en del af en virksomhed i vækst, hvor din indsats gør en reel forskel – og vi sørger for, at der er plads til både seriøsitet og sjov i hverdagen!

Det Praktiske

Vi tilbyder en fast stilling på 30-37 timer ugentligt i vores afdeling Administration & Økonomi i vores domicil i Esbjerg. Vi har frokostordning, som du til en fordelagtig pris kan blive en del af. Kaffe/te samt frugt er også til fri afbenyttelse.

Du bliver ansat under HK’s overenskomst, med løn efter kvalifikationer og hos os får du bl.a. pensionsordning, fritvalgskonto, mulighed for sundhedsforsikring, 5 feriefridage samt mulighed for fordelagtige køb i shoppens varesortiment.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV, som du kan sende til jobs@kids-world.dk. Marker mailen med "Administration og økonomi".

For at sikre en god forventningsafstemning fra start, beder vi dig oplyse dit forventede lønniveau i din ansøgning. Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt, og opslaget vil blive fjernet, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Alle ansøgninger vil blive behandlet fortroligt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Jannie Tofte på tlf: 32173575

jobs.title: Commercial Account Executive - MENA
SaaS Product Support Jedi
jobs.description:
We’re on the hunt for a sharp, self-driven SaaS pro who’s as comfortable troubleshooting API and integrations as they are navigating human conversations.

Our European client base is growing fast and we need someone who can keep up. Our software isn’t your average plug-and-play; it has a steep learning curve so you’ll need to be technically savvy while also being the kind of person clients genuinely enjoy talking to. If you’ve got SaaS in your DNA, thrive in async/remote environments, and can juggle multiple threads without breaking a sweat — keep reading.

The role

You’ll join a lean, high-performing global support team working across two SaaS products, Award Force and Good Grants. Day to day you’ll be communicating with colleagues and clients across countries, cultures, and time zones.

Support happens across email tickets, phone, and 1-1 Zoom calls. Once you’ve leveled up on product knowledge, you’ll run onboarding sessions and client meetings covering issue resolution, best practices, and product adoption.

You’ll also be hands-on with bug testing and reporting, feeding considered feedback to our product teams— always pushing to make our products better.

We have a startup mindset. We experiment with new tools, iterate on processes, and move fast. Got a great idea? Pitch it. We’re not big on bureaucracy, only results. We don’t expect you to be a slave to your chair but flexibility is a must.

You’ll need to tick these boxes
  • You’re based in the UTC +1 or +2 timezone range. This is non-negotiable. Our European team and clients operate in this window and we don’t allow shift work. If you live outside this range, this one’s not for you
  • 2+ years of professional experience, ideally in a SaaS support or client-facing role
  • Native-level English fluency (bilingual? Even better!)
  • Terms like HTML, CSS, JS, API, integrations, dev console, staging & production environments, GitHub repos, and database queries don’t make you flinch. You don’t need to write code, but you need to get it
  • You’ve got exceptional interpersonal and communication skills—written and verbal
  • Client calls energise you. Four to five Zoom meetings a day? Bring it on
  • You’re a natural problem solver who loves helping others untangle theirs
  • Your writing is clean, well-structured, and detail-oriented
  • You’re curious by nature and love learning new things
  • You’re not allergic to upselling or fielding “sales-y” questions
  • You’re organised and process-driven. Multiple tools for different workflows? No problem — you thrive in that setup
  • You’re self-motivated and independent, but you also value being part of a tight-knit team
  • Remote work isn’t just something you dabble in—it’s where you do your best work. You’ve got fast, reliable internet and a distraction-free workspace ready to go

 

Responsibilities

Product support

  • Go deep on product knowledge through self-driven learning—become the expert

  • Be the first point of contact on all inbound support via email/tickets, phone, and eventually live chat

  • Run 1-1 Zoom sessions with clients for technical consultation and query resolution

  • Maintain our consistently impressive first-reply-time metric (yeah, we’re proud of it)

  • Provide technically accurate responses backed by hands-on testing of scenarios

  • Collaborate with engineering to squash bugs and keep clients in the loop with timely updates

  • Spot patterns in user issues and flag them for product improvement

 

Be seriously good with clients

  • Speed matters. Respond quickly and decisively
  • Listen deeply—get to the root of the issue and own it until it’s resolved
  • Treat every client interaction with genuine respect and appreciation
  • Build trusting, long-term relationships rooted in honesty and transparency

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant Manager, Enterprise - Japan
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

 - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

 - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you have a strong interest in the evolving AI landscape, stay closely attuned to industry trends and developments, and are curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Native or bilingual level fluency Japanese and business-level English proficiency across speaking, listening, and reading, including the ability to support team members with global communication




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model—able to navigate the SC/CSA hand-offs and hold the commercial arc across the full customer lifecycle




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
**Description**

**Please note that: we are not currently hiring for this role at this moment, but we encourage you to apply and be among the first candidates considered when the position becomes available.**

**The Role**

**We're looking for a Data Scientist to do the quantitative analysis behind a large-scale data quality program. When our data engineering team's monitors flag a statistical anomaly in large, human-generated rating and annotation data, you'll be the one who determines whether it's genuine signal or ordinary noise, and if it's real, what's actually driving it. You'll triage confirmed findings into the right remediation lane, turn your analysis into fast-turnaround diagnostic write-ups, and help build the dashboards and reporting views that make your findings visible to the team and stakeholders. You'll operate on a two-week sprint cadence as part of a small, distributed team, reporting into the program's Data Scientist Lead.**

**What You'll Do**

- **Take anomalies flagged by the data engineering team's monitoring systems and apply statistical methods (hypothesis testing, distributional comparisons, cohort/segment analysis) to classify each as genuine signal or ordinary noise/drift.**

- **Run root-cause analysis on confirmed anomalies in rating/annotation data — for example, comparing cohorts to identify what distinguishes an outlier group from the rest of the population — to identify the likely driver.**

- **Triage confirmed findings into the correct remediation lane: contributor-side issues (route to our internal Quality team for remediation) versus process-side issues (route back to the client's program team as a guideline or workflow fix).**

- **Turn analysis into clear, concise, fast-turnaround diagnostic write-ups that feed the team's stakeholder cadence, owned by the Data Scientist Lead.**

- **Build and maintain the dashboards and reporting views (in partnership with data engineering) that surface anomaly trends, cohort findings, and turnaround metrics to the team and stakeholders.**

- **Work within tight, SLA-driven turnaround windows, delivering diagnosis-ready findings within hours — not days — once an issue is flagged.**

- **Participate fully in a two-week sprint cadence: sprint planning, review, and continuous improvement of analysis methodology.**

- **Collaborate cross-functionally with data engineers, the Data Scientist Lead, and program/quality stakeholders across a distributed, international team.**


**What You'll Need**

- **3+ years of professional experience as a Data Scientist, Statistician, or Quantitative Analyst.**

- **Strong background in statistical analysis and hypothesis testing — comfortable choosing and applying the right test (e.g., distributional comparison tests) to determine whether two groups genuinely differ.**

- **Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, including standard statistical/analysis libraries.**

- **Demonstrated experience distinguishing genuine patterns from noise or drift in large, messy, human-generated datasets.**

- **Experience with BI/dashboarding tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Data Studio).**

- **Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with short sprint cycles.**

- **Strong written and verbal English communication skills; comfortable producing clear write-ups for both technical and non-technical audiences.**


**Nice to Have**

- **Experience with anomaly and drift detection on human-rated, crowdsourced, or annotation-based datasets.**

- **Prior experience in a data quality, trust & safety, content moderation, or crowdsourced-data environment.**

- **Familiarity with cohort or segmentation profiling techniques for large populations.**


**Project Overview**

**Location: Remote from Finland**

**Type: Full-time, fixed-term engagement of approximately 6 months, with potential to extend based on program needs.**

**WE OFFER**

- **Occupational health care at Terveystalo private clinic**

- **Sport & Culture & Health benefits through EPass**

- **Multicultural environment/diversity and inclusiveness**

- **Charity & well-being activities**

- **Company events**

- **Employee referral bonuses & Recognition programs**


**If this opportunity sounds appealing to you, apply now!**

**Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted/interviewed.**

**Kindly attach an updated Copy of your CV in English.**

Vi söker löpande nya kollegor som vill utvecklas inom försäljning i en social och fartfylld miljö. Du kommer att arbeta med etablerade produkter och tjänster inom bland annat telefoni, abonnemang och tech.

Du får en ordentlig introduktion, regelbunden coachning och stöd från erfarna kollegor och ledare.

Vi söker dig som 👤

Du är social, ansvarstagande och bekväm med att prata med människor via telefon. Du trivs med att arbeta i team, tar till dig feedback och vill fortsätta utvecklas inom försäljning.

Du motiveras av tydliga mål, affärer och resultat. För att trivas i rollen behöver du vara driven, tävlingsinriktad och villig att arbeta med outbound och kalla samtal.

Arbetsuppgifter 📞

    

Kontakta privatpersoner eller företag via telefon

    

Presentera produkter och tjänster utifrån kundens behov

    

Driva säljsamtalet från första kontakt till avslut

    

Arbeta aktivt med merförsäljning och kundlojalitet

    

Dokumentera kunddialoger och resultat i CRM-system

    

Arbeta mot tydliga individuella mål och teammål

    

Delta i coachning, uppföljningar och teammöten

Obligatoriska krav ✅

    

Du har fyllt 18 år

    

Du talar och skriver flytande svenska

    

Du har goda kunskaper i engelska

    

Du kan arbeta heltid och söker en långsiktig roll

    

Du har inga planerade studier under det närmaste året

    

Du är bekväm med telefonen som arbetsverktyg

    

Du har grundläggande datorvana

    

Du är villig att arbeta med outbound och kalla samtal

Meriterande krav ⭐

    

Erfarenhet av telefonförsäljning eller mötesbokning

    

Erfarenhet av att arbeta mot tydliga försäljningsmål

    

Intresse för tech, abonnemang eller digitala tjänster

    

Erfarenhet från en tävlings- eller prestationsinriktad miljö

    

Idrottsbakgrund eller annan erfarenhet som visar på driv och uthållighet

Om uppdraget 📍

Plats: Marbella Omfattning: Heltid Start: Omgående eller enligt överenskommelse Inriktning: Telefonförsäljning Ersättning: Fast lön samt möjlighet till provision Boende och administration: Hjälp med boende och nödvändig administration i Spanien Utveckling: Löpande coachning och möjlighet att utvecklas mot exempelvis teamledning eller B2B-försäljning Ansökan: Vi tar emot och går igenom ansökningar löpande. Annonsen har inget fast slutdatum.

Sway Sourcing är en innovativ rekryteringspartner som specialiserar sig på att matcha rätt talang med rätt företag – snabbt och effektivt. Vårt huvudfokus ligger inom Ekonomi, Administration, HR, Marknad och IT, men vi har även den breda expertis och flexibilitet som krävs för att leverera skräddarsydda rekryteringslösningar inom alla branscher.

Trots att vi är en relativt ny aktör har vi redan byggt förtroende hos många av Sveriges största företag och arbetar både nationellt och internationellt. Med baser i Sverige och Spanien erbjuder vi en unik kombination av lokal expertis och global räckvidd. Vårt starka nätverk och djupa branschinsikter gör oss till en självklar partner för företag som vill ligga steget före i sin rekrytering.

jobs.title: Servicemekaniker søges til Grønning Smede og Maskinforretning
jobs.description:
Vil du arbejde i en virksomhed med over 80 års erfaring, hvor traditionelt håndværk møder innovation – og hvor du bliver en del af et stærkt fællesskab med gode kollegaer?

Hos Grønning Smede- & Maskinforretning – en landbrugsorienteret virksomhed nord for Skive – søger vi en serviceminded medarbejder til en alsidig hverdag med service, reparation og kundekontakt.

Det er ikke et krav at du er uddannet mekaniker – det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, er god til mennesker, kan arbejde selvstændigt og har hænderne skuet rigtig på.

Dine opgaver:
· Service og reparation af maskiner ude hos kunder og på værksted
· Fejlsøgning på mekanik, hydraulik og el
· Kundekontakt og rådgivning i marken
· Vedligehold og klargøring af maskiner

Vi forventer, at du:
· Er mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst
· Er god til mennesker og trives med kundekontakt
· Kan arbejde selvstændigt
· Har kørekort

Vi tilbyder:
· Fuldtidsstilling med frihed under ansvar
· En afvekslende hverdag med gode kollegaer
· Grundig oplæring
· Løn efter kvalifikationer

Lyder dette som noget for dig, så tøv ikke med at sende din ansøgning.

Du er også velkommen til at ringe og høre mere om stillingen. Se oplysninger nedenfor.

Ansøgning: Send din ansøgning til Joakim jh@gronningsmede.dk eller kontakt ham på tlf. 54334008

Job start snarest muligt og samtaler holdes løbende, vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat.

Du kan læse mere om vores virksomhed her.

jobs.title: Operatør daghold
jobs.description:
For en af Danmarks førende asfalt producenter søger ranstad en blandeoperatør til en alsidig hverdag

For vores samarbejdspartner beliggende i Uldum søger Randstad en operatør til en spændende og alsidig fuldtidsansættelse hos en virksomhed, hvor du sjældent oplever to dage, der er ens.

Om stillingen
Kan du se dig selv i en produktionsvirksomhed med ansvar for at overvåge, omstille og betjene produktionsanlæg? I så fald er denne stilling lige noget for dig. Du vil få en grundig sidemandsoplæring og det rette introforløb, så du er godt klædt på til at bestride arbejdsopgaverne ift. dagligdagen på en asfalt blandestation hvor du sammen med et mindre hold sørger for at alt køre og tager imod forskellige vognmænd som skal hente læs ved jer.

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke afgørende, men vi ser gerne, at du har en god teknisk forståelse. Derudover er det et plus, hvis du har erfaring med betjening af produktionsanlæg og en generel procesforståelse. Dette kunne eksempelvis stamme fra tidligere arbejde som proces-/industrioperatør eller landmand/maskinoperatør med indsigt i fejlfinding og reparation af anlæg. Det er desuden en fordel, hvis du har truckcertifikat, men det er ikke et krav for at søge stillingen.

Mødetider
Produktionen starter kl. 05.00 om morgenen, og du ansættes på 37 timer om ugen. Da arbejdet til dels er sæsonpræget, skal du i højsæsonen forvente op mod 45-50 timer om ugen. Alt over 37 timer aflønnes med tillæg efter overenskomsten.

Arbejdsopgaverne er:
• Overvågning og indstilling af anlæg
• Kvalitetssikring af anlæg
• Fejlfinding og reparation af anlæg

Vi forventer:
• Du har enten en baggrund og eller erfaring indenfor de ovennævnte områder
• Du er ansvarlig og mødestabil
• Du er selvkørende og selvstændig men kan arbejde i teams
• Du er udpræget A menneske

Vi tilbyder:
• Overenskomstmæssige forhold
• Mulighed for faglig udvikling og større ansvar i dine opgaver
• Fastansættelse fra start

Ansøg
Hvis du synes, at ovenstående lyder spændende ser vi frem til at modtage dit CV. Såfremt du ønsker at vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte konsulent Asmus Dam på 48808201. Vi afholder løbende samtaler, og alle henvendelser behandles fortroligt. Vi ansætter snarest mulig.

Om randstad
Randstad er verdens største HR-udbyder og ‘partner for talent’. Vi giver lige muligheder til alle uanset baggrund og hjælper kandidater med at forblive relevante på et hastigt skiftende arbejdsmarked. Vi tror på et inkluderende arbejdsmarked, hvor alle kan være sig selv og føle sig velkomne.

Vores markedsindsigt og store kendskab til arbejdsmarkedet hjælper virksomheder med at opbygge en kvalificeret, mangfoldig og fleksibel arbejdsstyrke, og vi støtter mennesker og virksomheder i at nå deres fulde potentiale. Det er det, vi er her for, og det er det, der motiverer os hver dag.

Randstad DK er en del af den internationale Randstad Group. Vi formidler dagligt arbejde til over 600.000 mennesker verden over og er førende inden for rekruttering, karriererådgivning og fleksibel arbejdskraft i Danmark, med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding.

jobs.description:

  • Pažljivost prema detaljima i visoka razina preciznosti u radu
  • Timski igrač s odličnim komunikacijskim vještinama
  • Spremnost na rad u smjenama
  • znanje kineskog jezika (prednost)

Ponuda:

  • Stalno zaposlenje s probnim rokom
  • Atraktivna i konkurentska plaća
  • Mogućnost napredovanja i usavršavanja kroz različite obuke
  • Rad u modernom i opremljenom radnom okruženju
  • Povoljni uvjeti rada i beneficije za zaposlenike

Molimo vas da naznačite naziv radnom mjesta „Strojobravar- oglas“ u naslovu e- pošte.

Zahvaljujemo na vašem interesu za rad u Kronospanu CRO d.o.o. Bjelovar, te očekujemo vaše prijave!

jobs.title: KOMERCIJALIST /KOMERCIJALISTICA
jobs.description:
Glavne odgovornosti:

  • Savjetovanje i podrška: Putem telefona i e-maila savjetuješ tvrtke na hrvatskom tržištu o tome kako najbolje iskoristiti našu platformu za preuzimanje visokokvalitetnih potencijalnih klijenata (leadova).
  • Analiza i rast prodaje: Analiziraš poslovne ciljeve klijenata, predlažeš optimalna rješenja unutar platforme i pratiš rezultate kako bi im osigurao kontinuiran rast prodaje.
  • Optimizacija rezultata: Redovito analiziraš uspješnost obrade leadova kod klijenata te pružaš strateške preporuke kako bi povećali stopu konverzije i ostvarili bolji povrat investicije.
  • Customer Support & Feedback: Brzo i profesionalno rješavaš sve upite, reklamacije i prijedloge klijenata, djelujući kao spona između njih i naše platforme.
  • Rad iz ureda: Posao se obavlja isključivo iz našeg ureda u Splitu (nije remote), što nam omogućuje bržu internu komunikaciju i bolju timsku sinergiju.

Uvjeti

  • Iskustvo u korisničkoj podršci, account managementu ili telefonskoj prodaji (računamo i studentski rad)
  • Empatija i sposobnost slušanja: razumiješ potrebe klijenata i pretvaraš ih u konkretne korake
  • Organiziran/a si, voliš timski rad i motiviraju te jasni ciljevi

Što nudimo:

  • Struktuirani onboarding, kontinuirane edukacije i mentorstvo
  • Motivirajući bonusi povezani s rezultatima tima i portfelja
  • Ured s prijateljskom atmosferom i povremenim team building aktivnostima

Zašto se pridružiti:

  • Napredovanje svakih 12 mjeseci
  • Vikendi i večeri su slobodni – rad-život balans nam je važan - radimo samo do 16h radnim danom
  • Moderna oprema, besplatna kava i tim koji dijeli znanje i iskustvo

Osiguravamo ti između 20 i 30 dana odmora, ovisno o tvojoj dobi i stažu unutar naše firme. Posebno cijenimo tvoje slobodno vrijeme, stoga potičemo korištenje dužeg godišnjeg odmora tijekom ljetnih mjeseci kako bi se u potpunosti napunio baterije.

jobs.title: Senior FP&A Analyst, Corporate Finance
Cybersecurity Senior Strategy Consultant (m/f/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Transform the everyday Shape the future of digital resilience. In a world where cyber threats evolve faster than ever, organizations need strategic minds who can turn security challenges into competitive advantages. This is your opportunity to lead that transformation at Siemens.
Your mission in our team
You'll join a forward-thinking cybersecurity strategy team where your role is to advise senior leadership and key stakeholders on building robust, future-proof security frameworks. You'll work across organizational boundaries, translating complex security challenges into clear, actionable strategies that drive business value while protecting critical assets.
The role combines top-management consulting, business excellence, and strategic program leadership — with a strong focus on structure, analytical rigor, and impact.
This is a role for a former consultant who enjoys turning ambiguity into clarity, strategy into roadmaps, and ideas into measurable results.

What we offer you

- An environment where everyone can bring their whole self to work and feel a sense of belonging. - A workplace that values curiosity and guarantees continuous learning, with development opportunities for both personal and professional growth. - Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG. - A wide range of flexible benefits for you and your family to enjoy!

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.
You'll make an impact by

- Strategy & Strategic Execution- Continuously refine the Cybersecurity strategy and strategic ambition in line with Siemens’ overall business and IT strategy.- Translate strategic priorities into clear roadmaps, programs, and initiatives, including prioritization and sequencing.- leadership decision materials, and serve as a trusted strategic advisor to Cybersecurity and IT executives.
- Program & Performance Management- Design and drive cross-functional strategic and business excellence programs, from set-up to execution and impact tracking.- Define program structures, governance, milestones, KPIs, and success metrics.- Monitor progress, risks, and benefits realization; prepare regular management updates and steer course corrections where needed.- Case analyses while coordinating internal and external resources, including service providers.
- Stakeholder & Change Management- Engage with senior stakeholders across Cybersecurity, IT, and the business to understand needs, align priorities, and drive buy-in.- Support organizational development initiatives, including target operating models, role clarity, and governance structures.- Act as a coach and thought partner to executives while ensuring clear, structured communication of strategy and progress.

This is how you'll win us over

- Education- Master’s degree in Business Administration, Management or Economics; or an equivalent qualification
- Experience & Skills- Several years of post-consulting experience in cybersecurity strategy, risk management, or related advisory roles- Proven ability to develop strategic recommendations and influence senior decision-makers technical audiences- Experience in digital transformation or enterprise-wide (security) initiatives- Familiarity with specific frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, or similar)- Knowledge of cloud security, OT/IT convergence, or industry-specific security requirements- Experience working in regulated industries or large, complex organizations
- Ways of working: Collaborative, adaptable, and committed to continuous learning, working effectively across diverse teams and staying current with evolving security trends- Languages: business proficiency in English and German

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
Your individual personality and perspective are important to us. We create a working environment that reflects the diversity of the society and support you in your personal and professional development. Let’s get to know your authentic personality and create a better future together with us. As an equal-opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/arbeiten-bei-siemens/inklusion.html) we are happy to consider applications from individuals with disabilities. In the case of equal qualifications, severely disabled applicants and applicants with equivalent status will be given preference.

About Us
The world never stands still. And new challenges arise every day. With a passion for questioning things, for supplying ideas, and intelligently driving things forward we are helping society move towards a smarter tomorrow. Be it with technologies that reduce carbon emissions in cities or hyperintelligent robots. This is how we are able, to tackle the most important projects and push them forward together. Help us shape the future.

Are you our next Norwegian speaking customer-focused and reliable consultant for our client's brand new office in Fuengirola? Then this might be something for you!

As a customer service consultant, your tasks will involve receiving and responding to phone inquiries from our customers who need roadside assistance. The customers may find themselves in vulnerable situations and our job is to help and assist them in these situations. It is important to us that they receive the right assistance. You will often be the first person a customer talks to when something has happened on the road.

We are looking for employees who work well independently and are passionate about delivering excellent service to our customers. As a customer service consultant, you will work as part of a larger team that helps and supports each other when needed. To accomplish this task, you will work in various systems to solve the challenges as effectively as possible. Additionally, you will assist our partners in the insurance and automotive industry with various questions related to roadside assistance.

To succeed in this role, we would like you to possess the following skills:

    Experience in customer service
    Fluent in Norwegian, both spoken and written
    Proficient in English, both spoken and written
    Good knowledge of data/technology/systems
    A clean criminal record is a prerequisite

You will fit right in if you:

    value good work ethics
    have strong teamwork skills
    excel in communication
    are comfortable working both individually and in a team
    being at ease with data and phone as work tools.
    are detail oriented and enjoy complex tasks
    are solution-oriented both with customers and colleagues
    are curious and eager to acquire new knowledge
    thrive in a fast paced environment and adapt easily to change
    wants to be a part of a solid team with strong culture

For the right candidates, we can offer:

    Brand new offices in Fuengirola, Málaga
    A great work environment with experienced and curious colleagues
    Comprehensive and structured training
    excellent opportunities for personal and professional development
    A rotating schedule within 24/7 operations
    Competitive conditions + benefits
    Long term contract

We look forward to hearing from you!

Please send your application to:

fredrik@jobsbynordics.com

or via the apply button!

jobs.title: Notino Experience Program Manager - EMEA & APAC, Early Career
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

This early-career Notino Experience Program Manager role is for a builder who thrives in ambiguity and turns it into momentum. You’ll wear many hats across the People team, but your core job is to jump in, chart the path, and drive high-impact projects based on business priorities—bringing clarity, aligning cross-functional partners, and executing quickly so the team can deliver meaningful employee experiences across EMEA and APAC.

You’ll succeed here if you’re deeply curious, eager to grow, and excited to hone your craft in People. This is a launchpad opportunity to learn from strong leaders, build expertise across the full spectrum of People work, and help shape moments that matter—bringing energy, optimism, and genuine care for people while helping build a workplace where everyone can do the best work of their careers.

As the regional anchor for how Notion’s global people & environment programs come to life outside the U.S., you’ll sit at the intersection of global vision and local execution. Based in Dublin and reporting to the Notino Experience & Environment Lead for APAC & EMEA, you’ll partner closely with the Global Experience Programs team in AMER and environment teams across Dublin, Sydney, Tokyo, Seoul, and Hyderabad—translating global programs into locally relevant, high-quality experiences and building the operational infrastructure to deliver them consistently at scale.

We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own regional program operations. Take end-to-end ownership of key people programs across EMEA and APAC — from onboarding and performance cycles to engagement surveys and talent retention initiatives. You'll research, plan, launch, and iterate.

 - Bridge global and local. Act as the connective layer between the Global Experience Programs team and on-the-ground environment teams. You'll translate global frameworks into locally relevant experiences.

 - Build the infrastructure. Create processes, playbooks, and agents that make local execution easier and more consistent across markets. Think onboarding workflows, program calendars, and repeatable delivery frameworks.

 - Elevate Affinity Groups. Partner with Affinity Group leads across the region to strengthen their programmes, provide operational support, and help surface retention and engagement insights from within those communities.

 - Use data to drive decisions. Build and maintain dashboards that track program health, adoption, and outcomes. Use what you learn to run experiments, course-correct quickly, and demonstrate ROI.

 - Partner cross-functionally. Work closely with People Partners, NoE , Recruitment and business leaders to align people programs with organisational goals and ensure an inclusive, well-supported employee experience.

 - Champion the Notion Experience. Help craft and bring to life a more distinct Notino Experience brand across EMEA and APAC — reimagining how we work, how we connect, and what it feels like to be a Notino in your region.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Programatic: experience running people programs end-to-end, across multiple markets & time zones.

 - AI-native mindset: you’re “AI‑pilled” in the best way: you proactively use AI tools to speed up research, ops, and communication, and you’re excited to build AI agents/playbooks.

 - Project management: strong skills and the ability to hold many moving pieces.

 - Stakeholder trust: you build trust naturally across levels, from team members to executive partners.

 - Bias toward action: you’re resourceful, scrappy when needed, and energised by a fast-moving environment.

 - Change management: experience driving change at a high-growth company — you know how to bring people along, not just roll things out.

 - Executive presence: you’re comfortable presenting to and partnering with senior leaders.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Familiarity with or enthusiasm for Notion

 - Experience working across APAC and EMEA markets, with an understanding of cultural nuance in employee experience.
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €60,000 - €70,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Junior kampagne specialist for Google Ads i Barcelona
jobs.description:

Barcelona er hjemsted for mange store kunstnere og malere, så der er altid masser af kunst at udforske. Byens mest berømte kulturelle mesterværk er Gaudís værk, den imponerende katedral "Sagrada Familia," som repræsenterer en unik stil inden for moderne arkitektur.

Hvis du ikke er så vild med kunst og kultur, kan du tilbringe dagen på en af Barcelonas sandstrande, som kun ligger en kort gåtur fra byens centrum. Her kan du nyde noget af det bedste middelhavsinspirerede seafood. Byen har et ry for at være den mest kosmopolitiske, moderne og fremsynede by i Spanien. Selvom det er en meget moderne by, finder du stadig de gamle kvarterer som det gotiske kvarter, hvor byens ældste bygning ligger, samt utallige barer og butikker.

Vi tilbyder

  • Udviklingsmuligheder inden for virksomheden

  • Gratis fitnessmedlemskab

  • Præstationsbonusser

Om jobbet:

Som junior kampagne- og marketingspecialist vil du være ansvarlig for at forbedre og udvikle kampagner. Derfor vil du skulle rådgive og have gode forhandlingsevner – det er ikke aggressivt salg, men det er vigtigt, at du besidder nogle salgsmæssige kvaliteter. Dit daglige arbejde vil inkludere opgaver som:

  • Fungere som en betroet konsulent og onboarde kunder

  • Udvikle PPC-kampagner

  • Forstå kundernes behov og mål

  • Ansvar for at øge forbrug, mersalg og bæredygtighed

  • Håndtere en stor mængde potentielle kunder dagligt via telefonopkald

Dine kvalifikationer

Du taler dansk på modersmålsniveau og er flydende i engelsk (B2).

Erfaring: Minimum 1-2 års erfaring inden for salg og/eller online annoncering. Erfaring med outbound-opkald og salg (ikke påkrævet). BA/BS i Marketing, Digital Marketing eller Kommunikation er et plus.

Du har en god forståelse og et solidt niveau af computerfærdigheder.

Fremragende problemløsningsevner med evnen til at finde og identificere de rette oplysninger. Du har erfaring med og en passion for online display-annoncering.

Stærke kommunikations- og forhandlingsevner. Du er serviceorienteret, professionel og grundig.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at sende en mail til Cll@jobsqd.com


Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Cuisinier (H/F)
jobs.description:
Au quotidien, les femmes et les hommes de l'EdA s'engagent aux côtés de nos forces armées sur le territoire national et à l'étranger.

L'EdA c'est 1 000 collaborateurs dans le monde, 20 familles de métiers, pour assurer l'approvisionnement en denrées alimentaires, la restauration collective - externalisée ou en régie - et les activités de loisirs, la gestion des camps en opérations extérieures et le soutien aux évènements.


Notre offre

Au sein de la direction International et Opérations (DIO), rattaché au second de cuisine, le cuisinier a pour mission de réaliser la production alimentaire d'un restaurant collectif et de ces prestations particulières.


Vos missions au quotidien

- Réaliser les préparations culinaires selon les fiches techniques

- Assurer les cuissons le dressage et la mise en valeur des plats

- Appliquer strictement les règles d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire (HACCP)

- Assurer le nettoyage et l'entretien du poste de travail et du matériel

- Travailler en coordination avec le reste de l'équipe du RF

- Contrôler et garantir l'entretien et la bonne utilisation des matériels mis à sa disposition

- Préparer les produits et mettre en place les matériels de cuisine

- S'assurer de la qualité des denrées fournies

- Produire, valoriser et vérifier (goût, qualité, présentation) les préparations

- Repérer et signaler les dysfonctionnements

- Veiller au bon déroulement du service dans les différents espaces de restauration

- Assurer l'accueil des convives et la gestion des enregistrements des passages viales caisses JES pour les 3 services


Votre profil
Le candidat est de nationalité française et/ou ressortissant européen.
Etablissement soumis à enquête administrative.

Votre parcours

Formation CAP/BEP restauration et/ou niveau équivalent acquis par une expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine.


Les savoir-être partagés par tous les collaborateurs de l'EdA

Esprit d'équipe, sens du service, discrétion, implication, agilité, éthique, communication, initiative


Nos propositions

Poste à pourvoir sur des enceintes militaires françaises.

Rattaché au second de cuisine.

Respect des règles de sécurité édictées par l'autorité militaire, notamment les conditions de sortie.

Logement fourni (nuitée et petit déjeuner), type appart hôtel.

Poste de contact, varié, nécessitant d'être apte à travailler en autonomie aussi bien qu'en équipe.

Contrat : CDD de droit privé, contrat français détaché, à temps plein (42h30).

Durée : 3 mois avec première mission d'un 1 mois.

Statut : Agent de maîtrise

Rémunération : 4 000 € net mensuel de package.

Pourquoi postuler

L'engagement au côté des forces armées françaises nous permet de donner du sens à nos actions et de nous accomplir au quotidien. C'est l'opportunité de mettre nos expertises et notre créativité au service de projets dimensionnants.
Pour garantir leur réussite, nous veillons à développer et conjuguer les talents de chacun.

Nous rejoindre c'est intégrer un collectif où l'humain reste au centre des attentions, qu'il soit client ou collaborateur. Nous avons la conviction que le service indéfectible que nous devons à nos prescripteurs ne peut être garanti que par la qualité de l'environnement que nous proposons à nos équipes.

A la jonction des univers militaire et civil, l'EdA est riche d'une culture de mixité.
En postulant chez nous, ne vous posez pas d'autre question que celle de savoir si vous partagez nos valeurs et ambitions.
Au-delà de votre expertise, nous recherchons les qualités qui font la force de nos équipes : éthique, implication, audace, rigueur, empathie et créativité.

Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

jobs.title: Postdoc in clinical Raman spectroscopy and AI-based diagnostics
jobs.description:
A position as Postdoc (full-time) is vacant at the TE Andersen Lab part of the Research Unit of Clinical Microbiology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Shape the future of clinical diagnostics

We are seeking an ambitious and highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to help establish next-generation Raman spectroscopy technologies for clinical microbiology. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the interface between optics, artificial intelligence, microbiology and clinical diagnostics in close collaboration with hospitals, industry and international research partners.

Research environment

The successful candidate will join the research group led by Professor Thomas Emil Andersen. The group conducts translational research in microbiology, advanced infection models, spectroscopy and medical technology. We collaborate extensively with Danish and international hospitals, universities and industrial partners, with a strong focus on translating innovative technologies into improved patient care.

The academic position

The job involves research, professional development, research education, research-based teaching, and supervision.

Your responsibilities will consist of the following:

  • Lead OUH contributions to the EU- and state-funded projects (Innovation Fund Denmark project nanoRaman, two Eurostars projects MbCare and QMIC, and the MedTech Odense project UriNix).

  • Design, plan and execute experimental studies from concept to publication.

  • Develop Raman spectroscopy workflows for analysis of clinical samples.

  • Apply machine learning and AI for spectral analysis and diagnostic classification.

  • Coordinate collaborations across hospitals, academia and industrial partners.

  • Build and develop a Raman spectroscopy research platform within the Andersen Lab.

  • Supervise students and junior researchers.

  • Publishing results in leading international journals and contributing to future grant applications.

Expectations and qualifications

We are looking for candidates holding a PhD in physics, engineering, optics, spectroscopy, biomedical engineering or a related discipline. The candidate may also hold a PhD within health sciences, biology, microbiology or similar but should then also hold significant knowledge and experience within optical sciences, spectroscopy and related data handling.

Essential qualifications:

  • Significant knowledge and experience with Raman spectroscopy.

  • Experience with optical instrumentation.

  • Experience with machine learning and/or AI.

  • Experience analysing biological or clinical samples.

  • Profound in scientific writing and a solid publication record.

Desirable qualifications:

  • Experience with clinical microbiology or hospital diagnostics.

  • Experience in academia–industry collaborations.

  • Project coordination skills.

  • Ability to work independently while thriving in multidisciplinary teams.

What we offer

  • A unique translational research environment combining engineering and medicine.

  • Participation in major externally funded collaborative projects.

  • Close interaction with clinicians, engineers and industrial partners.

  • Access to state-of-the-art spectroscopy and microbiology facilities.

  • Excellent opportunities for scientific publishing, networking and career development.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision - We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future - it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research - with people at the centre; strong research environments - as drivers of development; and the research journey - from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information

Further information about the position can be obtained from Professor Thomas Emil Andersen, e-mail: thandersen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 21261634 or Head of Department of Clinical Research, Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477.

Application deadline

August 18, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at the laboratory of Professor Andersen at the Department of Clinical Microbiology, Odense University Hospital, J. B. Winsløws Vej 21.1, Odense C, Denmark. The laboratory and department will move to the newly built University Hospital associated with the University of Southern Denmark, in late summer 2027.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

  • An explanation other qualification relevant to the post

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: GTM Recruiter, Tokyo
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for an experienced Go-To-Market (GTM) Recruiter in Tokyo to partner closely with our Japan leadership team to attract, engage, and close top talent from an array of backgrounds. In this role, you’ll help build our Japan organization in a high-ownership, high-growth environment. We will look to you to advise and consult with hiring managers and interviewers, proactively source and engage future Notinos, and design a rigorous hiring processes while ensuring a delightful candidate experience.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the Japan recruiting process for GTM roles, primarily for Solutions Consultants (direct sales) and other GTM roles.

 - Operate autonomously across the end-to-end cycle, from direct sourcing and screening through close, while ensuring a thoughtful candidate experience at every step.

 - Run role kick-off meetings, define profiles, and align interview plans and scorecards to drive consistent, high-quality decisions.

 - Utilize internal hiring metrics and external market data to proactively propose recommendations and solutions to leaders.

 - Drive our diversity and inclusion strategy forward, with a heavy emphasis on sourcing and maintaining a well-balanced and diverse top-of-funnel candidate slate.

 - Build and nurture future talent pipelines for priority Japan GTM roles.

 - Establish trusted partnerships with the Japan leadership team to ensure Notion hires the right talent at the right time to achieve the company’s ambitious goals.

 - Ensure scalable, structured hiring plans for all roles with a strong sense of urgency and agency, while building repeatable processes and creative solutions that help the recruiting team scale for years to come.

 - Inspire candidates throughout all stages of the interview process, and build a customized close for each candidate.

 - Collaborate closely with peers and cross-functional partners, including Recruiting Coordinators, HRBPs/People Partners, Compensation Partners, Recruiting Operations, Executive Operations Partners, and Revenue Operations.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - You have at least 3 years of recruiting experience, preferably in a high-growth, in-house environment. Agency background is also welcome if you have full-cycle IT/SaaS sales hiring experience.

 - You have a track record of directly sourcing, qualifying, and closing exceptional GTM talent (e.g. Sales, Customer Success, Pre-Sales, Professional Services) based in Tokyo.

 - You can partner with, manage, and influence leadership stakeholders effectively. You have coached and guided hiring managers and interviewers through the full recruiting process.

 - You have built diverse candidate pipelines and helped hiring managers build inclusive teams.

 - You have outstanding communication and interpersonal skills in both English and Japanese (written and spoken fluency in both are required.)

 - You have a relentless focus on delivering a high-touch, high-quality recruiting experience, while respecting candidates’ and hiring managers’ time.

 - You can multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment.

 - You’re a team player with an optimistic attitude, and you’re comfortable wearing many hats in a smaller organization.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You have owned the end-to-end hiring process at global SaaS companies.

 - You have managed roles and candidates across regions outside of Japan.

 - You’re a Notion power user!




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


We're looking for a Partner Sales Specialist to help scale Replit's strategic partnership ecosystem into a repeatable and measurable revenue channel. This role sits at the intersection of Partnerships and Enterprise Sales, serving as the execution engine behind our co-sell motions with strategic partners including Microsoft, Google Cloud, Databricks, and future ecosystem partners.

You will work directly with Account Executives, Strategic Alliances, and partner field teams to identify opportunities, coordinate co-sell engagement, accelerate deal progression, and drive measurable business outcomes through partnerships.

This is a highly collaborative and externally facing role for someone who enjoys building relationships, working directly with sales teams, and turning strategic partnerships into pipeline and revenue. You'll play a critical role in helping Replit establish partnerships as a scalable enterprise growth channel.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Drive enterprise co-sell motions across Replit's strategic partnerships, including Microsoft, Google Cloud, Databricks, and future ecosystem partners.

 - Partner closely with Account Executives to identify opportunities where strategic partners can accelerate customer acquisition, expansion, and procurement.

 - Build trusted working relationships with partner account teams to increase co-sell engagement and opportunity progression.

 - Conduct recurring account mapping exercises with strategic partners to identify whitespace opportunities and prioritize joint engagement.

 - Coordinate partner involvement throughout the sales cycle, ensuring opportunities receive appropriate partner support and visibility.

 - Drive partner sourced and partner influenced opportunities through active coordination, follow up, and stakeholder management.

 - Manage deal registration processes across partner portals, ensuring accurate and timely submission of opportunities to maximize partner program benefits and co-sell eligibility.

 - Collaborate closely with Sales, Strategic Alliances, Partner Operations, Marketing, Enablement, and partner stakeholders to ensure successful execution of partnership initiatives.

 - Help establish repeatable co-sell processes, operating rhythms, and best practices that can scale across Replit's partner ecosystem.

 - Maintain visibility into partner engagement across active opportunities and support accurate attribution of partner sourced and partner influenced pipeline.

 


REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years of experience in enterprise sales, channel sales, partnerships, alliances, business development, partner management, or related go to market functions.

 - Experience working directly with enterprise Account Executives and sales organizations to drive pipeline and revenue outcomes.

 - Experience supporting enterprise co-sell motions with hyperscalers, cloud providers, ISVs, systems integrators, or strategic technology partners.

 - Strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles, opportunity management, and pipeline development.

 - Experience conducting account mapping, opportunity planning, and partner engagement activities.

 - Familiarity with deal registration processes and partner portal management across hyperscaler or ISV programs.

 - Strong relationship building skills and comfort working across both internal and external stakeholder groups.

 - Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple opportunities, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously.

 - Experience operating in fast paced, high growth environments.

 - Excellent communication, coordination, and project management skills.

 - Strong Salesforce proficiency and familiarity with CRM driven sales processes.

 


BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Familiarity with Microsoft, Google Cloud, Databricks, or other enterprise technology ecosystems.

 - Familiarity with Azure Marketplace, Google Cloud Marketplace, private offers, hyperscaler procurement motions, and co-sell programs.

 - Experience supporting partner sourced or partner influenced revenue motions.

 - Experience working in SaaS, cloud infrastructure, developer tools, AI, or enterprise software companies.

 - Experience helping build repeatable partnership and co-sell programs from the ground up.

 - Passion for AI, developer tools, and helping enterprises transform how software gets built.

jobs.title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
SISTEM INŽENJER/KA
jobs.description:
Osatina Grupa d.o.o. je u potrazi za stručnim i motiviranim Sistem inženjerom (m/ž) koji će se pridružiti našem IT timu. Ako imaš iskustva u održavanju poslužiteljske infrastrukture, voliš rješavati tehničke izazove i želiš raditi u dinamičnom okruženju, ovo je prilika za tebe! OPIS POSLA Kao Sistem inženjer, bit ćeš ključna osoba za osiguravanje stabilnosti, sigurnosti i optimalnih performansi naše IT infrastrukture. Tvoji glavni zadaci uključivat će:
  • virtualizacija i serveri: Instalacija, konfiguracija i proaktivno održavanje Windows servera te upravljanje Hyper-V virtualizacijskom okolinom i virtualnim strojevima (VM).
  • sigurnost podataka: Konfiguracija, nadzor i redovito testiranje sustava za sigurnosnu pohranu (backup) i oporavak podataka korištenjem Veeam rješenja.
  • upravljanje domenom: Administracija Active Directoryja (upravljanje korisničkim računima, grupama, pravima pristupa i GPO politikama).
  • file serveri: Održavanje i strukturiranje mrežnih dijeljenih mapa (File servers), dodjeljivanje prava i praćenje dostupnosti.
  • korisnička podrška i oprema: Instalacija, održavanje i rješavanje problema na radnim računalima (hardware i software) te konfiguracija mrežnih printera i ostale periferne opreme.
  • nadzor sustava: Praćenje rada cjelokupnog informacijskog sustava i pravovremeno rješavanje tehničkih poteškoća.
UVJETI
  • minimalno 1 godina radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima.
  • napredno poznavanje Microsoft Windows Server okruženja je prednost.
  • praktično iskustvo s Hyper-V tehnologijom virtualizacije.
  • iskustvo u radu s Veeam Backup & Replication alatima.
  • odlično poznavanje Active Directory, DNS, DHCP servisa.
  • sposobnost samostalnog rješavanja problema s računalima (Windows 10/11) i perifernom opremom (printeri, skeneri).
  • poznavanje osnovnih mrežnih koncepata (LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, VPN)
ŠTO NUDIMO
  • ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rok.
