jobs.title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
jobs.description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

jobs.title: Mobile Product Designer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. 

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Quality is our competitive advantage. Every member of our fully remote team is a maker at heart, caring deeply about the quality and feel of our work. While the industry optimizes for speed and metrics alone, we believe that craft and quality have lasting value. Quality creates gravity — it pulls people toward our team and product rather than requiring us to push. This philosophy drives everything we do, from product decisions to hiring choices.

For this role, we expect robust design skills, sharp product thinking, and the ability to engage in technical discussions. We work in small, autonomous project teams, where engineers are paired tightly with designers to explore ideas, build prototypes, deploy internal builds, and ultimately ship to customers. You will be a key element of projects from beginning to end.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Own the experience of our iOS and Android mobile apps, including guiding the adaptation of desktop features to mobile

 - Pair closely with mobile engineers and product leads to initiate and complete mobile-specific projects, no hand-offs

 - Take opportunities to redesign or refine key screens and flows, as well as smaller quality issues and “paper cuts” as you use Linear

 - Create mockups, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals to communicate ideas and describe their execution

 - Guide and inspire fellow designers through collaborative critique of work-in-progress across both mobile and desktop platforms

 - Use and improve our lightweight design system components

 - Help with hiring new teammates that can elevate our team and product

What we’re looking for

 - 5+ years experience designing software, with mobile-specific emphasis

 - Courage to ask questions, experiment, and advocate for what you feel is right

 - Humility to accept feedback, adapt your thinking, and iterate toward the best solution

 - Experience with prototyping directly in code, or with tools like Figma, Origami, etc

 - Ability to distill problems and feedback, then design clear, focused solutions

 - Effective written and verbal communication skills — much of our work is async

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

jobs.title: Product Engineer, New Products
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Engineer, you’ll take emerging ideas from concept to polished experiences. You’ll build sophisticated, intuitive user experiences while working across AI models, agentic workflows, and all parts of web infrastructure to ship complete products.




The Goal: Build products that can define major new categories for Replit. You will combine the flexibility of software with the accessibility of presentations, spreadsheets, dashboards, and visual editors, enabling anyone to create powerful, interactive artifacts through natural language.




The Audience: We build for the next generation of creators, knowledge workers, and high-leverage teams. Our users should be able to turn an idea, dataset, or business problem into a polished, editable, and shareable product just by themselves.

Candidates who thrive here often have the product judgment, technical range, and ownership mindset associated with founders. This is a high-visibility role working closely with product leadership.





HOW WE WORK

Structure: We operate as a collective of in-house technical founders, not narrowly specialized engineers. Initiatives are run by lean, autonomous teams built for velocity and technical leverage. Engineers maintain meaningful ownership over technical direction, product quality, and launch success, supported by Product and Design partners.



Cadence: We work in focused three-week sprints, shipping quickly, observing real user behavior, and incorporating feedback into each iteration. We value decisive execution, thoughtful experimentation, and the ability to make progress without perfectly defined requirements.





WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own major product experiences from initial concept through design, implementation, launch, measurement, and continued improvement

 - Invent and build intuitive interfaces for generating, editing, arranging, and collaborating on AI-created presentations, data applications, and visual artifacts

 - Deliver exceptional frontend experiences across interaction design, typography, layout, motion, accessibility, performance, and error recovery

 - Partner directly with users, Product, Design, and AI engineers to understand real workflows, test ideas, and turn feedback into better products

 - Create reusable editing, visualization, and collaboration primitives that accelerate future products across Replit
   
   
   


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

 - 4+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong record of shipping high-quality, user-facing products

 - Understanding of the full agentic software development stack, helping coding agents build, test and review correct code

 - Deep experience with TypeScript, React, HTML, and CSS, along with strong knowledge of browser performance, application state, responsive design, and accessibility

 - Strong product judgment and visual taste, with the ability to balance usability, speed, correctness, polish, and long-term maintainability

 - Comfort working across the full stack, including Node.js, APIs, Postgres, data models, and production debugging

 - Familiarity with agentic software development and how coding agents build, test, review, and operate software
   
   
   


BONUS POINTS

 - Building visual editors, presentation software, creative tools, data applications, developer tools, or collaboration products

 - Working with canvas or graphics systems, rich text, direct manipulation, real-time collaboration, data visualization, or complex interactive interfaces

 - Designing user experiences around AI generation, streaming responses, tool calls, and long-running agent workflows

 - Founding a technical company, working as a founding engineer, or shipping a high-visibility independent project

These experiences are preferred, but not required. We care most about what you have built, the quality of your product thinking, and your ability to learn quickly.





EXAMPLE PROJECTS YOU’LL WORK ON

 - Building on top of our Replit Slides AI-native presentation product where users can generate beautiful decks, directly edit elements, collaborate with others, and reliably export their work

 - Enable Replit Agent to turn raw datasets and natural-language questions into interactive, trustworthy data applications

 - Design visual tools that make AI-generated work feel as precise, editable, and controllable as traditionally authored content

 - Build reusable editing, visualization, collaboration, and artifact-management systems that power multiple new Replit products

 - Develop feedback loops and evaluations that improve the visual quality of Agent-generated artifacts
   

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The hybrid role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)



Want to learn more about what we are up to?

Interviewing + Culture at Replit

jobs.title: Waitress
jobs.description:
About Us

Tandoori Twist is an offering from Tinyhus Cafe, a child-friendly cafe in Copenhagen, Denmark, serving authentic Indian delicacies. 

We serve not only classic favourites like butter chicken and biriyani, but also lesser known Indian regional food, with myriad of spices and flavours as our specilities.

Our cafe Tinyhus serves continental food, also traditional local cuisines for events and catering. 

We strive to provide authentic food and exceptional service to our guests and we look for team members who are self-motivated, proactive and passionate to walk the extra mile to provide exceptional culinery experience for our guests. 


Our people, just like our food, are the ambassadors of our cafe and restaurant. If you like challenges and you are looking for a place where you can contribute positively, overcoming the odds of a new but growing restaurant, then please do get in touch; we will look forward to hear from you.

Job Description

Are you a proactive person who enjoys interacting with people, understands their preferences and needs and provides service with a smile? Do you have experience in making coffee and simple cocktails?

Tandoori Twist, a newly established but growing Indian Take-away and Restaurant located in Copenhagen, looking for team member who is outgoing and hard-working. If you have experience as a waiter / waitress and bartender, especially in Asian / Indian restaurant and are proactive, quick-learner, have a pleasant and outgoing personality and can take ownership of tasks, then please feel free to contact us.

Only applications through our career site will be considered https://www.tandooritwist.dk/tandooritwist-career/.


Job description

Your task will be to welcome our guests when they visit the restaurant. You will handle the orders, guide the guests if they need any recommendation, serve food, prepare and serve drinks, take payments, clean the tables and handle take-away deliveries prepared in the kitchen. You will have to make basic cocktails and coffee and serve.

In addition, there is cleaning of our premises and facilities on an ongoing basis and during the opening and closing hours.

This is a part-time position. The work is mainly in the evening and also during weekends. Please note that you need to have right to work in Denmark as work-permit will not be sponsored for this position.


Requirements

Your profile:

• You have a high level of fluency in English (Understanding Danish is an advantage but not mandatory)

• You have a pleasant, outgoing personality and you care for polished and professional appearance

• You remain calm under pressure

• You are truly passionate about high level of customer service, energetic, smiling and attentive

• You truly enjoy customer interaction and have experience in customer-facing sales activity

• Prior experience as a waitress / waiter in a restaurant is mandatory

• Prior hands-on experience either as a Barista and / or as a Bartender is preferred

• You are proficient in making basic cocktails

• Experience in making different types of coffee is desirable; however, if you do not have experience in handling manual coffee machine, you are eager to learn within a short time

• You are a proactive person who takes responsibility and hands-on ownership of the tasks and flexible when it comes to responsibilities and tasks typical for a small but growing organisation

jobs.title: SMB Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a marketing professional who combines strategy and execution, owning demand gen programs and campaigns for the SMB sales segment and startups in Japan. You will partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders—including the Japan sales org, Japan and global marketing teams, and external agencies—to plan and deliver programs that drive results.

In addition, this role supports growth of Notion’s startup program by building awareness and driving trial acquisition, partnering with the Global/APAC startup team to execute marketing activities and recruit partners.

You may also support other marketing initiatives to unlock the full potential of the business in Japan.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Develop a strong understanding of the Notion product and the SMB user/buyer journey to identify the highest-impact plays for the segment. Partner with SMB Sales leadership to set program priorities, define target audiences and goals, and align on campaign plans—proactively communicating progress, results, and learnings to stakeholders.

 - Own end-to-end execution of events and webinars—from planning and logistics through day-of delivery and post-event lead management—translating the agreed program plan into flawless execution. Partner closely with SDRs to ensure timely follow-up, clean lead handoffs, and maximum pipeline impact.

 - Execute demand gen campaigns in our marketing automation platform (e.g., nurture/engagement programs), including audience/segmentation setup and campaign builds, in coordination with Japan + global marketing teams on content and messaging (e.g., gated offers).

 - Partner with APAC Marketing Ops and BizTech to keep GTM systems running smoothly (marketing automation platform, Salesforce, Outreach, Sansan)—including intake/ticketing, operational processes, and system governance (e.g., lead scoring changes, integrations, and best practices).

 - Own lead and pipeline reporting for the SMB segment, tracking key KPIs and regularly assessing pipeline health to inform optimizations across programs.

 - Increase awareness of the Notion for Startups program among early-stage startups and drive acquisition of startup trials through localized, high-velocity campaigns.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 5–7 years of experience managing and executing demand generation programs and campaigns for B2B companies.

 - Proven track record of hitting aggressive growth goals by leveraging campaigns such as email and webinars, with expertise in end-to-end campaign development, execution, and measurement.

 - Proficiency with marketing automation platforms, SFDC, Outreach, Sansan and Figma.

 - Customer-centric and insight-driven. You understand the customer journey and each influencer in the decision-making process, and you use customer insights to design campaigns.

 - Strong cross-functional relationship-building skills. You’ve worked closely with sales, content, SDRs and operations partners.

 - Experience planning and executing webinars from start to finish.

 - Previous experience working with global teams.

 - Proficient in fluent-level Japanese and business-level English, both written and verbal.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - A builder mindset




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Be a Notion power user and are already an advocate for the tool.

 - Track record of interacting with startup founders, VC firms, and incubators




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.description:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications
  • Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  • 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  • Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  • Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  • Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

 

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

jobs.title: Job i Barcelona - Vil du videre fra Telemarketing og arbejde som Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist?
jobs.description:
Vi søger en Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist til vores internationale kontor i Barcelona. 

Har du arbejdet med salg eller Telemarketing i mere end et år, og er du klar til det næste skridt i den karriere? Eller brænder du for digital markedsføring og er du kreativ og vil gerne blive certificeret rådgiver der kan hjælpe andre med at lave succesfulde digitale kampagner? Hvis du er teknisk, kreativ og udadvendt og kan få tingene gjort i et tempofyldt, hurtigt skiftende miljø, har vi måske det perfekte job til dig!

Hvad laver en Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist?

Du arbejder tæt sammen med ambitiøse virksomheder, der skal onboardes til digital vækst. Du rådgiver om Pay-Per-Click-kampagner (PPC), identificerer vækstmuligheder og skaber langsigtet værdi. Med forståelse for markedsdynamik og strategisk tænkning styrker du system integrering og kundeloyalitet — med effekt og relation i centrum.

Skaber vækst og digitale resultater

Du udvikler og optimerer kampagner, opsøger kunder via telefon og video, og identificerer løsninger, der matcher deres unikke behov. Du opbygger tillid og sikrer, at dine kunder får det fulde udbytte af deres digitale investeringer — både på kort og lang sigt.

Styrker kunderejser og partnerskaber

Du håndterer et højt volumen af kunder og rådgiver i komplekse kontekster. Du arbejder med strategier, der øger ROI og kampagnespend, og bistår med integration på tværs af platforme. Du bruger AI-værktøjer i din dagligdag og kommunikerer effektivt med forskellige interessenter — altid med respekt for datasikkerhed og GDPR.

Du bliver en del af et globalt team i hjertet af Barcelona, hvor teknologi og marketing mødes. 

Engelsktalende arbejdsmiljø er standard, og du får fuldt betalt oplæring, personlige coaches og adgang til certificeringer. Stillingen åbner døre til intern karriereudvikling og spændende projekter inden for digital markedsføring.

Dit ansvar:

  • Onboarding af kunder og opbygning af langsigtede relationer over telefon og videomøder

  • Udvikling af performance-drevne PPC-strategier

  • Proaktivt salg og kampagneoptimering

  • Opdatering og vedligeholdelse af kundedata

  • Rådgivning om digital positionering og annoncering

  • Forståelse for ROI og integration med andre platforme

  • Support og strategisk planlægning på nordisk niveau

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Dansk og engelsk på minimum C1

  • Bachelorgrad eller relevant erfaring i marketing/salg/Telemarketing

  • Kendskab til Google Ads, CRM og datastyring

  • Proaktiv og strategisk tilgang til kundeopgaver

  • Evne til at navigere i komplekse stakeholder-miljøer

  • Passion for digital markedsføring og forretningsudvikling

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav — hvis rollen vækker din interesse, opfordrer vi dig stadig til at søge!

Benefits:

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling (39 timer/uge) med hybridmodel i Barcelona

  • Flyttepakke med flybillet og indkvartering i privat studie

  • Privat sygeforsikring og sundhedsfokus

  • Bonus for at anbefale en ven

  • Certificeringer og løbende kompetenceudvikling

  • Arbejdsmiljø med sociale aktiviteter og teambuilding

  • Kontor med havudsigt i World Trade Center, Barcelona

Hvad får du ud af at tage afsted?

Barcelona byder på solrige dage, strandliv og kreativ energi. Her kan du nyde tapas ved havet, arbejde med banebrydende teknologi og udvikle dig både personligt og professionelt i et byliv, der aldrig står stille. Derudover får du:

  • Lavere leveomkostninger end Danmark

  • Kunst, musik, tech og kultur i dynamisk samspil

  • Fokus på trivsel og diversitet

  • Internationale brands og karrieremuligheder

  • Åben og inkluderende atmosfære

Professionel udvikling:

  • Indsigt i digital markedsføring og internationale arbejdskulturer

  • Specialiseret viden om Google Ads og online strategi

  • Fuld oplæring og adgang til certificeringer

  • Karriereveje inden for tech, salg og rådgivning

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med kunder fra hele Europa

Personlig vækst og karriere:

Forestil dig at starte dagen med café con leche, arbejde med digitale strategier under palmerne og slutte af med live-musik ved stranden. Hos TP får du ikke bare et job — du får muligheden for at bygge en karriere, forme fremtiden og leve livet fuldt ud.

Barcelona er stedet, hvor arbejde og livskvalitet går op i en højere enhed.

jobs.title: PEÓN SALA BLANCA EN INDUSTRIA CÁRNICA
jobs.description:
Funciones y tareas: * Deshuesado y preparación: Las piezas (previamente deshuesadas y limpias de corteza y grasa amarillenta) se preparan en mesas de trabajo dentro de la zona estéril. * Loncheado (corte): Se realiza a máquina o por cortadores profesionales que separan y combinan distintas partes de la pieza (maza, babilla, punta y jarrete) para obtener platos equilibrados en sabor y grasa infiltrada. También se lonchean aquí embutidos como lomo, salchichón o chorizo. * Envasado al vación o en atmósfera modificada: Las lonchas se distribuyen en bandejas o platos y se envasan inmediatamente al vacío o con una inyección de gas inerte para evitar la oxidación y extender su vida útil hasta los 90 días. * Etiquetado y trazabilidad: Se registra cada lote. Cada sobre recibe una etiqueta con el tipo de ibérico (bellote, cebo, etc.), porcentaje racial, ingredientes, peso, lote, y fecha de caducidad, asegurando el cumplimientod e la normativa. Desinfección continua: Los cuchillos y herramientas se desinfectan de manera constante, pasando incluso por armarios de ozono para garantizar la esterilidad Perfil del candidato: * No se requiere formación previa, pero será valorable haber tenido experiencia en sala de loncheo. Condiciones laborales: * Contrato indefinido con periodo de prueba, a jornada completa. * Horario: De mañana y tarde * Salario: Según convenio. Observaciones: OFERTA ACOGIDA AL DECRETO 29/2024. jobs.description:
Dansktalende Kundeservicerådgiver for Audi.

Opstart den 20. august og 3. september - Med firmabolig. Vi mangler 4 medarbejdere, så du kan starte alene eller sammen med en af dine venner.

Er du klar til at tage springet og blive en del af en global digital organisation, der leverer support i verdensklasse?

Vi søger tekniske supportere til en spændende rolle med Audi – en af Europas mest ikoniske bilproducenter. Stillingen er 100 % remote fra Portugal, og du bliver en nøglespiller i et internationalt team, der sikrer en ekstraordinær kunderejse for Audi’s brugere.

Hvad laver en Kundeservicerådgiver?

Som Kundeservicerådgiver er du kundens direkte kontaktpunkt og hjælper med alt fra bilteknologi til digitale funktioner og serviceydelser. Du skaber en professionel oplevelse med struktur, empati og høj kvalitet i centrum.

Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Besvarelse af henvendelser via telefon, e-mail og chat

  • Fejlsøgning af tekniske problemer og vejledning i bilsystemer

  • Registrering af kundeinteraktioner i CRM-systemet

  • Opdatering på Audi’s produkter og politikker

  • Aktiv deltagelse i teamets deling af best practices

Dine kvalifikationer:

Vi leder efter dig, hvis du:

  • Taler og skriver dansk + har et minimum B2-niveau i engelsk

  • Har erfaring med kundeservice – gerne fra bilbranchen

  • Har teknisk flair og interesse for digitale løsninger

  • Kan kommunikere tydeligt, løse problemer og skabe tillid

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav – vi opfordrer dig stadig til at søge!

Vi tilbyder:

  • Mulighed for firmabolig i Braga

  • Konkurrencedygtig grundløn plus bonusordning

  • Professionelle udviklingsmuligheder

  • Et samarbejdende og støttende arbejdsmiljø

  • Adgang til eksklusive rejsefordele og rabatter

  • Restaurantkort

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring

  • 14 lønudbetalinger om året

Fordele ved at arbejde i en international virksomhed i Portugal

  • Udvidelse af dine faglige kompetencer gennem globalt samarbejde

  • Forbedring af kommunikation og salgsteknikker i et internationalt miljø

  • Mulighed for karriereudvikling inden for kundeservice, salg og rejsebranchen

  • Adgang til et netværk af internationale kolleger og brancheeksperter

  • Erfaring med moderne digitale værktøjer til kundehåndtering

Dette er en unik mulighed for at kombinere en stærk erhvervserfaring med en fleksibel arbejdsmodel.

Fordele ved at arbejde fra Portugal

  • Mildt klima året rundt – Portugal har et behageligt middelhavsklima med varme somre og milde vintre, hvilket gør det til en attraktiv destination for dem, der ønsker at bo og arbejde i et solrigt land

  • Lavere leveomkostninger – Sammenlignet med mange andre europæiske lande er leveomkostningerne i Portugal relativt lave, hvilket giver mulighed for en høj livskvalitet til en rimelig pris.

  • Høj livskvalitet – Portugal er kendt for sin afslappede livsstil, gode mad og venlige lokalbefolkning, hvilket skaber et positivt og behageligt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Internationale karrieremuligheder – Arbejde i Portugal giver mulighed for at udvikle internationale færdigheder og samarbejde med kolleger fra forskellige nationaliteter, hvilket kan være en fordel for din fremtidige karriere.

  • God infrastruktur og moderne faciliteter – Portugal har en stærk digital infrastruktur, moderne kontorfaciliteter og gode transportmuligheder, hvilket sikrer en behagelig arbejdsdag.

  • Adgang til smukke strande og natur – Portugal tilbyder nem adgang til fantastiske strande, naturskønne områder og en rig kulturarv, som kan opleves både i fritiden og weekenderne.

  • Attraktiv skattepolitik for udlændinge – For internationale medarbejdere findes der skattefordele, der kan gøre det økonomisk fordelagtigt at arbejde i Portugal.

  • Voksende erhvervsliv og økonomi – Portugal har en blomstrende erhvervssektor, hvor flere internationale virksomheder etablerer sig, hvilket skaber gode jobmuligheder og karriereveje.

  • Stærkt netværk af expats og internationale virksomheder – Mange internationale virksomheder har kontorer i Portugal, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig i et globalt arbejdsmiljø.

Arbejdet i Portugal giver både professionel og personlig udvikling samt mulighed for at opleve en spændende livsstil med stor kulturel og økonomisk værdi.

jobs.title: Outcomes Growth Strategy and Programs Lead
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s global Outcomes organization is focused on helping customers achieve business objectives with Notion. As the Growth Strategy & Programs Lead, you will help design and scale the programs, operating rhythms, and cross-functional initiatives that make install-base growth more explosive and repeatable globally.



This is a high-impact strategy and programs role. You will create the clarity, structure, and execution systems that help the business grow existing customers more deliberately.



You will bring analytical rigor to how we understand growth, translate insights into scalable programs, and help teams execute with consistency while still allowing for local market nuance. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable building a model, writing a crisp recommendation, aligning executive stakeholders, and turning a strategy into a practical field motion.

 

This role will be based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




IN YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS, YOU WILL:

 - Learn Notion's post-sales operating model, regional execution model, and current install-base growth priorities.

 - Partner with RevOps, Data Science, Finance, Sales, Outcomes, and Services leaders to develop a practical view of the key drivers and leading indicators behind retention and expansion.

 - Identify a focused set of priority growth programs or plays to support the business in the near term.

 - Build the initial program plans, success metrics, stakeholder map, and operating cadence for those priority initiatives.

 - Partner with regional teams to understand how global programs should be adapted for local execution.

 - Create clear documentation, field-facing materials, and executive-ready updates that help teams align and act.

 - Establish a repeatable rhythm for reviewing progress, capturing learnings, and improving




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Help build a clear, shared view of the drivers behind expansion and adoption across Notion's customer base.

 - Design and scale global programs that support customer adoption, value realization, cross-sell, upsell, and durable growth.

 - Partner with regional and functional leaders to turn local learnings into repeatable playbooks, programs, and operating cadences.

 - Create measurement, reporting, and review mechanisms that help teams understand what is working and where to focus.

 - Support the design of customer growth motions that connect Sales, Services, and Partners.

 - Help codify best practices so growth becomes part of the standard operating rhythm, not a set of one-off campaigns.

 - Bring structure to ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives and drive them from idea to operational execution.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Experience in management consulting, investment banking, business operations, or post-sales GTM operations.

 - Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills; you can turn ambiguous business questions into clear frameworks, insights, and recommendations.

 - Proven ability to design and manage cross-functional programs from strategy through execution.

 - Strong stakeholder management across senior leaders and operating teams, with the ability to align people around a shared plan.

 - Excellent written communication, including crisp strategy docs, program plans, executive updates, and field-facing materials.

 - Comfort working in a global organization where programs need a strong central strategy and room for regional adaptation.

 - Ability to operate autonomously, prioritize effectively, and bring structure to fast-moving, ambiguous work.

 - Strong business judgment and curiosity about what drives customer adoption, retention, and expansion.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Familiarity with usage-based, consumption-based, or product-led growth models.

 - Experience building or scaling global programs across multiple regions or customer segments.

 - Exposure to pricing, packaging, services, partners, or monetization initiatives.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is $250,000 - $280,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74. 



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: MARKETING EXECUTIVE
Senior Technical Program Manager, Security
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to own our vulnerability management program end to end. In this role, you will drive vulnerability intake, triage, remediation, and reporting across our bug bounty program, our Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure, source code hosted on GitHub, and a broad portfolio of third-party SaaS services. You will partner closely with platform engineering, product engineering, SRE, security, IT, legal, and vendor management to make sure vulnerabilities are found fast, triaged accurately, and closed within SLA — and that leadership always has a clear, current picture of the organization's risk posture.The ideal candidate uses AI and automation aggressively to scale themselves, but understands that the core value is clarity, tradeoffs, and execution, not just tooling.



What you'll do:

 - Program Ownership: Own and continuously improve the vulnerability management program, including intake, severity scoring (CVSS/risk-based), SLA definition, and remediation tracking across all asset types.

 - Bug Bounty Operations: Manage the triage/payouts/rewards workflow, and report on program health and trends.

 - Cloud Remediation (GCP): Drive remediation of vulnerabilities found in GCP infrastructure — IAM, networking, Compute/GKE, storage, and logging/monitoring configuration — by partnering with security, cloud, and platform engineering teams.

 - Code & Supply Chain Security: Coordinate remediation of vulnerabilities surfaced through SAST/DAST/SCA tooling (Wiz Code, Snyk, Dependabot, code scanning, secret scanning) across engineering repos, including dependency and supply-chain risk.

 - SaaS Vendor Risk: Build and manage the process for assessing and tracking security posture across third-party SaaS applications.

 - Escalation & Exceptions: Define and enforce escalation paths for overdue or critical/high-severity findings, including risk acceptance and exception processes with appropriate sign-off.

 - Cross-Team Accountability: Partner with engineering managers and tech leads to embed remediation work into sprint planning and hold teams accountable to remediation SLAs.

 - Reporting & Alerting: Establish and maintain a single source of truth for vulnerability status, aging, SLA compliance, and risk trends, with dashboards for engineering leadership, security leadership, and executives.

 - Audit & Compliance Support: Support audit and compliance efforts (SOC 2, ISO 27001, customer security questionnaires) by keeping vulnerability management evidence and metrics audit-ready.

 - Process & Automation: Drive process improvements and automation to reduce manual triage effort and improve time-to-remediation across all vulnerability sources.



Required Skill & Experience:

 - Experience: 4–6+ years of experience in technical program management, security program management, or security operations, with direct ownership of a vulnerability management or application security program.

 - Bug Bounty Expertise: Hands-on experience running a bug bounty program (e.g., HackerOne, Bugcrowd, Intigriti), including triage and payout workflows.

 - Cloud Security Knowledge (GCP): Working knowledge of GCP security fundamentals: IAM, VPC/networking, Security Command Center, Cloud Logging/Monitoring, and common cloud misconfiguration risks.

 - Code Security Familiarity: Familiarity with GitHub-based development workflows and code security tooling (Wiz Code, Dependabot, SAST/DAST/SCA tools such as Snyk, Semgrep, or CodeQL).

 - Risk Prioritization: Strong grasp of vulnerability scoring frameworks (CVSS) and risk-based prioritization.

 - Communication: Excellent cross-functional communication skills — able to translate technical vulnerability data into business risk for executive audiences and hold engineering teams accountable without owning the code themselves.

 - Reporting Tools: Proven ability to build reporting/dashboards (e.g., Linear, Jira, ServiceNow, Tableau, Looker) that give leadership real-time visibility into program health.

 - Compliance Awareness: Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, or FedRAMP.



What we value:

 - Systems Thinking: The ability to see the “big picture” and understand how vulnerability management decisions impact the entire stack — cloud, code, and vendor ecosystem alike.

 - Technical Influence: The ability to drive alignment across engineering and security through expertise and collaboration rather than direct authority.

 - Autonomy: Comfortable owning a program end to end and driving outcomes with minimal oversight.

 - Bias for Action: A track record of closing the gap between finding a vulnerability and actually getting it fixed.

You'll establish the foundation for scalable revenue growth while architecting a personalized first-touch experience that sets the tone for their Replit journey.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

jobs.title: Electronics Production Technician
jobs.description:
Work tasks: The role
As an Electronics Production Technician, you will support the assembly, inspection, testing and rework of electronic components and printed circuit boards used in our products and development systems. You will work closely with our engineering team, following technical documentation and testing procedures, identifying faults and recording results accurately. Your work will help ensure that our electronic assemblies meet the required quality and performance standards. This role is suitable for someone with a vocational background or practical experience in electronics who enjoys precise, hands-on work and wants to develop their skills in an advanced engineering environment. Key responsibilities • Assemble electronic components, printed circuit boards and related systems • Inspect incoming PCB assemblies, components and solder joints visually and under a microscope • Perform soldering, cleaning, handling and rework of PCB assemblies • Carry out electrical measurements and functional testing using standard test equipment and dedicated test rigs • Identify faults, perform initial troubleshooting and escalate complex issues to engineers • Read and follow electronic schematics, datasheets, assembly instructions and testing procedures • Prepare cables, connectors and electronic connections • Record inspection, testing and rework results accurately • Maintain the traceability of components and completed work • Monitor electronic component and consumable inventory and communicate replenishment needs • Provide practical feedback and suggest improvements to assembly, testing and work procedures

We offer: What we offer
• A monthly gross salary of €2394–€3724 depending on your experience and skills • Hands-on work with advanced space and optical communication technology • Close cooperation with electronics, embedded software and mechanical engineers • The opportunity to help establish and improve assembly and testing processes as the company grows • Varied work across electronics assembly, inspection, testing, troubleshooting and production support • A small international team where your contribution has a visible impact on the final product Occasional remote work for suitable tasks may be agreed with the hiring manager. The role follows standard business hours in Estonia, with reasonable flexibility in daily starting and finishing times by agreement with the hiring manager.

Other requirements: What we are looking for
Required experience • Vocational education in electronics or equivalent practical experience • Practical experience with electronics assembly and PCB handling • Ability to read electronic schematics, component datasheets and technical instructions • Soldering and PCB rework skills • Ability to use standard electronic test equipment, including multimeters, oscilloscopes and laboratory power supplies • Ability to identify electronic components and understand their markings and package information • Basic fault-finding and troubleshooting skills • A careful, methodical and quality-focused approach • Ability to follow procedures and document work accurately • English at B2 level or above • Willingness to learn new equipment, processes and techniques We welcome applications from both experienced technicians and strong junior candidates with relevant practical skills and a solid foundation in electronics. Nice to have • Experience with surface-mount and through-hole soldering • Experience using hot-air rework equipment • Experience with FBGA rework or reballing • Experience operating pick-and-place or reflow equipment • Experience testing PCB assemblies using dedicated test rigs • Familiarity with IPC workmanship standards or relevant IPC certification • Experience maintaining production, testing or traceability records • Experience with component inventory and production consumables • Previous experience in electronics production, prototyping or a laboratory environment

Option to work from home: No

jobs.title: Talent Management
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is entering a new chapter of People work: more AI-native, more strategic, and more focused on building systems that help every Notino do the best work of their career. We're building toward a four-pronged People Consulting model:



1) Strategic People Partners who steer orgs as the consultative layer closest to the business.

2) Talent Management is the systems and programmatic engine layer — talent programs, systems and resourcing work that support our People Partners & talent density.

3) People Relations is the primary arm and escalation point for employee relations.

4) People Operations owns the operational layer of the end-to-end employee lifecycle, a layer we're increasingly scaling through agentic services.



We are looking for the right person to join our existing Talent Management arm. This person will help define, operationalize, and continuously improve how we grow talent at Notion. This role sits at the intersection of talent philosophy, people partner strategy and enablement.



This is not a siloed program role. It is an extension of our strategic People Partner & Talent Management org: someone who brings deep talent management craft, strong business judgment, and the operating muscle to turn philosophy into practice across the company.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

1) Maintain and operationalize Notion’s talent philosophies

 - Codify and evolve our talent philosophies across performance, growth, leadership, career development, internal mobility, early career, and high-performance expectations.

 - Translate principles into practical tools, rituals, and operating mechanisms that People Partners and leaders can use.

 - Ensure our philosophies stay connected to business needs, company strategy, and the realities of how work is changing.

2) Ensure the talent systems we build are durable and make talent expectations clear, consistent, and actionable — without over-programming or adding unnecessary process.

 - Co-build the programmatic layer & talent engine for People Partners

 - Help steer and co-build the overall talent enablement engine equipping People Partners to drive higher-quality actions with leaders. If People Partners are consultants, our talent management arm builds the resources to enable talent density.

 - Keep our core philosophies aligned with our deployment-ready materials: playbooks, manager guides, conversation frameworks, decision tools, calibration support, and coaching resources.

 - Partner closely with strategic People Partner leaders to identify where enablement is needed most and how it should show up in the business. Develop net new, creative strategies aligned with Notion’s values and vision.

 - Ensure People Partners are not just consuming talent programs, but actively shaping and deploying them with context and judgment.

3) Enable talent density

 - Bring the taste, craft, and pattern recognition to understand what different talent segments need to grow.

 - Design self-service strategies & actions that help leaders develop talent

 - Power up our mechanisms to better identify, engage, stretch, and retain talent.

 - Enable our leadership bench.

4) Lead fluid, high-leverage talent strategy projects

This role will flex into the highest-priority talent questions of the moment. Examples of historical and potential high-impact projects include:

 - Early career strategy enablement: helping define the scaffolding, manager expectations, growth model, and experience needed to make Notion a definitive launchpad for early-career talent.

 - Total rewards exploration: partnering with Total Rewards, Talent, and People leaders to explore what recognition could look like in a more AI-native, high-performance environment.

 - Role architecture for the next generation of work: rethinking how roles, levels, career paths, and talent systems should evolve as AI changes what people can do.

 - Internal mobility and talent flow: partnering with People Ops, Recruiting and People partners in creating clearer, higher-touch pathways for high-slope talent to find the right next opportunity inside Notion.

 - Leadership expectations: supporting the translation of Notion’s leadership philosophy into practical enablement for managers and leaders.




HOW YOU’LL WORK

 - Embedded, not independent: You will work as an extension of strategic People Partner leaders and existing Talent Management team, not as a separate talent silo.

 - Strategic + practical: You can shape philosophy at 10,000 feet and turn it into an executable V1 strategy in a week – not for the purpose of moving fast, but for getting opinions and engagement of the right solution fast.

 - High taste, low ego: You have strong opinions about what great talent work looks like, but you build through partnership and field feedback.

 - Systems-minded: You design for repeatability and leverage, while knowing when to do the unscalable thing first.

 - Business-first: You anchor talent work in company outcomes, not HR activity.

 - AI-native and Notion-powered: You are energized by reimagining how talent work should change when AI can remove manual coordination and amplify judgment. You also understand how Notion can support our initiatives.

 - Path-agnostic: You’re glad to start as an individual contributor and build the case for a team through impact, not title.




SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Significant experience designing, scaling, and evolving talent management strategies and programs (e.g. performance, talent reviews, succession planning, career architecture, or related initiatives).

 - Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive cross-functional change without formal authority.

 - Experience translating ambiguous talent philosophies into scalable tools, frameworks, and operating mechanisms.

 - Strong business acumen and organizational judgment, with the ability to connect talent decisions to company outcomes.

 - Excitement for reimagining talent management in an AI-native world.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. jobs.description:
Tražimo sistem administratora/administratoricu za rad na implementaciji i održavanju ispisnih rješenja te povezane IT infrastrukture u enterprise okruženjima.

jobs.title: VODITELJ/VODITELJICA ODRŽAVANJA
jobs.description:
Opis poslova:
  • Planiranje i organiziranje održavanja: izrada plana godišnjeg preventivnog održavanje, definira godišnje ciljeve i aktivnosti koji su uključeni u pripremu strategije tvrtke, sudjeluje u pripremi pokazatelja vrijednosti za ciljeve, sudjeluje u pripremi programa upravljanja okolišem koji su uključeni u planiranje i organiziranje investicijskih projekata, organiziranje provođenja redovitih mišljenja o stanju strojeva i opreme te otklanja pronađene pogreške.
  • Vodi i kontrolira provedbu investicijskih projekata i nadgleda provedbu redovitih preventivnih pregleda strojeva i uređaja, prati i daje izvješća o zastojima u radu i poteškoćama, kontrolira otklanjanje kvarova, potvrđuje interne naloge za održavanje, upravlja troškovima održavanja za postizanje ciljeva i maksimiziranje dobiti, priprema sve potrebne izvještaje.
  • Planira i izrađuje ciljeve za podređene zaposlenike, sudjeluje u izradi plana obrazovanja i osposobljavanja i osposobljavanja na radnom mjestu, utvrđuje učinkovitost obrazovanja i osposobljavanja, ocjenjuje rad i izvedbu podređenih zaposlenika, predlaže nagrade i promocije, organizira vođenje evidencije prisutnosti i odsutnosti s rada svojih podređenih, potiče zaposlenike na davanje korisnih prijedloga, organizira mentorstvo, potiče zaposlenike da prijavljuju eventualne opasnosti od nezgode i ozljede na radu.
  • Komunicira interno, te prema vani, voditelj je u procesu rada prema podređenim zaposlenicima i dobavljačima.
  • Sudjelovanje u procesu racionalizacije potrošnje energije.
  • Sudjelovanje u projektnim timovima, praćenje provedbe, kontrola projektne dokumentacije.
  • Poznavanje propisa i promjena u zakonodavstvu i njihovo uvođenje u provedbu postavljenih zadaća.
  • Za vrijeme svoje odsutnosti, iz bilo kojeg razloga, dužan je osigurati da se rad obavlja bez problema i osigurati zamjenu.
  • Obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu rukovoditelja.
  • Odgovornost za realizaciju planova održavanja u pogonu.
  • Odgovornost za funkcioniranje elektro i strojnog održavanja.
  • Odgovornost za rad u skladu sa Zakonom o radu, Zakonom o očuvanju okoliša i zahtjevima sustava ISO standarda.
  • Odgovornost za funkcionalnu i pouzdanu raspoloživost strojeva za proizvodnju.
  • Odgovornost za racionalno i učinkovito korištenje i naručivanje rezervnih dijelova.
  • Odgovornost za remonte i planirane zastoje stroja dogovara s voditeljem pogona i svojim nadređenim.
  • Odgovornost za upotrebu osobne zaštitne opreme i za poštovanje uputa za siguran rad svih podređenih.

jobs.title: Account Executive (India)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



Replit is experiencing extraordinary demand and seeking an Account Executive with strong communication skills to drive our hyper-growth. Candidates with SaaS experience, particularly with some technical background (i.e. having some coding knowledge or prior experience at other developer tool companies) are ideal.



This full-cycle sales position encompasses new client acquisition. We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for people who excel in client-facing situations and have a passion for driving sales and AI. You'll leverage your skills to effectively communicate Replit's value proposition: a world where anyone can create software using natural language.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Evangelize a future where anyone can create software in natural language, ushering in a change in the nature of the firm on par with the PC era

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for prospects and customers, guiding them through the buying journey

 - Conduct compelling product demonstrations and help realize the art of the possible by orchestrating non-engineering hackathons

 - Articulate Replit's value proposition and align it with customers' business objectives

 - Collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure technical accuracy and successful delivery

 - Prepare tailored quotes and skillfully negotiate deals

 - Maintain accurate customer and forecasting data in Replit’s CRM (Hubspot)

 - Foster strong relationships with existing clients while identifying opportunities for expanded adoption

 - Optimize customers' use of the Replit platform through ongoing collaboration and support

 - Gather and communicate valuable customer feedback, championing their interests within Replit



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Experience in AE or SE/technical sales role, preferably in SaaS or developer tools

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas

 - Experience with, or direct observations of full-cycle sales, from prospecting to closing deals to managing existing customers

 - Proficiency in using CRM systems and sales tools (e.g., Hubspot)

 - Ability to quickly learn and articulate the value of new technologies

 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think on your feet

 - Self-motivated with excellent time management and organizational skills

 - Passion for technology and staying current with industry trends

 - Experience with or strong interest in AI and machine learning is a plus

 - Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time for client meetings and events
   
   


NICE TO HAVE:

 - You're an active Replit user

 - You've worked at an early-stage startup or in developer tools

 - Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience)
   
   


TOOLS + TECH STACK FOR THIS ROLE:

 - Replit

 - Hubspot CRM

 - ZoomInfo

 - Clay

 - SmartLead

 - LinkedIn Sales Navigator

 - Hashboard, Hex
   
   


THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF:

 - You’re not based in India area

 - You lack an understanding of the software development lifecycle; have little to no coding knowledge

 - You’re not passionate about AI

 - You don’t enjoy being in client facing roles where 80% of your day is talking to others





Note: This role will begin as remote, with plans to transition to a hybrid model once we establish a local office presence.

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project: The Molecular Endocrinology Department (KMEB), Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD scholarship
jobs.description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project:

The Molecular Endocrinology Department (KMEB), Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD scholarship for a highly motivated candidate interested in working at the intersection of cancer biology and endocrinology. The project aims to investigate stanniocalcin-2 (STC2) as a key mediator of adipose tissue–tumor crosstalk in obesity-related cancer.

The project is part of a larger collaborative research initiative, the Molecular Mechanisms Linking Obesity and Cancer (MMLOC) network, funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. Though this grant, 2/3 of the PhD salary has been secured.

Employment is therefore conditional upon the successful enrolment of the candidate as a PhD student at the PhD School at Faculty of Health Sciences, and the awarding of a one-year Faculty Scholarship. 

 

Research environment

The PhD project will be anchored at KMEB, a research unit focused on clinical and translational endocrinology, under the supervision of Associate Professor Rikke Hjortebjerg and Professor Jan Frystyk. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with the laboratory of co-supervisor Professor Henrik Ditzel, Cancer and Inflammation Research Unit, Department of Molecular Medicine, SDU. 

The candidate will work across two complementary research groups with access to state-of-the-art research facilities. Together, the groups provide a multidisciplinary research environment with close integration of clinical and experimental research. The teams are internationally oriented and offer a supportive and inclusive research culture.

You can read more about KMEB here: https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/kmeb

 

Project description

Our research centers around the insulin-like growth factor (IGF) system, a key hormonal regulator in several diseases. The project focuses on stanniocalcin-2 (STC2), an IGF system member that is linked to poor outcomes in most obesity-related cancers but paradoxically predicts favorable prognosis in postmenopausal estrogen receptor-positive (ER+) breast cancer. 

The aim is to examine how STC2 effects are modulated by obesity and estrogen signaling and how it regulates IGF-2/insulin receptor pathways in the tumor–adipose microenvironment. To establish clinically relevant models, the candidate will generate patient-derived xenograft (PDX) mouse models with human tumor tissue and participate in establishing patient-derived organoids and 3D co-cultures. These systems will be interrogated using genetically engineered STC2 and PAPP-A variants and analyzed with advanced sequencing, spatial, and single-cell omics.

The PhD student will:

  • Establish and analyze PDX mouse models of ER+ breast cancer.

  • Sample and process tumor and tumor-adjacent/distant adipose tissue from breast cancer patients.

  • Assess STC2 activity, IGF-2 signaling, and tumor growth under estrogen-controlled conditions.

  • Help analyze molecular data generated through sequencing and omics-based approaches.

 

Qualifications

The applicant should possess the following qualifications:

  • A master’s degree (MSc or equivalent) in molecular biology, biomedicine, or related fields. 

  • Preferably prior experience with endocrinology or cancer research. 

  • An interest in working with animal models (mice) is a necessity.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

  • A motivated, independent, and quality-oriented approach to research, with enthusiasm for learning new scientific disciplines and methodologies.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:
Rikke Hjortebjerg

KMEB, Department of Clinical Research

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

E-mail: rhjortebjerg@health.sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• At letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)


Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. This also applies to reference letters.

 

Closing date September 1, 2026

Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order)

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.
